/// Корневой виджет приложения.
library;

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:lottie/lottie.dart';

import 'application/navigation/router.dart';
import 'application/state/presence_detector_provider.dart';
import 'application/state/theme_provider.dart';
import 'data/services/screen_saver_settings.dart';
import 'presentation/theme/app_theme.dart';
import 'presentation/widgets/screen_saver_host.dart';
import 'package:flutter_localizations/flutter_localizations.dart';
import 'data/services/language_preference.dart';
import 'l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class SHomeApp extends StatefulWidget {
  const SHomeApp({super.key});

  @override
  State<SHomeApp> createState() => _SHomeAppState();
}

class _SHomeAppState extends State<SHomeApp> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(LanguagePreference.load());
    unawaited(ScreenSaverSettings.load());
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Consumer(
      builder: (context, ref, child) {
        ref.watch(presenceDetectorProvider);
        final themeMode = ref.watch(themeProvider);

        return ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
          valueListenable: LanguagePreference.value,
          builder: (context, languageCode, _) {
            final Locale? appLocale =
            languageCode == LanguagePreference.system
                ? null
                : Locale(languageCode);

            return MaterialApp.router(
              title: 'SHome',
              theme: AppTheme.light(),
              darkTheme: AppTheme.dark(),
              themeMode: themeMode,
              routerConfig: router,
              debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,

              // null означает «Как в системе».
              locale: appLocale,

              // Эти делегаты предоставляют AppLocalizations и системные
              // переводы Flutter Material, Widgets и Cupertino.
              localizationsDelegates: const [
                AppLocalizations.delegate,
                GlobalMaterialLocalizations.delegate,
                GlobalWidgetsLocalizations.delegate,
                GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate,
              ],
              supportedLocales: AppLocalizations.supportedLocales,

              builder: (context, routerChild) {
                return ValueListenableBuilder<ScreenSaverConfig>(
                  valueListenable: ScreenSaverSettings.value,
                  builder: (context, screenConfig, _) {
                    return ScreenSaverHost(
                      enabled: screenConfig.enabled,
                      idleTimeout: Duration(
                        seconds: screenConfig.idleTimeoutSeconds,
                      ),
                      motionWakeEnabled:
                      screenConfig.motionWakeEnabled,
                      motionSensitivity:
                      screenConfig.motionSensitivity,
                      iconSize: 180,
                      screenSaverBuilder: (context) {
                        return Lottie.asset(
                          'assets/animations/Home.json',
                          fit: BoxFit.contain,
                          repeat: true,
                        );
                      },
                      child: routerChild ?? const SizedBox.shrink(),
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

/// Глобальные уровни логирования для разработчика.
/// Пользователю эти настройки не видны.
class DebugConfig {
  /// Уровень логирования:
  /// none  — ничего
  /// error — только ошибки
  /// info  — ошибки + важные события
  /// debug — всё
  static const String logLevel = 'error'; // ← меняй здесь вручную

  static bool get showErrors =>
      logLevel == 'error' || logLevel == 'info' || logLevel == 'debug';

  static bool get showInfo => logLevel == 'info' || logLevel == 'debug';

  static bool get showDebug => logLevel == 'debug';
}

class NotificationSettings {
  final bool enabled;
  final String vkToken;
  final String vkUserId;

  final bool notifyScenes;
  final bool notifyDevices;
  final bool notifyAlarms;
  final bool notifyErrors;

  // Zigbee alerts
  final bool notifyZigbeeWaterLeak;
  final bool notifyZigbeeSmoke;
  final bool notifyZigbeeGas;
  final bool notifyZigbeeMotion;
  final bool notifyZigbeeContact;

  // Frigate
  final bool notifyFrigatePerson;
  final bool notifyFrigateCar;

  // Availability
  final bool notifyZigbeeOffline;
  final bool notifyFrigateOffline;

  // Cooldown VK
  final int vkCooldownMin;

  final bool smsEnabled;
  final String smsPhoneNumber;

  // Расписание
  final bool useSchedule;
  final bool scheduleOnlyAlarms;
  final int startHour;
  final int startMinute;
  final int endHour;
  final int endMinute;
  final List<int> daysOfWeek;

  NotificationSettings({
    this.enabled = false,
    this.vkToken = '',
    this.vkUserId = '',
    this.notifyScenes = true,
    this.notifyDevices = false,
    this.notifyAlarms = true,
    this.notifyErrors = true,
    // Zigbee alerts
    this.notifyZigbeeWaterLeak = true,
    this.notifyZigbeeSmoke = true,
    this.notifyZigbeeGas = true,
    this.notifyZigbeeMotion = true,
    this.notifyZigbeeContact = true,
    // Frigate
    this.notifyFrigatePerson = true,
    this.notifyFrigateCar = false,
    // Availability
    this.notifyZigbeeOffline = true,
    this.notifyFrigateOffline = true,
    // Cooldown
    this.vkCooldownMin = 1,
    // Schedule
    this.useSchedule = false,
    this.scheduleOnlyAlarms = true,
    this.startHour = 9,

  bool get isConfigured =>
      enabled && vkToken.isNotEmpty && vkUserId.isNotEmpty;

  NotificationSettings copyWith({

class PresencePhone {
  final String phoneId;
  final String phoneName;
  final String ip;
  final bool enabled;

  PresencePhone({
    required this.phoneId,
    required this.phoneName,
    this.ip = '',
    this.enabled = true,
  });

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() => {
    'phoneId': phoneId,
    'phoneName': phoneName,
    'ip': ip,
    'enabled': enabled,
  };

  factory PresencePhone.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) => PresencePhone(
    phoneId: json['phoneId'] as String,
    phoneName: json['phoneName'] as String,
    ip: json['ip'] as String? ?? '',
    enabled: json['enabled'] as bool? ?? true,
  );

  PresencePhone copyWith({
    String? phoneId,
    String? phoneName,
    String? ip,
    bool? enabled,
  }) {
    return PresencePhone(
      phoneId: phoneId ?? this.phoneId,
      phoneName: phoneName ?? this.phoneName,
      ip: ip ?? this.ip,
      enabled: enabled ?? this.enabled,
    );
  }
}

class PresenceSettings {
  final bool enabled;
  final List<PresencePhone> phones;
  final double homeLat;
  final double homeLng;
  final int homeRadius;
  final int awayTimeoutMin;

  PresenceSettings({
    this.enabled = false,
    this.phones = const [],
    this.homeLat = 0.0,
    this.homeLng = 0.0,
    this.homeRadius = 100,
    this.awayTimeoutMin = 5,
  });

  bool get isConfigured => phones.any((p) => p.enabled);

  PresenceSettings copyWith({
    bool? enabled,
    List<PresencePhone>? phones,
    double? homeLat,
    double? homeLng,
    int? homeRadius,
    int? awayTimeoutMin,
  }) {
    return PresenceSettings(
      enabled: enabled ?? this.enabled,
      phones: phones ?? this.phones,
      homeLat: homeLat ?? this.homeLat,
      homeLng: homeLng ?? this.homeLng,
      homeRadius: homeRadius ?? this.homeRadius,
      awayTimeoutMin: awayTimeoutMin ?? this.awayTimeoutMin,
    );
  }
}

===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\application\onboarding_manager.dart =====
/// Управляет флагом завершения онбординга через SharedPreferences.
/// Если онбординг не пройден — при старте показывается Welcome экран.
/// После завершения — флаг сохраняется и больше не показывается.
library;
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

class OnboardingManager {
  /// Ключ для хранения флага в SharedPreferences
  static const _keyOnboardingComplete = 'onboarding_complete';

  /// Проверяет, был ли завершён онбординг.
  /// Возвращает true, если пользователь уже прошёл онбординг.
  /// Если ключ отсутствует — возвращает false (первый запуск).
  static Future<bool> isOnboardingComplete() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    return prefs.getBool(_keyOnboardingComplete) ?? false;
  }

  /// Устанавливает флаг завершения онбординга в true.
  /// Вызывается после прохождения всех экранов онбординга.
  static Future<void> complete() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.setBool(_keyOnboardingComplete, true);
  }

  /// Сбрасывает флаг онбординга (для отладки или сброса настроек).
  /// После вызова при следующем запуске снова покажется онбординг.
  static Future<void> reset() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    await prefs.remove(_keyOnboardingComplete);
  }
}
===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\application\services\notification_settings_service.dart =====
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../../data/local/secure_storage/encrypted_keys.dart';

class NotificationSettingsService {
  static Future<bool> shouldSendDeviceNotification() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final enabled = prefs.getBool('notifications_enabled') ?? false;
    final notifyDevices = prefs.getBool('notify_devices') ?? false;

    // VK-токен и userId — в SecureStorage
    final keys = EncryptedKeys();
    final token = await keys.getVkToken() ?? '';
    final userId = await keys.getVkUserId() ?? '';

    return enabled &&
        notifyDevices &&
        token.isNotEmpty &&
        userId.isNotEmpty;
  }

  static Future<bool> shouldSendSceneNotification() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final enabled = prefs.getBool('notifications_enabled') ?? false;
    final notifyScenes = prefs.getBool('notify_scenes') ?? true;

    final keys = EncryptedKeys();
    final token = await keys.getVkToken() ?? '';
    final userId = await keys.getVkUserId() ?? '';

    return enabled &&
        notifyScenes &&
        token.isNotEmpty &&
        userId.isNotEmpty;
  }
}
===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\application\services\update_service.dart =====
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:github_release_apk_updater/github_release_apk_updater.dart';
import 'package:open_filex/open_filex.dart';
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:path_provider/path_provider.dart';

class UpdateService {
  static final _updater = GithubReleaseApkUpdater();
  static final _apiService = GithubApiService();

  static Future<String?> _getReleaseNotes(String version) async {
    try {
      final response = await http.get(
        Uri.parse('https://api.github.com/repos/votsurx/SHome-Releases/releases/tags/v$version'),
      );
      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
        return data['body'] as String?;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Ошибка получения release notes: $e');
    }
    return null;
  }

  static Future<void> checkForUpdates(BuildContext context) async {
    try {
      if (!context.mounted) return;

      final supportedAbis = await _updater.getSupportedAbis() ?? ['arm64-v8a'];
      final release = await _apiService.getLatestGithubAPKRelease(
        ownerGithub: 'votsurx',
        repositoryGithub: 'SHome-Releases',
        apkKeyName: '',
        supportedAbis: supportedAbis,
      );

      if (release == null) {
        if (!context.mounted) return;
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('Не удалось проверить обновления')),
        );
        return;
      }

      final currentVersion = await _updater.getCurrentAppVersion();
      final isNewer = VersionComparator().isNewerVersion(release.version, currentVersion);

      if (!context.mounted) return;

      if (isNewer) {
        _showUpdateDialog(context, release);
      } else {
        showDialog(
          context: context,
          builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
            title: const Text('Обновлений нет'),
            content: const Text('У вас установлена последняя версия SHome.'),
            actions: [
              TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: const Text('OK')),
            ],
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Ошибка проверки обновлений: $e');
    }
  }

  /// Прямое скачивание APK с GitHub Releases
  static Future<String?> _downloadApkDirect(
      String version,
      String abi,
      void Function(double progress) onProgress,
      ) async {
    try {
      // Определяем имя файла по ABI
      String fileName;
      if (abi.contains('arm64')) {
        fileName = 'app-arm64-v8a-release.apk';
      } else if (abi.contains('armeabi')) {
        fileName = 'app-armeabi-v7a-release.apk';
      } else if (abi.contains('x86_64')) {
        fileName = 'app-x86_64-release.apk';
      } else {
        fileName = 'app-arm64-v8a-release.apk';
      }

      // Прямой URL
      final url = Uri.parse(
        'https://github.com/votsurx/SHome-Releases/releases/download/v$version/$fileName',
      );

      debugPrint('📥 Прямое скачивание: $url');

      final dir = await getApplicationDocumentsDirectory();
      final filePath = '${dir.path}/SHome_update.apk';
      final file = File(filePath);
      if (await file.exists()) {
        await file.delete();
      }

      final client = http.Client();
      final request = http.Request('GET', url);
      final response = await client.send(request);

      if (response.statusCode != 200) {
        debugPrint('❌ Ошибка скачивания: ${response.statusCode}');
        client.close();
        return null;
      }

      final total = response.contentLength ?? 0;
      int received = 0;
      final sink = file.openWrite();

      await for (final chunk in response.stream) {
        sink.add(chunk);
        received += chunk.length;
        if (total > 0) {
          onProgress(received / total);
        }
      }

      await sink.close();
      client.close();

      debugPrint('✅ APK скачан: $filePath');
      return filePath;
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Ошибка скачивания: $e');
      return null;
    }
  }

  static void _showUpdateDialog(BuildContext context, GithubAPKRelease release) async {
    final releaseNotes = await _getReleaseNotes(release.version);
    final progressNotifier = ValueNotifier<double>(0);
    final isDownloading = ValueNotifier<bool>(false);

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (dialogCtx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogCtx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.system_update, color: Colors.green, size: 22),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  'Обновление ${release.version}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                  maxLines: 1,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: isDownloading.value
                ? ValueListenableBuilder<double>(
              valueListenable: progressNotifier,
              builder: (context, progress, _) => Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  LinearProgressIndicator(
                    value: progress,
                    minHeight: 8,
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Text(
                    '${(progress * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  const Text('Скачивание обновления...', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey)),
                ],
              ),
            )
                : Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                if (releaseNotes != null && releaseNotes.isNotEmpty) ...[
                  const Text('Что нового:', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(releaseNotes, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
                ] else
                  const Text('Доступна новая версия приложения.'),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: isDownloading.value
              ? null
              : [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogCtx),
              child: const Text('Позже'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () async {
                isDownloading.value = true;
                setDialogState(() {});

                // Получаем ABI устройства
                final abis = await _updater.getSupportedAbis();
                final abi = (abis != null && abis.isNotEmpty) ? abis.first : 'arm64-v8a';

                // Прямое скачивание
                final filePath = await _downloadApkDirect(
                  release.version,
                  abi,
                      (progress) {
                    progressNotifier.value = progress;
                  },
                );

                if (filePath != null) {
                  debugPrint('✅ APK скачан: $filePath');

                  final result = await OpenFilex.open(filePath);
                  debugPrint('📦 Результат: ${result.type} — ${result.message}');

                  if (!dialogCtx.mounted) return;

                  if (result.type != ResultType.done) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogCtx).showSnackBar(
                      SnackBar(content: Text('Ошибка установки: ${result.message}')),
                    );
                  } else {
                    Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogCtx).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('После установки откройте SHome вручную')),
                    );
                  }
                } else {
                  if (dialogCtx.mounted) {
                    Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(dialogCtx).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(content: Text('Ошибка скачивания')),
                    );
                  }
                }
              },
              icon: const Icon(Icons.download),
              label: const Text('Обновить'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Провайдер списка устройств на Riverpod.
/// Центральный узел управления устройствами: вкл/выкл, многоканальные, датчики.
/// Использует прямое управление через TuyaProtocol (без CommandHandler).
/// Логирует все действия через EventLogger.
/// При старте все устройства переводятся в offline — AdaptivePoller актуализирует состояние.
library;
import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../../data/protocols/zigbee_protocol.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/device_repository.dart';
import '../../data/protocols/tuya_protocol.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../data/services/event_logger.dart';
import '../../data/services/notification_coordinator.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import '../../application/state/notification_settings_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/sms_settings_provider.dart';
import '../../di/global_container.dart';

/// Глобальный провайдер списка устройств.
final devicesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<DevicesNotifier, List<Device>>((ref) {
  return DevicesNotifier();
});

class DevicesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Device>> {
  final DeviceRepository _repository = getIt<DeviceRepository>();
  final TuyaProtocol _tuyaProtocol = getIt<TuyaProtocol>();
  final NotificationCoordinator _notifier = NotificationCoordinator();

  void Function(String)? onCommandSent;

  DevicesNotifier() : super([]) {
    _loadDevices();
  }

  List<Device> get devices => state;

  // ═══════════ ЗАГРУЗКА И ПОРЯДОК ═══════════

  Future<void> _loadDevices() async {
    final devices = await _repository.getAllDevices();
    state = devices.map((d) {
      final props = Map<String, dynamic>.from(d.properties);

      if (d.type == DeviceType.switch1 ||
          d.type == DeviceType.switch2 ||
          d.type == DeviceType.switch3) {
        if (props['dps_map'] == null || (props['dps_map'] as Map).isEmpty) {
          final channels = props['channels'] as int? ??
              (d.type == DeviceType.switch3 ? 3 : d.type == DeviceType.switch2 ? 2 : 1);
          props['dps_map'] = {
            for (var i = 1; i <= channels; i++)
              '$i': {'label': 'Канал $i', 'type': 'bool', 'role': 'channel'},
          };
        }
      }

      props['isOn'] = false;
      if (props['states'] != null) {
        props['states'] = List<bool>.filled((props['channels'] as int?) ?? 1, false);
      }

      // 🆕 Zigbee: не сбрасываем isOnline, если last_seen свежий (< 24ч).
      // Tuya и остальные — как раньше, сбрасываем в offline (AdaptivePoller актуализирует).
      final isZigbee = d.properties['source'] == 'zigbee';
      final lastSeen = d.properties['last_seen'] as String?;
      final isRecent = lastSeen != null &&
          DateTime.tryParse(lastSeen) != null &&
          DateTime.now().difference(DateTime.parse(lastSeen)).inHours < 24;

      final keepOnline = isZigbee && isRecent;

      return d.copyWith(
        isOnline: keepOnline ? d.isOnline : false,
        state: keepOnline ? d.state : DeviceState.offline,
        properties: props,
      );
    }).toList();
    _restoreOrder();
  }

  void reorderDevices(int oldIndex, int newIndex) {
    final list = [...state];
    if (oldIndex < newIndex) newIndex--;
    final item = list.removeAt(oldIndex);
    list.insert(newIndex, item);
    state = list;
    _saveOrder();
  }

  Future<void> _saveOrder() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final ids = state.map((d) => d.id).toList();
    await prefs.setString('device_order', jsonEncode(ids));
  }

  Future<void> _restoreOrder() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final orderJson = prefs.getString('device_order');
    if (orderJson == null) return;

    final orderIds = (jsonDecode(orderJson) as List).cast<String>();
    final list = [...state];

    list.sort((a, b) {
      final aIndex = orderIds.indexOf(a.id);
      final bIndex = orderIds.indexOf(b.id);
      if (aIndex == -1 && bIndex == -1) return 0;
      if (aIndex == -1) return 1;
      if (bIndex == -1) return -1;
      return aIndex.compareTo(bIndex);
    });

    state = list;
  }

  // ═══════════ ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ СОСТОЯНИЙ ═══════════

  void updateDeviceLocal(Device device) {
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == device.id ? device : d).toList();
  }

  void updateDeviceState(String id, bool isOn) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    // P2: не notify если isOn не изменилось
    if (device.properties['isOn'] == isOn) return;

    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {
        ...device.properties,
        'isOn': isOn,
        if (device.properties['states'] != null)
          'states': device.properties['states'],
      },
    );
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
  }

  void updateDeviceStates(String id, List<bool> states) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {...device.properties, 'states': states, 'isOn': states.any((s) => s)},
    );
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
  }

  void updateOnlineState(String id, bool isOnline) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    // P2: не notify если состояние не изменилось
    if (device.isOnline == isOnline) return;

    final wasOnline = device.isOnline;
    final updated = device.copyWith(
      isOnline: isOnline,
      state: isOnline ? DeviceState.online : DeviceState.offline,
    );
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();

    // 🔔 Уведомление при transition online → offline
    if (wasOnline && !isOnline) {
      _notifyOffline(updated);
    }
  }

  void updateDeviceProperties(String id, Map<String, dynamic> properties) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    final updated = device.copyWith(properties: properties);
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
  }

  // ═══════════ CRUD ═══════════

  Future<void> addDevice(Device device) async {
    await _repository.saveDevice(device);
    state = [...state, device];
    _saveOrder();
    EventLogger.log(event: 'deviceAdded', deviceId: device.id, deviceName: device.name);
  }

  Future<void> updateDevice(Device device) async {
    await _repository.saveDevice(device);
    await _loadDevices();
    onCommandSent?.call(device.id);
  }

  Future<void> removeDevice(String id) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    EventLogger.log(event: 'deviceRemoved', deviceId: id, deviceName: device.name);
    await _repository.deleteDevice(id);
    state = state.where((d) => d.id != id).toList();
    _saveOrder();
  }

  // ═══════════ КОМАНДЫ ═══════════

  Future<bool> turnOn(String id) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    if (device.properties['source'] == 'frigate') return false;

    // 🐝 Zigbee
    if (device.properties['source'] == 'zigbee') {
      try {
        final friendlyName = device.properties['friendly_name'] as String?
            ?? device.name;
        final protocol = getIt<ZigbeeProtocol>();
        await protocol.turnOn(friendlyName);
        _updateLocalState(id, true);
        EventLogger.log(deviceId: id, deviceName: device.name, event: 'turnOn');
        _notifyStateChanged(device, 'Включено', true);
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('❌ Zigbee turnOn error: $e');
        return false;
      }
    }

    // 🔌 Tuya
    EventLogger.log(deviceId: id, deviceName: device.name, event: 'turnOn');
    onCommandSent?.call(id);
    _updateLocalState(id, true);
    final success = await _tuyaProtocol.turnOn(device);
    if (!success) _updateLocalState(id, false);

    _notifyStateChanged(device, 'Включено', success);
    return success;
  }

  Future<bool> turnOff(String id) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    if (device.properties['source'] == 'frigate') return false;

    // 🐝 Zigbee
    if (device.properties['source'] == 'zigbee') {
      try {
        final friendlyName = device.properties['friendly_name'] as String?
            ?? device.name;
        final protocol = getIt<ZigbeeProtocol>();
        await protocol.turnOff(friendlyName);
        _updateLocalState(id, false);
        EventLogger.log(deviceId: id, deviceName: device.name, event: 'turnOff');
        _notifyStateChanged(device, 'Выключено', true);
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('❌ Zigbee turnOff error: $e');
        return false;
      }
    }

    // 🔌 Tuya
    EventLogger.log(deviceId: id, deviceName: device.name, event: 'turnOff');
    onCommandSent?.call(id);
    _updateLocalState(id, false);
    final success = await _tuyaProtocol.turnOff(device);
    if (!success) _updateLocalState(id, true);

    _notifyStateChanged(device, 'Выключено', success);
    return success;
  }

  Future<bool> setSwitchChannel(String id, int channel, bool value) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    if (device.properties['source'] == 'zigbee') {
      try {
        final friendlyName = device.properties['friendly_name'] as String? ?? device.name;
        final protocol = getIt<ZigbeeProtocol>();
        await protocol.setState(friendlyName, {'state_l$channel': value ? 'ON' : 'OFF'});
        _updateChannelState(id, channel, value);

        // 🆕 Событие для Zigbee-канала
        EventLogger.log(
          deviceId: id,
          deviceName: device.name,
          event: value ? 'turnOn' : 'turnOff',
          value: 'Канал $channel',
        );

        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('❌ Zigbee setSwitchChannel error: $e');
        return false;
      }
    }

    onCommandSent?.call(id);
    _updateChannelState(id, channel, value);
    final success = await _tuyaProtocol.setSwitchChannel(device, channel, value);

    if (!success) {
      _updateChannelState(id, channel, !value);
    } else {
      // 🆕 Событие для Tuya-канала
      EventLogger.log(
        deviceId: id,
        deviceName: device.name,
        event: value ? 'turnOn' : 'turnOff',
        value: 'Канал $channel',
      );
    }

    return success;
  }

  void _updateLocalState(String id, bool isOn) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {...device.properties, 'isOn': isOn},
    );
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
  }

  void _updateChannelState(String id, int channel, bool value) {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    final states = List<bool>.from(device.properties['states'] ?? [false, false]);
    if (channel <= states.length) {
      states[channel - 1] = value;
    }
    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {...device.properties, 'states': states},
    );
    state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
  }

  Future<bool> pingDevice(String id) async {
    return await _repository.pingDevice(id);
  }

  Future<bool> setCurtainPosition(String id, int position) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    final success = await _tuyaProtocol.setCurtainPosition(device, position);
    if (success) {
      final updated = device.copyWith(
        properties: {...device.properties, 'position': position},
      );
      state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
    }
    return success;
  }

  Future<bool> setHvac(String id, {required bool power, required double targetTemp, required String mode, required int fanSpeed}) async {
    return await _repository.setHvac(id, power: power, targetTemp: targetTemp, mode: mode, fanSpeed: fanSpeed);
  }

  Future<bool> setBrightness(String id, int brightness) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);

    if (device.properties['source'] == 'zigbee') {
      try {
        final friendlyName = device.properties['friendly_name'] as String?
            ?? device.name;
        final protocol = getIt<ZigbeeProtocol>();
        await protocol.setBrightness(friendlyName, brightness);
        final updated = device.copyWith(
          properties: {
            ...device.properties,
            'brightness': brightness,
            'isOn': brightness > 0,
          },
        );
        state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        debugPrint('❌ Zigbee setBrightness error: $e');
        return false;
      }
    }

    final success = await _tuyaProtocol.setBrightness(device, brightness);
    if (success) {
      final updated = device.copyWith(
        properties: {
          ...device.properties,
          'brightness': brightness,
          'isOn': brightness > 0,
        },
      );
      state = state.map((d) => d.id == id ? updated : d).toList();
    }
    return success;
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> getDeviceDps(String id) async {
    final device = state.firstWhere((d) => d.id == id);
    return await _tuyaProtocol.getStatus(device);
  }

  // ═══════════ УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ ═══════════

  Future<void> _notifyStateChanged(Device device, String action, bool success) async {
    try {
      final vkSettings = globalContainer.read(notificationSettingsProvider);
      final smsSettings = globalContainer.read(smsSettingsProvider);

      await _notifier.notifyDevice(
        device: device,
        type: 'state_changed',
        title: success ? '✅ Устройство' : '❌ Устройство',
        message: '${device.name}: $action',
        vkSettings: vkSettings,
        smsSettings: smsSettings,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Notification error: $e');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _notifyOffline(Device device) async {
    try {
      final vkSettings = globalContainer.read(notificationSettingsProvider);
      final smsSettings = globalContainer.read(smsSettingsProvider);

      await _notifier.notifyDevice(
        device: device,
        type: 'offline',
        title: '📡 Устройство offline',
        message: device.name,
        vkSettings: vkSettings,
        smsSettings: smsSettings,
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ Notification offline error: $e');
    }
  }

/// Riverpod-провайдер для Frigate (камеры, события, статистика).
library;

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../domain/models/frigate_models.dart';
import '../../data/services/frigate_service.dart';
import '../../data/services/frigate_bridge.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';

/// Настройки Frigate (интервал статистики, фильтры уведомлений).
final frigateSettingsProvider =
StateProvider<FrigateSettings>((ref) {
  return FrigateSettings.defaults();
});

/// Список камер.
final frigateCamerasProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<FrigateCamerasNotifier, List<FrigateCamera>>((ref) {
  return FrigateCamerasNotifier();
});

/// Список последних событий.
final frigateEventsProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<FrigateEventsNotifier, List<FrigateEvent>>((ref) {
  return FrigateEventsNotifier();
});

/// Статистика (CPU, RAM).
final frigateStatsProvider = StateProvider<FrigateStats?>((ref) => null);

class FrigateSettings {
  final int statsInterval;  // секунды
  final Set<String> notifyLabels;  // какие события отправлять
  final String? rtspPassword;

  FrigateSettings({
    required this.statsInterval,
    required this.notifyLabels,
    this.rtspPassword,
  });

  factory FrigateSettings.defaults() {
    return FrigateSettings(
      statsInterval: 5,
      notifyLabels: {'person', 'car'},
    );
  }

  FrigateSettings copyWith({
    int? statsInterval,
    Set<String>? notifyLabels,
    String? rtspPassword,
  }) {
    return FrigateSettings(
      statsInterval: statsInterval ?? this.statsInterval,
      notifyLabels: notifyLabels ?? this.notifyLabels,
      rtspPassword: rtspPassword ?? this.rtspPassword,
    );
  }
}

class FrigateCamerasNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<FrigateCamera>> {
  final FrigateService _service = getIt<FrigateService>();

  FrigateCamerasNotifier() : super([]) {
    refresh();
  }

  Future<void> refresh() async {
    final cameras = await _service.getCameras();
    state = cameras;
  }

  void addCamera(FrigateCamera camera) {
    state = [...state, camera];
  }

  void removeCamera(String name) {
    state = state.where((c) => c.name != name).toList();
  }
}

class FrigateEventsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<FrigateEvent>> {
  final FrigateBridge _bridge = getIt<FrigateBridge>();

  FrigateEventsNotifier() : super([]) {
    _bridge.onEvent = (event) {
      state = [event, ...state].take(100).toList();
    };
  }

  void clear() => state = [];
}

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../../data/local/secure_storage/encrypted_keys.dart';
import '../models/notification_settings.dart';

final notificationSettingsProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<NotificationSettingsNotifier, NotificationSettings>(
      (ref) {
    return NotificationSettingsNotifier();
  },
);

class NotificationSettingsNotifier extends StateNotifier<NotificationSettings> {
  final EncryptedKeys _keys = EncryptedKeys();

  NotificationSettingsNotifier() : super(NotificationSettings()) {
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    // ─── МИГРАЦИЯ: VK-токен из SharedPreferences → SecureStorage ───
    final oldToken = prefs.getString('vk_token');
    final oldUserId = prefs.getString('vk_user_id');

    String token = await _keys.getVkToken() ?? '';
    String userId = await _keys.getVkUserId() ?? '';

    if (token.isEmpty && oldToken != null && oldToken.isNotEmpty) {
      await _keys.saveVkToken(oldToken);
      token = oldToken;
      await prefs.remove('vk_token');
    }
    if (userId.isEmpty && oldUserId != null && oldUserId.isNotEmpty) {
      await _keys.saveVkUserId(oldUserId);
      userId = oldUserId;
      await prefs.remove('vk_user_id');
    }

    state = NotificationSettings(
      enabled: prefs.getBool('notifications_enabled') ?? false,
      vkToken: token,
      vkUserId: userId,
      notifyScenes: prefs.getBool('notify_scenes') ?? true,
      notifyDevices: prefs.getBool('notify_devices') ?? false,
      notifyAlarms: prefs.getBool('notify_alarms') ?? true,
      notifyErrors: prefs.getBool('notify_errors') ?? true,
      // Zigbee alerts
      notifyZigbeeWaterLeak: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_water_leak') ?? true,
      notifyZigbeeSmoke: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_smoke') ?? true,
      notifyZigbeeGas: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_gas') ?? true,
      notifyZigbeeMotion: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_motion') ?? true,
      notifyZigbeeContact: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_contact') ?? true,
      // Frigate
      notifyFrigatePerson: prefs.getBool('notify_frigate_person') ?? true,
      notifyFrigateCar: prefs.getBool('notify_frigate_car') ?? false,
      // Availability
      notifyZigbeeOffline: prefs.getBool('notify_zigbee_offline') ?? true,
      notifyFrigateOffline: prefs.getBool('notify_frigate_offline') ?? true,
      // Cooldown
      vkCooldownMin: prefs.getInt('vk_cooldown_min') ?? 1,
      // Schedule
      useSchedule: prefs.getBool('notify_use_schedule') ?? false,
      scheduleOnlyAlarms: prefs.getBool('notify_schedule_only_alarms') ?? true,
      startHour: prefs.getInt('notify_start_hour') ?? 9,
      startMinute: prefs.getInt('notify_start_minute') ?? 0,
      endHour: prefs.getInt('notify_end_hour') ?? 21,
      endMinute: prefs.getInt('notify_end_minute') ?? 0,
      daysOfWeek: prefs.getStringList('notify_days')?.map(int.parse).toList() ??
          const [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7],
      smsEnabled: prefs.getBool('sms_enabled') ?? false,
      smsPhoneNumber: prefs.getString('sms_phone') ?? '',
    );
  }

  Future<void> update(NotificationSettings settings) async {
    state = settings;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    // ─── Секреты — в SecureStorage ───
    if (settings.vkToken.isNotEmpty) {
      await _keys.saveVkToken(settings.vkToken);
    } else {
      await _keys.deleteVkToken();
    }
    if (settings.vkUserId.isNotEmpty) {
      await _keys.saveVkUserId(settings.vkUserId);
    } else {
      await _keys.deleteVkUserId();
    }

    // ─── Остальное — в SharedPreferences ───
    await prefs.setBool('notifications_enabled', settings.enabled);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_scenes', settings.notifyScenes);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_devices', settings.notifyDevices);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_alarms', settings.notifyAlarms);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_errors', settings.notifyErrors);
    // Zigbee alerts
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_water_leak', settings.notifyZigbeeWaterLeak);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_smoke', settings.notifyZigbeeSmoke);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_gas', settings.notifyZigbeeGas);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_motion', settings.notifyZigbeeMotion);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_contact', settings.notifyZigbeeContact);
    // Frigate
    await prefs.setBool('notify_frigate_person', settings.notifyFrigatePerson);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_frigate_car', settings.notifyFrigateCar);
    // Availability
    await prefs.setBool('notify_zigbee_offline', settings.notifyZigbeeOffline);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_frigate_offline', settings.notifyFrigateOffline);
    // Cooldown
    await prefs.setInt('vk_cooldown_min', settings.vkCooldownMin);
    // Schedule
    await prefs.setBool('notify_use_schedule', settings.useSchedule);
    await prefs.setBool('notify_schedule_only_alarms', settings.scheduleOnlyAlarms);
    await prefs.setInt('notify_start_hour', settings.startHour);
    await prefs.setInt('notify_start_minute', settings.startMinute);
    await prefs.setInt('notify_end_hour', settings.endHour);
    await prefs.setInt('notify_end_minute', settings.endMinute);
    await prefs.setStringList(
      'notify_days',
      settings.daysOfWeek.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(),
    );
    await prefs.setBool('sms_enabled', settings.smsEnabled);
    await prefs.setString('sms_phone', settings.smsPhoneNumber);
  }
}
===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\application\state\presence_detector_provider.dart =====
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../data/services/presence_detector.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import 'presence_provider.dart';
import '../../application/models/presence_settings.dart';

/// Глобальный провайдер PresenceDetector.
/// Живёт всё время работы приложения.
///
/// Использует ТОТ ЖЕ экземпляр, что и AutomationEngine
/// (берётся из getIt), чтобы callback onStatusChanged был единым.
final presenceDetectorProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<PresenceDetectorNotifier, PresenceDetector>((ref) {
  return PresenceDetectorNotifier(ref);
});

class PresenceDetectorNotifier extends StateNotifier<PresenceDetector> {
  final Ref ref;

  PresenceDetectorNotifier(this.ref) : super(getIt<PresenceDetector>()) {
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    // Ждём загрузки настроек
    await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 500));

    final settings = ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider);
    if (settings.enabled && settings.isConfigured) {
      await state.start(settings);
    }

    // Следим за изменениями настроек
    ref.listen(presenceSettingsProvider, (previous, next) {
      _onSettingsChanged(previous, next);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _onSettingsChanged(
      PresenceSettings? previous,
      PresenceSettings next,
      ) async {
    if (next.enabled && next.isConfigured) {
      if (!state.isRunning) {
        await state.start(next);
      } else {
        // Перезапускаем с новыми настройками
        state.stop();
        await Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 100));  // ← пауза
        await state.start(next);
      }
    } else {
      if (state.isRunning) {
        state.stop();
      }
    }
  }

  void stop() {
    state.stop();
  }

  Future<void> restart() async {
    state.stop();
    final settings = ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider);
    if (settings.enabled && settings.isConfigured) {
      await state.start(settings);
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import '../models/presence_settings.dart';

final presenceSettingsProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<PresenceSettingsNotifier, PresenceSettings>((ref) {
  return PresenceSettingsNotifier();
});

class PresenceSettingsNotifier extends StateNotifier<PresenceSettings> {
  PresenceSettingsNotifier() : super(PresenceSettings()) {
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    final phonesJson = prefs.getString('presence_phones') ?? '[]';
    final phonesList = (jsonDecode(phonesJson) as List)
        .map((e) => PresencePhone.fromJson(e as Map<String, dynamic>))
        .toList();

    state = PresenceSettings(
      enabled: prefs.getBool('presence_enabled') ?? false,
      phones: phonesList,
      homeLat: prefs.getDouble('presence_home_lat') ?? 0.0,
      homeLng: prefs.getDouble('presence_home_lng') ?? 0.0,
      homeRadius: prefs.getInt('presence_home_radius') ?? 100,
      awayTimeoutMin: prefs.getInt('presence_away_timeout') ?? 5,
    );
  }

  Future<void> update(PresenceSettings settings) async {
    state = settings;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    await prefs.setBool('presence_enabled', settings.enabled);
    await prefs.setString(
      'presence_phones',
      jsonEncode(settings.phones.map((p) => p.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await prefs.setDouble('presence_home_lat', settings.homeLat);
    await prefs.setDouble('presence_home_lng', settings.homeLng);
    await prefs.setInt('presence_home_radius', settings.homeRadius);
    await prefs.setInt('presence_away_timeout', settings.awayTimeoutMin);
  }

  Future<void> addPhone(PresencePhone phone) async {
    final updated = [...state.phones, phone];
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }

  Future<void> removePhone(String phoneId) async {
    final updated = state.phones.where((p) => p.phoneId != phoneId).toList();
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }

  Future<void> updatePhone(String phoneId, PresencePhone newPhone) async {
    final updated = state.phones.map((p) {
      return p.phoneId == phoneId ? newPhone : p;
    }).toList();
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }
}

/// Провайдер комнат на Riverpod.
/// Управляет списком комнат: добавление, удаление, переименование.
/// При удалении комнаты все устройства из неё переносятся в "all".
/// Логирует события через EventLogger.
library;
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../data/services/event_logger.dart';
import '../../domain/models/room.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/room_repository.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
//import 'devices_provider.dart';

/// Глобальный провайдер списка комнат.
final roomsProvider = StateNotifierProvider<RoomsNotifier, List<Room>>((ref) {
  return RoomsNotifier();
});

/// Управляет комнатами: загрузка, добавление, переименование, удаление.
class RoomsNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Room>> {
  final RoomRepository _repository = getIt<RoomRepository>();

  RoomsNotifier() : super([]) {
    _loadRooms();
  }
  Future<void> updateRoom(Room room) async {
    await _repository.saveRoom(room);
    state = state.map((r) => r.id == room.id ? room : r).toList();
  }

  /// Загружает все комнаты из БД
  Future<void> _loadRooms() async {
    final rooms = await _repository.getAllRooms();
    state = rooms;
  }

  /// Добавляет новую комнату. Логирует событие roomAdded.
  Future<void> addRoom(Room room) async {
    await _repository.saveRoom(room);
    state = [...state, room];
    await EventLogger.log(event: 'roomAdded', roomName: room.name);
  }

  /// Удаляет комнату по ID (без переноса устройств).
  /// Для удаления с переносом используй deleteRoomAndMoveDevices.
  Future<void> deleteRoom(String id) async {
    await _repository.deleteRoom(id);
    state = state.where((r) => r.id != id).toList();
  }

  /// Переименовывает комнату.
  Future<void> renameRoom(String id, String newName) async {
    final room = state.firstWhere((r) => r.id == id);
    final updated = room.copyWith(name: newName);
    await _repository.saveRoom(updated);
    state = state.map((r) => r.id == id ? updated : r).toList();
  }
}

/// Провайдер сцен на Riverpod.
/// Управляет сценами: создание, выполнение, удаление.
/// Логирует все действия через EventLogger.
library;
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../data/services/event_logger.dart';
import '../../domain/models/scene.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/scene_repository.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../data/services/vk_notification_service.dart';
import '../../application/services/notification_settings_service.dart';

/// Глобальный провайдер списка сцен.
final scenesProvider = StateNotifierProvider<ScenesNotifier, List<Scene>>((ref) {
  return ScenesNotifier();
});

/// Управляет сценами: загрузка, добавление, выполнение, удаление.
class ScenesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<Scene>> {
  final SceneRepository _repository = getIt<SceneRepository>();

  ScenesNotifier() : super([]) {
    _loadScenes();
  }

  /// Загружает все сцены из репозитория
  Future<void> _loadScenes() async {
    state = await _repository.getAllScenes();
  }

  /// Добавляет новую сцену. Логирует событие sceneCreated.
  Future<void> addScene(Scene scene) async {
    await _repository.saveScene(scene);
    await _loadScenes();
    await EventLogger.log(event: 'sceneCreated', sceneName: scene.name);
  }

  /// Выполняет сцену: для каждого действия отправляет команду на устройство.
  /// Логирует событие scene.
  Future<void> executeScene(String id) async {
    final scene = state.firstWhere((s) => s.id == id);
    await _repository.executeScene(scene);

    // Отправляем уведомление
    final shouldSend = await NotificationSettingsService.shouldSendSceneNotification();
    if (shouldSend) {
      final vk = VkNotificationService();
      await vk.loadSettings();
      await vk.sendSceneNotification(sceneName: scene.name, success: true);
    }

    await EventLogger.log(
      deviceId: '',
      deviceName: '',
      event: 'scene',
      sceneName: scene.name,
    );
  }

  /// Удаляет сцену. Логирует событие sceneDeleted.
  Future<void> deleteScene(String id) async {
    final scene = state.firstWhere((s) => s.id == id);
    await EventLogger.log(event: 'sceneDeleted', sceneName: scene.name);
    await _repository.deleteScene(id);
    state = state.where((s) => s.id != id).toList();
  }
}

  Future<void> update(SmsSettings settings) async {
    state = settings;
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

    await prefs.setBool('sms_enabled', settings.enabled);
    await prefs.setString(
      'sms_phones',
      jsonEncode(settings.phones.map((p) => p.toJson()).toList()),
    );
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_scenes', settings.notifyScenes);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_devices', settings.notifyDevices);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_alarms', settings.notifyAlarms);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_errors', settings.notifyErrors);
    // Zigbee alerts
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_water_leak', settings.notifyZigbeeWaterLeak);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_smoke', settings.notifyZigbeeSmoke);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_gas', settings.notifyZigbeeGas);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_motion', settings.notifyZigbeeMotion);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_contact', settings.notifyZigbeeContact);
    // Frigate
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_frigate_person', settings.notifyFrigatePerson);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_frigate_car', settings.notifyFrigateCar);
    // Availability
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_zigbee_offline', settings.notifyZigbeeOffline);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_notify_frigate_offline', settings.notifyFrigateOffline);
    // Cooldown
    await prefs.setInt('sms_cooldown_min', settings.smsCooldownMin);
    // Schedule
    await prefs.setBool('sms_use_schedule', settings.useSchedule);
    await prefs.setBool('sms_schedule_only_alarms', settings.scheduleOnlyAlarms);
    await prefs.setInt('sms_start_hour', settings.startHour);
    await prefs.setInt('sms_start_minute', settings.startMinute);
    await prefs.setInt('sms_end_hour', settings.endHour);
    await prefs.setInt('sms_end_minute', settings.endMinute);
    await prefs.setStringList(
      'sms_days',
      settings.daysOfWeek.map((e) => e.toString()).toList(),
    );
  }

  Future<void> addPhone(SmsPhone phone) async {
    final updated = [...state.phones, phone];
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }

  Future<void> removePhone(String phone) async {
    final updated = state.phones.where((p) => p.phone != phone).toList();
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }

  Future<void> updatePhone(String oldPhone, SmsPhone newPhone) async {
    final updated = state.phones.map((p) {
      return p.phone == oldPhone ? newPhone : p;
    }).toList();
    await update(state.copyWith(phones: updated));
  }
}

/// Провайдер темы на Riverpod.
/// Управляет переключением темы: День → Ночь → Авто → День.
/// Сохраняет выбор в SharedPreferences.
library;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

final themeProvider = StateNotifierProvider<ThemeNotifier, ThemeMode>((ref) {
  return ThemeNotifier();
});

class ThemeNotifier extends StateNotifier<ThemeMode> {
  static const _key = 'theme_mode';

  ThemeNotifier() : super(ThemeMode.system) {
    _loadTheme();
  }

  Future<void> _loadTheme() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final value = prefs.getString(_key) ?? 'system';
    state = _parseTheme(value);
  }

  /// Переключает: День → Ночь → Авто → День...
  Future<void> toggle() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final auto = prefs.getBool('auto_theme') ?? false;

    if (auto) {
      // Авто → Ночь
      state = ThemeMode.dark;
      await prefs.setString(_key, 'dark');
      await prefs.setBool('auto_theme', false);
    } else if (state == ThemeMode.dark) {
      // Ночь → День
      state = ThemeMode.light;
      await prefs.setString(_key, 'light');
    } else {
      // День → Авто
      state = ThemeMode.system; // ← system = авто
      await prefs.setString(_key, 'system');
      await prefs.setBool('auto_theme', true);
    }
    await updateAutoCache();
  }

  Future<void> setDark() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final auto = prefs.getBool('auto_theme') ?? false;
    if (!auto) return; // только в авто-режиме
    state = ThemeMode.dark;
    await prefs.setString(_key, 'dark');
  }

  Future<void> setLight() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final auto = prefs.getBool('auto_theme') ?? false;
    if (!auto) return;
    state = ThemeMode.light;
    await prefs.setString(_key, 'light');
  }

  ThemeMode _parseTheme(String value) {
    switch (value) {
      case 'light': return ThemeMode.light;
      case 'dark': return ThemeMode.dark;
      default: return ThemeMode.system;
    }
  }

  String get themeName {
    if (_isAuto) return 'Авто';
    switch (state) {
      case ThemeMode.dark: return 'Ночь';
      case ThemeMode.light: return 'День';
      default: return 'Ночь';
    }
  }

  IconData get themeIcon {
    if (_isAuto) return Icons.brightness_auto;
    switch (state) {
      case ThemeMode.dark: return Icons.nightlight_round;
      case ThemeMode.light: return Icons.wb_sunny;
      default: return Icons.nightlight_round;
    }
  }

  /// Синхронно проверяет авто (костыль, но работает)
  bool get _isAuto {
    // Не можем использовать await в геттере, поэтому синхронно читаем SharedPreferences
    // Используем static переменную как кеш
    return _autoCache;
  }

  static bool _autoCache = false;

  static Future<void> updateAutoCache() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _autoCache = prefs.getBool('auto_theme') ?? false;
  }
}

/// Riverpod-провайдер для Zigbee-устройств.
library;

import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../domain/models/zigbee_device.dart';
import '../../data/services/zigbee_bridge.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';

/// Список всех Zigbee-устройств из Z2M.
final zigbeeDevicesProvider =
StateNotifierProvider<ZigbeeDevicesNotifier, List<ZigbeeDevice>>((ref) {
  return ZigbeeDevicesNotifier();
});

/// Флаг: открыта ли сеть для сопряжения.
final zigbeePermitJoinProvider = StateProvider<bool>((ref) => false);

/// Таймер обратного отсчёта сопряжения (секунды).
final zigbeePermitJoinTimerProvider = StateProvider<int>((ref) => 0);

class ZigbeeDevicesNotifier extends StateNotifier<List<ZigbeeDevice>> {
  final ZigbeeBridge _bridge = getIt<ZigbeeBridge>();

  ZigbeeDevicesNotifier() : super([]) {
    _bridge.onDevicesList = (devices) {
      state = devices.where((d) => !d.isCoordinator).toList();
    };

    if (_bridge.lastDevices.isNotEmpty) {
      state = _bridge.lastDevices.where((d) => !d.isCoordinator).toList();
    }
  }

  ZigbeeDevice? findByName(String friendlyName) {
    try {
      return state.firstWhere((d) => d.friendlyName == friendlyName);
    } catch (_) {
      return null;
    }
  }
}

  static Future<Database> _initDB() async {
    final dbPath = await getDatabasesPath();
    final path = join(dbPath, 'shome.db');

    return await openDatabase(
      path,
      version: 12,
      onCreate: (db, version) async {
        // ─── существующие таблицы ───

        ''');

            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

            command TEXT NOT NULL,
            executeAt TEXT NOT NULL,
            executed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL

            deviceName TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,

  // ============ Energy Log ============

  static Future<void> upsertEnergyLog({
    required String deviceId,
    required String deviceName,
    required double power,
    required double voltage,
    required double current,
    required double energyIncrement,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final today = DateTime.now().toIso8601String().substring(0, 10);
    final existing = await db.query('energy_log', where: 'deviceId = ? AND date = ?', whereArgs: [deviceId, today]);
    if (existing.isNotEmpty) {
      final row = existing.first;
      final newTotal = (row['totalEnergy'] as num).toDouble() + energyIncrement;
      await db.update('energy_log', {
        'totalEnergy': newTotal,
        'power': power,
        'voltage': voltage,
        'current': current,
      }, where: 'deviceId = ? AND date = ?', whereArgs: [deviceId, today]);
    } else {
      await db.insert('energy_log', {
        'deviceId': deviceId,
        'deviceName': deviceName,
        'date': today,
        'totalEnergy': energyIncrement,
        'power': power,
        'voltage': voltage,
        'current': current,
      });
    }
  }

  static Future<void> insertSensorLog({
    required String deviceId,
    required String deviceName,
    required String timestamp,
    double? temperature,
    double? humidity,
    double? power,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.insert('sensor_log', {
      'deviceId': deviceId,
      'deviceName': deviceName,
      'timestamp': timestamp,
      'temperature': temperature,
      'humidity': humidity,
      'power': power,
    });
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getSensorData({
    String? deviceId,
    int days = 7,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final cutoff = DateTime.now().subtract(Duration(days: days)).toIso8601String();
    String where;
    List<dynamic> whereArgs;
    if (deviceId != null) {
      where = 'deviceId = ? AND timestamp >= ?';
      whereArgs = [deviceId, cutoff];
    } else {
      where = 'timestamp >= ?';
      whereArgs = [cutoff];
    }
    return db.query('sensor_log', where: where, whereArgs: whereArgs, orderBy: 'timestamp ASC');
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> getEnergyStats({int days = 7}) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.query('energy_log', orderBy: 'date DESC', limit: days);
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // STATS — device_stats_daily
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  static Future<void> upsertDeviceStat({
    required String deviceId,
    required String date,
    int online = 0,
    int offline = 0,
    int alert = 0,
    int action = 0,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.rawInsert('''
      INSERT INTO device_stats_daily
        (device_id, date, online_count, offline_count, alert_count, action_count)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(device_id, date) DO UPDATE SET
        online_count  = online_count  + excluded.online_count,
        offline_count = offline_count + excluded.offline_count,
        alert_count   = alert_count   + excluded.alert_count,
        action_count  = action_count  + excluded.action_count
    ''', [deviceId, date, online, offline, alert, action]);
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> getDeviceUptime({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT device_id,
        SUM(online_count)  AS online,
        SUM(offline_count) AS offline,
        SUM(alert_count)   AS alerts,
        SUM(action_count)  AS actions,
        CASE WHEN SUM(online_count)+SUM(offline_count)=0 THEN NULL
             ELSE 1.0*SUM(online_count)/(SUM(online_count)+SUM(offline_count))
        END AS uptime_ratio
      FROM device_stats_daily
      WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?
      GROUP BY device_id
      ORDER BY uptime_ratio ASC
    ''', [fromDate, toDate]);
  }

  static Future<Map<String, int>> getStatsTotals({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final r = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(online_count),0)  AS online,
        COALESCE(SUM(offline_count),0) AS offline,
        COALESCE(SUM(alert_count),0)   AS alerts,
        COALESCE(SUM(action_count),0)  AS actions
      FROM device_stats_daily WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?
    ''', [fromDate, toDate]);
    final m = r.first;
    return {
      'online': (m['online'] as num).toInt(),
      'offline': (m['offline'] as num).toInt(),
      'alerts': (m['alerts'] as num).toInt(),
      'actions': (m['actions'] as num).toInt(),
    };
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> getDeviceDailySeries({
    required String deviceId,
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT date, online_count, offline_count, alert_count, action_count
      FROM device_stats_daily
      WHERE device_id = ? AND date BETWEEN ? AND ?
      ORDER BY date ASC
    ''', [deviceId, fromDate, toDate]);
  }

  static Future<Map<String, int>> getFrigateDetectionsByLabel({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT event, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM events
      WHERE event LIKE 'frigate_%'
        AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
      GROUP BY event
    ''', [fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
    final result = <String, int>{};
    for (final r in rows) {
      final label = (r['event'] as String).replaceFirst('frigate_', '');
      result[label] = (r['cnt'] as num).toInt();
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Future<Map<String, int>> getFrigateDetectionsByCamera({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT deviceName, COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM events
      WHERE event LIKE 'frigate_%'
        AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
        AND deviceName IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY deviceName
    ''', [fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
    final result = <String, int>{};
    for (final r in rows) {
      result[r['deviceName'] as String] = (r['cnt'] as num).toInt();
    }
    return result;
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> getFrigateHourlyHeatmap({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        substr(timestamp, 1, 10) AS date,
        CAST(substr(timestamp, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) AS hour,
        COUNT(*) AS count
      FROM events
      WHERE event LIKE 'frigate_%'
        AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
      GROUP BY date, hour
      ORDER BY date ASC, hour ASC
    ''', [fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
  }

  static Future<List<String>> getForgottenScenes({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final rows = await db.rawQuery('''

        WHERE event = 'scene' AND sceneName IS NOT NULL
          AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?

      ORDER BY name ASC
    ''', [fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
    return rows.map((r) => r['name'] as String).toList();

  static Future<Map<String, int>> getPresenceTotals({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    final r = await db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(home_sec), 0)    AS home,
        COALESCE(SUM(near_sec), 0)    AS near,
        COALESCE(SUM(away_sec), 0)    AS away,
        COALESCE(SUM(unknown_sec), 0) AS unknown,
        COALESCE(SUM(cloud_fallback_count), 0) AS cloud
      FROM presence_daily
      WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?
    ''', [fromDate, toDate]);
    final m = r.first;
    return {
      'home': (m['home'] as num).toInt(),
      'near': (m['near'] as num).toInt(),
      'away': (m['away'] as num).toInt(),
      'unknown': (m['unknown'] as num).toInt(),
      'cloud': (m['cloud'] as num).toInt(),
    };
  }

    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''

      FROM presence_daily
      WHERE date BETWEEN ? AND ?
      ORDER BY date ASC
    ''', [fromDate, toDate]);
  }

  static Future<void> addPresenceSeconds({
    required String date,
    required String state,
    required int seconds,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    // защита от SQL-инъекции: state — только из известного набора
    const allowed = {'home', 'near', 'away', 'unknown'};
    if (!allowed.contains(state)) return;
    final column = '${state}_sec';
    await db.rawInsert('''
      INSERT INTO presence_daily (date, $column)
      VALUES (?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(date) DO UPDATE SET $column = $column + excluded.$column
    ''', [date, seconds]);
  }

  static Future<void> incrementCloudFallback(String date) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.rawInsert('''
      INSERT INTO presence_daily (date, cloud_fallback_count)
      VALUES (?, 1)
      ON CONFLICT(date) DO UPDATE SET cloud_fallback_count = cloud_fallback_count + 1
    ''', [date]);
  }

  // STATS: Климат (из sensor_log)
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  static Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> getClimateStats({
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT deviceId, deviceName,
        MIN(temperature) AS t_min,
        MAX(temperature) AS t_max,
        AVG(temperature) AS t_avg,
        MIN(humidity) AS h_min,
        MAX(humidity) AS h_max,
        AVG(humidity) AS h_avg,
        COUNT(*) AS samples
      FROM sensor_log
      WHERE timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
        AND (temperature IS NOT NULL OR humidity IS NOT NULL)
      GROUP BY deviceId
      ORDER BY deviceName ASC
    ''', [fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
  }

  static Future<List<Map<String, Object?>>> getClimateTrend({
    required String deviceId,
    required String fromDate,
    required String toDate,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    return db.rawQuery('''
      SELECT timestamp, temperature, humidity
      FROM sensor_log
      WHERE deviceId = ? AND timestamp >= ? AND timestamp < ?
        AND (temperature IS NOT NULL OR humidity IS NOT NULL)
      ORDER BY timestamp ASC
    ''', [deviceId, fromDate, '$toDate 23:59:59']);
  }

    required String date,
    required String channel,
    required String category,
  }) async {
    final db = await database;
    await db.rawInsert('''
      INSERT INTO notification_stats_daily
        (date, channel, category, suppressed_by_cooldown)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)
      ON CONFLICT(date, channel, category) DO UPDATE SET
        suppressed_by_cooldown = suppressed_by_cooldown + 1
    ''', [date, channel, category]);
  }

  /// Топ категорий по отправкам.

    required String fromDate,

    ''', [fromDate, toDate]);
  }
