/// Главный экран со списком устройств в виде адаптивной сетки.
/// Поддерживает фильтрацию по комнатам через RoomSelector.
/// AppBar: название слева, время + погода по центру, шестерёнка справа.
library;
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../widgets/device_card.dart';
import '../widgets/room_selector.dart';
import '../../data/services/adaptive_poller.dart';
import 'package:talker/talker.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../data/protocols/tuya_protocol.dart';
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert';
import '../widgets/edge_handle.dart';
import '../widgets/today_drawer.dart';
import '../../application/state/current_room_provider.dart';
import 'package:reorderable_grid_view/reorderable_grid_view.dart';
import '../../application/onboarding_manager.dart';
import '../widgets/frigate_camera_card.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
class DeviceListScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const DeviceListScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<DeviceListScreen> createState() => _DeviceListScreenState();
}

class _DeviceListScreenState extends ConsumerState<DeviceListScreen> {
  String _selectedRoomId = 'all';
  DeviceType _selectedType = DeviceType.outlet;
  AdaptivePoller? _poller;
  final GlobalKey<ScaffoldState> _scaffoldKey = GlobalKey<ScaffoldState>();

  void _onRoomSelected(String roomId) {
    setState(() => _selectedRoomId = roomId);
    final effective = roomId == 'all' ? null : roomId;
    // обновляем глобальный провайдер (для TodayDrawer)
    ref.read(currentRoomIdProvider.notifier).state = effective;
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _initPoller();
    _checkOnboarding();
  }

  Future<void> _checkOnboarding() async {
    final isComplete = await OnboardingManager.isOnboardingComplete();
    if (!isComplete && mounted) {
      context.go('/onboarding');
    }
  }

  Future<void> _initPoller() async {
    final ms = await AdaptivePoller.readIntervalMs();
    final interval = Duration(milliseconds: ms);

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _poller = AdaptivePoller(
        getIt<TuyaProtocol>(),
        getIt<Talker>(),
            (deviceId, isOn) {
          if (mounted) ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceState(deviceId, isOn);
        },
            (deviceId, isOnline) {
          if (mounted) ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateOnlineState(deviceId, isOnline);
        },
            (deviceId, states) {
          if (mounted) ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceStates(deviceId, states);
        },
        onSensorUpdate: (deviceId, properties) {
          if (mounted) ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceProperties(deviceId, properties);
        },
        normalInterval: interval,
      );
      _poller!.start();
      ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).onCommandSent = (deviceId) {
        _poller?.forceReset(deviceId);
      };
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final allDevices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);
    _poller?.updateDevices(allDevices); // ← обновляем список устройств

    final devices = _selectedRoomId == 'all'
        ? allDevices
        : allDevices.where((d) => d.roomId == _selectedRoomId).toList();

    return Scaffold(
      key: _scaffoldKey,
      endDrawer: const TodayDrawer(),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Row(
          children: [
            Text('SHome', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            Spacer(),
            _TimeWeatherWidget(),
            Spacer(),
            SizedBox(width: 48), // компенсация иконки справа для центрирования
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.settings),
            onPressed: () => context.push('/menu'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          Column(
            children: [
              RoomSelector(
                selectedRoomId: _selectedRoomId,
                onRoomSelected: (room) => _onRoomSelected(room.id),
              ),
              const Divider(),
              Expanded(
                child: devices.isEmpty
                    ? Center(
                  child: Column(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.devices, size: 80, color: Colors.grey),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    Text(
                      l10n.noDevices,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 20, color: Colors.grey),
                    ),
                  ],
                  ),
                )
                    : LayoutBuilder(
                  builder: (context, constraints) {
                    final width = constraints.maxWidth;
                    final crossAxisCount = width > 900 ? 5 : (width > 600 ? 4 : (width > 400 ? 3 : 2));

                    return ReorderableGridView.count(
                      crossAxisCount: crossAxisCount,
                      mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                      crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                      childAspectRatio: 0.85,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      children: devices.map((device) {
                        // 🎥 Frigate-камера — своя карточка
                        if (device.type == DeviceType.camera &&
                            device.properties['source'] == 'frigate') {
                          return RepaintBoundary(
                            key: ValueKey(device.id),
                            child: FrigateCameraCard(device: device),
                          );
                        }

                        // Остальные устройства (Tuya, Zigbee)
                        return RepaintBoundary(
                          key: ValueKey(device.id),
                          child: DeviceCard(device: device),
                        );
                      }).toList(),
                      onReorder: (oldIndex, newIndex) {
                        ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).reorderDevices(oldIndex, newIndex);
                      },
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          EdgeHandle(
            onOpen: () => _scaffoldKey.currentState?.openEndDrawer(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: _showAddDeviceDialog,
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddDeviceDialog() {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final nameController = TextEditingController();
    final deviceIdController = TextEditingController();
    final addressController = TextEditingController();
    final localKeyController = TextEditingController();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          // 'Добавить устройство'
          title: Text(l10n.addDeviceTitle),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                // 'Название'
                TextField(controller: nameController, decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.deviceName)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                DropdownButtonFormField<DeviceType>(
                  initialValue: _selectedType,
                  // 'Тип устройства'
                  decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.deviceType, prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.category)),
                  items: [
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.outlet, child: Text(l10n.outlet),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.switch1, child: Text(l10n.switchOne),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.switch2, child: Text(l10n.switchTwo),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.switch3, child: Text(l10n.switchThree),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.sensor, child: Text(l10n.sensor),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.light, child: Text(l10n.light),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.curtain, child: Text(l10n.curtain),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.hvac, child: Text(l10n.airConditioner),),
                    DropdownMenuItem(value: DeviceType.compound, child: Text(l10n.universalDevice),),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) => setDialogState(() => _selectedType = value ?? DeviceType.outlet),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(controller: deviceIdController, decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.deviceId)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(controller: addressController, decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.ipAddressLabel)),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(controller: localKeyController, decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.localKey)),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            // 'Отмена'
            TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context), child: Text(l10n.cancel)),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                if (nameController.text.isNotEmpty && deviceIdController.text.isNotEmpty) {
                  final device = Device(
                    id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
                    name: nameController.text,
                    type: _selectedType,
                    roomId: _selectedRoomId == 'all' ? 'living' : _selectedRoomId,
                    isOnline: false,
                    state: DeviceState.offline,
                    deviceId: deviceIdController.text,
                    localKey: localKeyController.text,
                    address: addressController.text,
                    version: 3.5,
                    properties: _getDefaultProperties(_selectedType),
                  );
                  ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).addDevice(device);
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                }
              },
              // 'Добавить'
              child: Text(l10n.add),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _getDefaultProperties(DeviceType type) {
    return DevicesNotifier.defaultProperties(type);
  }
}

/// Виджет времени и погоды для AppBar.
/// Обновляет время каждую минуту, погоду — каждые 30 минут.
class _TimeWeatherWidget extends StatefulWidget {
  const _TimeWeatherWidget();

  @override
  State<_TimeWeatherWidget> createState() => _TimeWeatherWidgetState();
}

class _TimeWeatherWidgetState extends State<_TimeWeatherWidget> {
  late DateTime _now;
  String _temperature = '--°';
  String _weatherIcon = '☀️';
  Timer? _timer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _now = DateTime.now();
    _updateTime();
    _fetchWeather();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _updateTime() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _now = DateTime.now());
    _timer = Timer(const Duration(minutes: 1), _updateTime);
  }

  Future<void> _fetchWeather() async {
    try {
      final url = Uri.parse('https://wttr.in/54.53,36.27?format=%t|%C&lang=en');
      final response = await http.get(url);

      if (response.statusCode == 200) {
        final parts = response.body.split('|');
        if (parts.length == 2) {
          final tempStr = parts[0].trim().replaceAll('+', '').replaceAll('°C', '');
          final emoji = _weatherEmoji(parts[1].trim());

          if (!mounted) return;
          setState(() {
            _temperature = '$tempStr°';
            _weatherIcon = emoji;
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Weather fetch error: $e');
    }

    if (mounted) {
      Future.delayed(const Duration(minutes: 30), _fetchWeather);
    }
  }

  String _weatherEmoji(String condition) {
    if (condition.contains('Sunny') || condition.contains('Clear')) return '☀️';
    if (condition.contains('cloud')) return '☁️';
    if (condition.contains('rain') || condition.contains('drizzle')) return '🌧️';
    if (condition.contains('snow')) return '❄️';
    if (condition.contains('thunder')) return '⛈️';
    if (condition.contains('fog') || condition.contains('mist')) return '🌫️';
    return '🌡️';
  }

  void _showForecast(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        // '🌤️ Прогноз погоды'
        title: Text('🌤️ ${l10n.forecastTitle}'),
        content: FutureBuilder(
          future: _fetchForecast(),
          builder: (context, snapshot) {
            if (!snapshot.hasData) {
              return const SizedBox(
                height: 100,
                child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
              );
            }
            final days = snapshot.data as List<Map<String, String>>;
            return SizedBox(
              width: double.maxFinite,
              height: 250,  // фиксированная высота для скролла
              child: ListView.builder(
                itemCount: days.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  final day = days[index];
                  return ListTile(
                    leading: Text(day['icon']!, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 24)),
                    title: Text(day['date']!),
                    trailing: Text(day['temp']!, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                  );
                },
              ),
            );
          },
        ),
        actions: [TextButton(onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx), child: Text(l10n.ok)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<List<Map<String, String>>> _fetchForecast() async {
    final url = Uri.parse('https://wttr.in/Kaluga,Russia?format=j1&lang=ru');
    final response = await http.get(url);

    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      final data = jsonDecode(response.body);
      final days = <Map<String, String>>[];

      for (final day in data['weather'] ?? []) {
        final date = day['date'] as String;
        final maxTemp = day['maxtempC']?.toString() ?? '--';
        final minTemp = day['mintempC']?.toString() ?? '--';
        final emoji = _weatherEmoji(day['hourly']?[4]?['weatherDesc']?[0]?['value'] ?? '');

        days.add({
          'date': date,
          'temp': '$minTemp° / $maxTemp°',
          'icon': emoji,
        });
      }
      return days;
    }
    return [];
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final timeStr = '${_now.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:${_now.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () => _showForecast(context),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        children: [
          Text(timeStr, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Text(_weatherIcon, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          Text(_temperature, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Экран уведомлений для конкретного устройства.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class DeviceNotificationsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const DeviceNotificationsScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.deviceId,
  });

  final String deviceId;

  @override
  ConsumerState<DeviceNotificationsScreen> createState() =>
      _DeviceNotificationsScreenState();
}

class _DeviceNotificationsScreenState
    extends ConsumerState<DeviceNotificationsScreen> {
  static const _zigbeeTypes = [
    'water_leak',
    'smoke',
    'gas',
    'motion',
    'contact',
    'low_battery',
  ];

  static const _frigateLabels = [
    'person',
    'car',
    'dog',
    'cat',
    'bird',
    'motorcycle',
    'bicycle',
    'truck',
    'bus',
    'boat',
  ];

  static const _tuyaTypesByDeviceType = {
    DeviceType.outlet: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.switch1: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.switch2: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.switch3: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.light: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.hvac: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.curtain: ['state_changed', 'offline', 'error'],
    DeviceType.sensor: [
      'temperature_above',
      'temperature_below',
      'humidity_above',
      'humidity_below',
      'power_above',
      'offline',
      'error',
    ],
    DeviceType.compound: [
      'state_changed',
      'offline',
      'error',
      'low_battery',
    ],
  };

  String _condition = 'always';
  int _cooldown = 1;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  void _load() {
    final device = _getDevice();
    _condition =
        device?.properties['notify_condition'] as String? ?? 'always';
    _cooldown =
        device?.properties['notify_cooldown_min'] as int? ?? 1;
  }

  Device? _getDevice() {
    final devices = ref.read(devicesProvider);
    return devices.where((device) => device.id == widget.deviceId).firstOrNull;
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return;

    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {
        ...device.properties,
        'notify_condition': _condition,
        'notify_cooldown_min': _cooldown,
      },
    );

    await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(updated);

    if (!mounted) return;

    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(l10n.notificationSettingsSaved),
        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
      ),
    );

    Navigator.pop(context);
  }

  void _toggleType(String type, bool enabled) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return;

    final current =
        (device.properties['notify_types'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ?? [];
    final updated = List<String>.from(current);

    if (enabled) {
      if (!updated.contains(type)) updated.add(type);
    } else {
      updated.remove(type);
    }

    final updatedDevice = device.copyWith(
      properties: {
        ...device.properties,
        'notify_types': updated,
      },
    );

    ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceLocal(updatedDevice);
    setState(() {});
  }

  bool _isTypeEnabled(String type, List<String> defaults) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return false;

    final types =
    (device.properties['notify_types'] as List?)?.cast<String>();

    if (types == null) return defaults.contains(type);
    return types.contains(type);
  }

  void _toggleLabel(String label, bool enabled) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return;

    final current =
        (device.properties['notify_labels'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ??
            ['person'];
    final updated = List<String>.from(current);

    if (enabled) {
      if (!updated.contains(label)) updated.add(label);
    } else {
      updated.remove(label);
    }

    final updatedDevice = device.copyWith(
      properties: {
        ...device.properties,
        'notify_labels': updated,
      },
    );

    ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceLocal(updatedDevice);
    setState(() {});
  }

  bool _isLabelEnabled(String label) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return false;

    final labels =
        (device.properties['notify_labels'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ??
            ['person'];

    return labels.contains(label);
  }

  void _setThreshold(String key, double? value) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return;

    final updatedProperties = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties);

    if (value == null) {
      updatedProperties.remove(key);
    } else {
      updatedProperties[key] = value;
    }

    final updatedDevice = device.copyWith(properties: updatedProperties);
    ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceLocal(updatedDevice);
    setState(() {});
  }

  double? _getThreshold(String key) {
    final device = _getDevice();
    if (device == null) return null;

    return (device.properties[key] as num?)?.toDouble();
  }

  String _labelEmoji(String label) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'person':
        return '🚶';
      case 'car':
        return '🚗';
      case 'dog':
        return '🐕';
      case 'cat':
        return '🐱';
      case 'bird':
        return '🐦';
      case 'motorcycle':
        return '🏍️';
      case 'bicycle':
        return '🚲';
      case 'truck':
        return '🚚';
      case 'bus':
        return '🚌';
      case 'boat':
        return '⛵';
      case 'water_leak':
        return '💧';
      case 'smoke':
        return '🔥';
      case 'gas':
        return '💨';
      case 'motion':
        return '🏃';
      case 'contact':
        return '🚪';
      case 'low_battery':
        return '🔋';
      default:
        return '📦';
    }
  }

  String _typeLabel(String type, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'water_leak':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationWaterLeak}';
      case 'smoke':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationSmoke}';
      case 'gas':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationGas}';
      case 'motion':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationMotion}';
      case 'contact':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationContact}';
      case 'low_battery':
        return '${_labelEmoji(type)} ${l10n.notificationLowBattery}';
      case 'state_changed':
        return '🔄 ${l10n.notificationStateChanged}';
      case 'offline':
        return '📡 ${l10n.notificationOffline}';
      case 'error':
        return '❌ ${l10n.notificationError}';
      case 'temperature_above':
        return '🌡️ ${l10n.notificationTemperatureAbove}';
      case 'temperature_below':
        return '🌡️ ${l10n.notificationTemperatureBelow}';
      case 'humidity_above':
        return '💧 ${l10n.notificationHumidityAbove}';
      case 'humidity_below':
        return '💧 ${l10n.notificationHumidityBelow}';
      case 'power_above':
        return '⚡ ${l10n.notificationPowerAbove}';
      default:
        return type;
    }
  }

  String _frigateLabel(String label, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'person':
        return l10n.notificationPerson;
      case 'car':
        return l10n.notificationCar;
      case 'dog':
        return l10n.notificationDog;
      case 'cat':
        return l10n.notificationCat;
      case 'bird':
        return l10n.notificationBird;
      case 'motorcycle':
        return l10n.notificationMotorcycle;
      case 'bicycle':
        return l10n.notificationBicycle;
      case 'truck':
        return l10n.notificationTruck;
      case 'bus':
        return l10n.notificationBus;
      case 'boat':
        return l10n.notificationBoat;
      default:
        return label;
    }
  }

  String _conditionLabel(String condition, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (condition) {
      case 'always':
        return l10n.notificationConditionAlways;
      case 'away':
        return l10n.notificationConditionAway;
      case 'night':
        return l10n.notificationConditionNight;
      case 'away_or_night':
        return l10n.notificationConditionAwayOrNight;
      default:
        return l10n.notificationConditionAlways;
    }
  }

  String _thresholdLabel(String type, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    if (type.contains('temperature')) {
      return l10n.notificationTemperatureThreshold;
    }
    if (type.contains('humidity')) {
      return l10n.notificationHumidityThreshold;
    }
    if (type.contains('power')) {
      return l10n.notificationPowerThreshold;
    }
    return l10n.notificationThreshold;
  }

  String _thresholdHint(String type) {
    if (type.contains('temperature')) return '30';
    if (type.contains('humidity')) return '80';
    if (type.contains('power')) return '1000';
    return '';
  }

  String _thresholdUnit(String type) {
    if (type.contains('temperature')) return '°C';
    if (type.contains('humidity')) return '%';
    if (type.contains('power')) return 'W';
    return '';
  }

  @override

  Widget _buildThresholdField(
      String type,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final key = 'threshold_$type';
    final current = _getThreshold(key);

    return TextFormField(
      initialValue: current?.toStringAsFixed(1) ?? '',
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: _thresholdLabel(type, l10n),
        hintText: _thresholdHint(type),
        suffixText: _thresholdUnit(type),
        border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        isDense: true,
      ),
      keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
      onChanged: (value) {
        final parsed = double.tryParse(value);
        _setThreshold(key, parsed);
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _buildBatteryThresholdField(AppLocalizations l10n) {
    const key = 'threshold_battery_low';
    final current = _getThreshold(key) ?? 20;

    return TextFormField(
      initialValue: current.toStringAsFixed(0),
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        labelText: l10n.notificationBatteryThreshold,
        hintText: '20',
        suffixText: '%',
        border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
        isDense: true,
      ),
      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
      onChanged: (value) {
        final parsed = double.tryParse(value);
        _setThreshold(key, parsed);
      },
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

import 'package:shome/l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class ChangelogScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const ChangelogScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.changelogTitle),
        backgroundColor: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.inversePrimary,
      ),
      body: FutureBuilder<String>(
        future: rootBundle.loadString('CHANGELOG.md'),
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            return const Center(
              child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
            );
          }

          if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return Center(
              child: Text(l10n.changelogLoadError),
            );
          }

          return SingleChildScrollView(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Text(
              snapshot.data ?? '',
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 14,
                height: 1.5,
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

          _buildDocumentTile(
            context,
            icon: Icons.copyright,
            title: l10n.legalOpenSourceTitle,
            subtitle: l10n.legalOpenSourceSubtitle,
            onTap: () => showLicensePage(
              context: context,
              applicationName: LegalDocuments.appName,
              applicationVersion: LegalDocuments.fullVersion,
              applicationLegalese: LegalDocuments.copyright,
            ),
          ),
          _buildDocumentTile(
            context,
            icon: Icons.history,
            title: l10n.legalChangelogTitle,
            subtitle: l10n.legalChangelogSubtitle,
            onTap: () => Navigator.push(
              context,
              MaterialPageRoute<void>(
                builder: (_) => const ChangelogScreen(),
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Center(
            child: Text(
              '${LegalDocuments.copyright}\n'
                  '${LegalDocuments.developer}\n'
                  '${l10n.legalVersionFooter(LegalDocuments.fullVersion)}',
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                color: Colors.grey[600],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDocumentTile(
      BuildContext context, {
        required IconData icon,
        required String title,
        required String subtitle,
        required VoidCallback onTap,
      }) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 4),
      child: ListTile(
        leading: Icon(
          icon,
          color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary,
        ),
        title: Text(title),
        subtitle: Text(subtitle),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
        onTap: onTap,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Экран энергомониторинга (заготовка).
/// Отображает DPS-данные устройств: мощность, напряжение, ток, потребление.
/// Обновляется каждые 5 секунд.
/// В будущем будет заменён на графики из energy_log.
library;
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';

class EnergyScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EnergyScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<EnergyScreen> createState() => _EnergyScreenState();
}

class _EnergyScreenState extends ConsumerState<EnergyScreen> {
  /// Таймер периодического опроса DPS
  Timer? _timer;
  /// Кэш DPS-данных по устройствам
  final Map<String, Map<String, dynamic>> _deviceDps = {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _startPolling();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Запускает периодический опрос DPS каждые 5 секунд.
  void _startPolling() {
    _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 5), (_) => _updateDps());
    _updateDps();
  }

  /// Запрашивает DPS для всех устройств.
  Future<void> _updateDps() async {
    final devices = ref.read(devicesProvider)
        .where((d) => d.type == DeviceType.sensor && d.properties['sensorType'] == 'power')
        .toList();
    for (final device in devices) {
      if (device.deviceId != null) {
        final dps = await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).getDeviceDps(device.id);
        if (dps != null && mounted) {
          setState(() => _deviceDps[device.id] = dps);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final allDevices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);
    final devices = allDevices
        .where((d) => d.type == DeviceType.sensor && d.properties['sensorType'] == 'power')
        .toList();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Энергомониторинг')),
      body: devices.isEmpty
          ? const Center(child: Text('Нет устройств'))
          : ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: devices.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final device = devices[index];
          final dps = _deviceDps[device.id];
          return _buildEnergyCard(device, dps);
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Карточка с энергоданными одного устройства.
  Widget _buildEnergyCard(Device device, Map<String, dynamic>? dps) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 16),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(device.name, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
            const Divider(),
            if (dps != null) ...[
              _buildDpsRow('Мощность',   '${dps['9']  ?? "—"} W'),
              _buildDpsRow('Напряжение', '${dps['10'] ?? "—"} V'),
              _buildDpsRow('Ток',        '${dps['11'] ?? "—"} mA'),
              _buildDpsRow('Потреблено', '${dps['12'] ?? "—"} kWh'),
            ] else
              const Text('Нет данных DPS', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Строка с одним показателем.
  Widget _buildDpsRow(String label, String value) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey)),
          Text(value, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 16)),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\presentation\screens\events_screen.dart =====
/// Экран журнала событий.
/// Читает из StatsCache (последние 200) + БД (старые, пагинация).
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../data/services/stats_cache.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

enum EventCategory { all, alerts, actions, errors }

enum _PresenceVisualState {
  away,
  homeCloud,
  homeWifi,
  home,
  unknown,
}

class EventsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const EventsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<EventsScreen> createState() => _EventsScreenState();
}

class _EventsScreenState extends ConsumerState<EventsScreen> {
  static const _pageSize = 50;

  List<dynamic> _cacheEvents = [];
  final List<dynamic> _dbEvents = [];

  int _dbOffset = 0;
  bool _loading = true;
  bool _loadingMore = false;
  bool _hasMoreDb = true;

  EventCategory _category = EventCategory.all;
  String? _selectedDeviceId;

  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    StatsCache.instance.addListener(_onCacheChanged);
    _scrollController.addListener(_onScroll);
    _loadInitial();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    StatsCache.instance.removeListener(_onCacheChanged);
    _scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  bool _isPresenceEvent(String event) {
    return event.startsWith('Присутствие:');
  }

  void _onCacheChanged() {
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _cacheEvents = StatsCache.instance.recentEvents.reversed.toList();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadInitial() async {
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _loading = true);
    }

    _cacheEvents = StatsCache.instance.recentEvents.reversed.toList();

    final exclude = _cacheEvents
        .map(
          (event) =>
      '${event.timestamp}|${event.event}|${event.deviceId ?? ''}',
    )
        .toSet();

    final dbEvents = await AppDatabase.getEventsPaginated(
      limit: _pageSize,
      offset: 0,
      excludeKeys: exclude,
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _dbEvents
        ..clear()
        ..addAll(dbEvents);
      _dbOffset = _pageSize;
      _hasMoreDb = dbEvents.length == _pageSize;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _loadMoreFromDb() async {
    if (_loadingMore || !_hasMoreDb) return;

    setState(() => _loadingMore = true);

    final exclude = _cacheEvents
        .map(
          (event) =>
      '${event.timestamp}|${event.event}|${event.deviceId ?? ''}',
    )
        .toSet();

    final more = await AppDatabase.getEventsPaginated(
      limit: _pageSize,
      offset: _dbOffset,
      excludeKeys: exclude,
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _dbEvents.addAll(more);
      _dbOffset += _pageSize;
      _hasMoreDb = more.length == _pageSize;
      _loadingMore = false;
    });
  }

  void _onScroll() {
    if (!_scrollController.hasClients) return;

    if (_scrollController.position.pixels >=
        _scrollController.position.maxScrollExtent - 200) {
      _loadMoreFromDb();
    }
  }

  List<dynamic> get _allEvents => [..._cacheEvents, ..._dbEvents];

  List<dynamic> get _filteredEvents {
    return _allEvents.where((eventEntity) {
      final event = eventEntity.event as String? ?? '';

      switch (_category) {
        case EventCategory.alerts:
          if (!event.startsWith('alarm_') &&
              !event.startsWith('frigate_')) {
            return false;
          }
          break;

        case EventCategory.actions:
          const actionEvents = {
            'turnOn',
            'turnOff',
            'scene',
            'roomAdded',
            'roomRemoved',
            'timer',
            'deviceAdded',
            'deviceRemoved',
            'sceneCreated',
            'sceneDeleted',
          };

          if (!actionEvents.contains(event) && !_isPresenceEvent(event)) {
            return false;
          }
          break;

        case EventCategory.errors:
          if (!{'offline', 'online', 'error'}.contains(event)) {
            return false;
          }
          break;

        case EventCategory.all:
          break;
      }

      if (_selectedDeviceId != null &&
          eventEntity.deviceId != _selectedDeviceId) {
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    }).toList();
  }

  String _presenceCurrentRaw(dynamic eventEntity) {
    final value = eventEntity.value?.toString().trim();

    if (value != null && value.isNotEmpty) {
      return value.split('→').last.trim();
    }

    final event = eventEntity.event?.toString() ?? '';
    final parts = event.split('→');

    if (parts.length > 1) {
      return parts.last.trim();
    }

    return event.replaceFirst('Присутствие:', '').trim();
  }

  _PresenceVisualState _presenceVisualState(dynamic eventEntity) {
    final current = _presenceCurrentRaw(eventEntity).toLowerCase();

    if (current.contains('ушёл') || current.contains('ушел')) {
      return _PresenceVisualState.away;
    }

    if (current.contains('дома')) {
      if (current.contains('облако')) {
        return _PresenceVisualState.homeCloud;
      }

      if (current.contains('heartbeat') ||
          current.contains('wi-fi') ||
          current.contains('wifi')) {
        return _PresenceVisualState.homeWifi;
      }

      return _PresenceVisualState.home;
    }

    return _PresenceVisualState.unknown;
  }

  String _presenceLabel(
      dynamic eventEntity,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    switch (_presenceVisualState(eventEntity)) {
      case _PresenceVisualState.away:
        return l10n.eventsPresenceAway;
      case _PresenceVisualState.homeCloud:
        return l10n.eventsPresenceHomeCloud;
      case _PresenceVisualState.homeWifi:
        return l10n.eventsPresenceHomeWifi;
      case _PresenceVisualState.home:
        return l10n.eventsPresenceHome;
      case _PresenceVisualState.unknown:
        return l10n.eventsPresenceUnknown;
    }
  }

  Color _presenceColor(dynamic eventEntity) {
    switch (_presenceVisualState(eventEntity)) {
      case _PresenceVisualState.away:
        return Colors.red;
      case _PresenceVisualState.homeCloud:
        return Colors.amber.shade800;
      case _PresenceVisualState.homeWifi:
      case _PresenceVisualState.home:
        return Colors.green;
      case _PresenceVisualState.unknown:
        return Colors.grey;
    }
  }

  IconData _eventIcon(String event) {
    if (_isPresenceEvent(event)) {
      return Icons.person_pin_circle;
    }

    switch (event) {
      case 'turnOn':
        return Icons.power_settings_new;
      case 'turnOff':
        return Icons.power_off;
      case 'scene':
        return Icons.movie;
      case 'roomAdded':
        return Icons.add_home;
      case 'roomRemoved':
        return Icons.remove_circle;
      case 'timer':
        return Icons.timer;
      case 'deviceAdded':
        return Icons.add_circle;
      case 'deviceRemoved':
        return Icons.delete;
      case 'sceneCreated':
        return Icons.movie_creation;
      case 'sceneDeleted':
        return Icons.movie_filter;
      case 'online':
        return Icons.wifi;
      case 'offline':
        return Icons.wifi_off;
      case 'error':
        return Icons.error;
    }

    if (event == 'alarm_water_leak') return Icons.water_drop;
    if (event == 'alarm_smoke') return Icons.local_fire_department;
    if (event == 'alarm_gas') return Icons.gas_meter;
    if (event == 'alarm_motion') return Icons.directions_run;

    if (event == 'alarm_contact_open' ||
        event == 'alarm_contact_closed') {
      return Icons.door_front_door;
    }

    if (event == 'alarm_temperature_above' ||
        event == 'alarm_temperature_below') {
      return Icons.thermostat;
    }

    if (event == 'alarm_humidity_above' ||
        event == 'alarm_humidity_below') {
      return Icons.water;
    }

    if (event == 'frigate_person') return Icons.person;
    if (event == 'frigate_car') return Icons.directions_car;
    if (event == 'frigate_dog' || event == 'frigate_cat') {
      return Icons.pets;
    }
    if (event == 'frigate_bird') return Icons.flutter_dash;
    if (event.startsWith('frigate_')) return Icons.videocam;

    return Icons.circle;
  }

  Color _eventColor(String event) {
    if (event.startsWith('alarm_') || event.startsWith('frigate_')) {
      return Colors.red;
    }
    if (event == 'offline') return Colors.grey;
    if (event == 'online') return Colors.green;
    if (event == 'error') return Colors.orange;
    if (event == 'turnOn') return Colors.green;
    if (event == 'turnOff') return Colors.red;
    if (event == 'scene') return Colors.purple;

    return Colors.blue;
  }

  String _eventLabel(String event, AppLocalizations l10n) {

    switch (event) {

                  initialValue: _selectedDeviceId,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: l10n.eventsDeviceFilter,
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.devices),
                    isDense: true,
                    border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: [
                    DropdownMenuItem<String?>(
                      value: null,
                      child: Text(l10n.eventsAllDevices),
                    ),
                    ...availableDevices.map(
                          (device) => DropdownMenuItem<String?>(
                        value: device.id,
                        child: Text(device.name),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() => _selectedDeviceId = value);
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          Expanded(
            child: filtered.isEmpty
                ? Center(
              child: Text(l10n.eventsEmptyFilter),
            )
                : ListView.builder(
              controller: _scrollController,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              itemCount:
              filtered.length + (_loadingMore ? 1 : 0),
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                if (index >= filtered.length) {
                  return const Padding(
                    padding: EdgeInsets.all(16),
                    child: Center(
                      child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
                    ),
                  );
                }

                final eventEntity = filtered[index];
                final timestamp =
                eventEntity.timestamp?.toString();

                if (timestamp == null) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                }

                final dateTime = DateTime.tryParse(timestamp);
                if (dateTime == null) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                }

                final dateStr =
                    '${dateTime.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}.'
                    '${dateTime.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}.'
                    '${dateTime.year}';

                final timeStr =
                    '${dateTime.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
                    '${dateTime.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
                    '${dateTime.second.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

                final eventType =
                    eventEntity.event as String? ?? '';
                final isPresence = _isPresenceEvent(eventType);
                final eventColor = isPresence
                    ? _presenceColor(eventEntity)
                    : _eventColor(eventType);

                final deviceName =
                eventEntity.deviceName?.toString();
                final sceneName =
                eventEntity.sceneName?.toString();

                final title = sceneName ??
                    (deviceName?.isNotEmpty == true
                        ? deviceName!
                        : eventType == 'error'
                        ? l10n.eventsSystemError
                        : isPresence
                        ? l10n.eventsPhone
                        : '');

                final details = eventEntity.value?.toString();
                final subtitle = isPresence
                    ? _presenceLabel(eventEntity, l10n)
                    : sceneName != null
                    ? l10n.eventsSceneCompleted
                    : eventType == 'error' &&
                    details != null &&
                    details.isNotEmpty
                    ? '${_eventLabel(eventType, l10n)}\n$details'
                    : _eventLabel(eventType, l10n);

                return Card(
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      _eventIcon(eventType),
                      color: eventColor,
                    ),
                    title: Text(
                      title,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      ),
                    ),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      subtitle,
                      maxLines: 2,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: eventColor,
                        fontSize: 13,
                        fontWeight: isPresence
                            ? FontWeight.w600
                            : FontWeight.normal,
                      ),
                    ),
                    trailing: Column(
                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.end,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          dateStr,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.grey,
                            fontSize: 11,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          timeStr,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.grey,
                            fontSize: 12,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCategoryChip(String label, EventCategory category) {
    return FilterChip(
      label: Text(label),
      selected: _category == category,
      onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _category = category),
    );
  }
}

  Future<void> _refresh() async {
    await ref.read(frigateCamerasProvider.notifier).refresh();

    final stats = await getIt<FrigateService>().getStats();
    ref.read(frigateStatsProvider.notifier).state = stats;

  String _getRoomDisplay(String roomId, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    final rooms = ref.read(roomsProvider);
    final room = rooms.where((item) => item.id == roomId).firstOrNull;

    if (room != null) {
      return '${room.icon ?? "🏠"} ${room.name}';
    }

    switch (roomId) {
      case 'other':
        return l10n.frigateRoomOther;
      case 'living':
        return l10n.frigateRoomLiving;
      case 'bedroom':
        return l10n.frigateRoomBedroom;
      case 'kitchen':
        return l10n.frigateRoomKitchen;
      default:
        return roomId;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addCamera(FrigateCamera camera) async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final devices = ref.read(devicesProvider);

    final alreadyExists = devices.any(
          (device) =>
      device.properties['source'] == 'frigate' &&
          device.properties['camera_name'] == camera.name,
    );

    if (alreadyExists) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(l10n.frigateCameraAlreadyAdded(camera.name)),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    final device = Device(
      id: 'frigate_${camera.name}',
      name: camera.name,
      type: DeviceType.camera,
      roomId: 'other',
      isOnline: true,
      state: DeviceState.online,
      deviceId: camera.name,
      properties: {
        'source': 'frigate',
        'camera_name': camera.name,
        'frigate_host': getIt<FrigateService>().host,
        'frigate_port': getIt<FrigateService>().port,
        'rtsp_port': 8554,
        'snapshot_interval': 5,
        'notify_labels': ['person', 'car'],
        'isDetecting': false,
      },
    );

    await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).addDevice(device);

    if (!mounted) return;

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(l10n.frigateCameraAdded(camera.name)),
        backgroundColor: Colors.green,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _removeDevice(Device device) async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.frigateDeleteCameraTitle),
        content: Text(l10n.frigateDeleteCameraMessage(device.name)),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
            child: Text(l10n.frigateCancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
            ),
            child: Text(l10n.frigateDelete),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).removeDevice(device.id);

    if (!mounted) return;

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(l10n.frigateCameraRemoved(device.name)),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showCameraSettings(Device device) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    FrigateCameraSettings.show(context, ref, device, l10n);
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';

import '../../application/state/frigate_provider.dart';
import '../../data/local/secure_storage/encrypted_keys.dart';
import '../../data/services/frigate_service.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class FrigateSettingsScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const FrigateSettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<FrigateSettingsScreen> createState() =>
      _FrigateSettingsScreenState();
}

class _FrigateSettingsScreenState
    extends ConsumerState<FrigateSettingsScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _hostController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _portController =
  TextEditingController(text: '5000');
  final TextEditingController _rtspPasswordController =
  TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _statsIntervalController =
  TextEditingController(text: '5');

  final Set<String> _notifyLabels = {'person', 'car'};

  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isSaving = false;
  bool? _isConnected;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSettings();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _hostController.dispose();
    _portController.dispose();
    _rtspPasswordController.dispose();
    _statsIntervalController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final keys = EncryptedKeys();

    final mqttHost = prefs.getString('mqtt_host') ?? '';
    final host = prefs.getString('frigate_host') ?? mqttHost;
    final port = prefs.getInt('frigate_port') ?? 5000;
    final rtspPassword = await keys.getFrigateRtspPassword() ?? '';
    final statsInterval = prefs.getInt('frigate_stats_interval') ?? 5;
    final notifyRaw =
        prefs.getStringList('frigate_notify_labels') ?? ['person', 'car'];

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _hostController.text = host;
      _portController.text = port.toString();
      _rtspPasswordController.text = rtspPassword;
      _statsIntervalController.text = statsInterval.toString();
      _notifyLabels
        ..clear()
        ..addAll(notifyRaw);
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    final host = _hostController.text.trim();
    final port = int.tryParse(_portController.text.trim()) ?? 5000;
    final statsInterval =
        int.tryParse(_statsIntervalController.text.trim()) ?? 5;

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString('frigate_host', host);
      await prefs.setInt('frigate_port', port);
      await prefs.setInt('frigate_stats_interval', statsInterval);
      await prefs.setStringList(
        'frigate_notify_labels',
        _notifyLabels.toList(),
      );

      final keys = EncryptedKeys();
      await keys.saveFrigateRtspPassword(_rtspPasswordController.text);

      final service = getIt<FrigateService>();
      service.configure(
        host: host,
        port: port,
        rtspPassword: _rtspPasswordController.text,
      );

      ref.read(frigateSettingsProvider.notifier).state = FrigateSettings(
        statsInterval: statsInterval,
        notifyLabels: _notifyLabels,
        rtspPassword: _rtspPasswordController.text,
      );

      await ref.read(frigateCamerasProvider.notifier).refresh();

      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() => _isSaving = false);
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(AppLocalizations.of(context).frigateSettingsSaved),
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted && _isSaving) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _testConnection() async {
    final host = _hostController.text.trim();
    final port = int.tryParse(_portController.text.trim()) ?? 5000;
    final service = getIt<FrigateService>();

    service.configure(host: host, port: port);

    final connected = await service.testConnection();
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _isConnected = connected);
  }

  String _labelText(String label, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (label) {
      case 'person':
        return l10n.frigateLabelPerson;
      case 'car':
        return l10n.frigateLabelCar;
      case 'dog':
        return l10n.frigateLabelDog;
      case 'cat':
        return l10n.frigateLabelCat;
      case 'motion':
        return l10n.frigateLabelMotion;
      default:
        return label;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.frigateSettingsTitle),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    l10n.frigateConnectionSection,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _hostController,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.frigateHostLabel,
                      hintText: l10n.frigateHostHint,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.dns),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _portController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.frigatePortLabel,
                      hintText: l10n.frigatePortHint,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.numbers),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _rtspPasswordController,
                    obscureText: true,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.frigateRtspPasswordLabel,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      ElevatedButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _testConnection,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.wifi),
                        label: Text(l10n.frigateTestConnection),
                      ),
                      if (_isConnected != null) ...[
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Icon(
                          _isConnected!
                              ? Icons.check_circle
                              : Icons.cancel,
                          color: _isConnected!
                              ? Colors.green
                              : Colors.red,
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 4),
                        Flexible(
                          child: Text(
                            _isConnected!
                                ? l10n.frigateConnectionSuccess
                                : l10n.frigateConnectionFailed,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    l10n.frigateSettingsSection,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _statsIntervalController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.frigateStatsIntervalLabel,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.timer),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Text(l10n.frigateNotifyFor),
                  ...['person', 'car', 'dog', 'cat', 'motion'].map((label) {

                      onChanged: (value) {
                        setState(() {
                          if (value == true) {
                            _notifyLabels.add(label);
                          } else {
                            _notifyLabels.remove(label);
                          }
                        });
                      },
                    );
                  }),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          SizedBox(

            child: ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: _isSaving ? null : _save,
              icon: _isSaving
                  ? const SizedBox(
                width: 16,
                height: 16,
                child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2),
              )
                  : const Icon(Icons.save),
              label: Text(
                _isSaving ? l10n.frigateSaving : l10n.frigateSave,
              ),
            ),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:shared_preferences/shared_preferences.dart';
import 'package:talker/talker.dart';

import '../../data/local/secure_storage/encrypted_keys.dart';
import '../../data/services/mqtt_service_impl.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class MqttBrokerSettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MqttBrokerSettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MqttBrokerSettingsScreen> createState() =>
      _MqttBrokerSettingsScreenState();
}

class _MqttBrokerSettingsScreenState
    extends State<MqttBrokerSettingsScreen> {
  final TextEditingController _hostController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _portController =
  TextEditingController(text: '1883');
  final TextEditingController _usernameController = TextEditingController();
  final TextEditingController _passwordController = TextEditingController();

  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _isConnecting = false;
  bool? _isConnected;
  String? _errorMessage;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSettings();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _hostController.dispose();
    _portController.dispose();
    _usernameController.dispose();
    _passwordController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    final keys = EncryptedKeys();

    final host = prefs.getString('mqtt_host') ?? '';

    // Порт может храниться как int или String.
    final portRaw = prefs.get('mqtt_port');
    final port = portRaw is int
        ? portRaw
        : int.tryParse(portRaw?.toString() ?? '') ?? 1883;

    final username = await keys.getMqttUsername() ?? '';
    final password = await keys.getMqttPassword() ?? '';

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _hostController.text = host;
      _portController.text = port.toString();
      _usernameController.text = username;
      _passwordController.text = password;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _saveAndConnect() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final host = _hostController.text.trim();
    final port = int.tryParse(_portController.text.trim()) ?? 1883;

    if (host.isEmpty) {
      setState(() => _errorMessage = l10n.mqttHostRequired);
      return;
    }

    setState(() {
      _isConnecting = true;
      _errorMessage = null;
      _isConnected = null;
    });

    try {
      final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
      await prefs.setString('mqtt_host', host);
      await prefs.setInt('mqtt_port', port);

      final keys = EncryptedKeys();
      await keys.saveMqttUsername(_usernameController.text.trim());
      await keys.saveMqttPassword(_passwordController.text);

      final service = MqttServiceImpl(getIt<Talker>());
      await service.connect(host, port: port);

      if (!mounted) {
        await service.disconnect();
        return;
      }

      final connected = service.isConnected;

      setState(() {
        _isConnected = connected;
        if (!connected) {
          _errorMessage = l10n.mqttConnectionFailed;
        }
      });

      await service.disconnect();
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _isConnected = false;
        _errorMessage = l10n.mqttConnectionError(error.toString());
      });
    } finally {
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isConnecting = false);
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    if (_isLoading) {
      return const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.mqttSettingsTitle),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    l10n.mqttBrokerTitle,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 18,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    l10n.mqttUsageHint,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.grey,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _hostController,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.mqttHostLabel,
                      hintText: l10n.mqttHostHint,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.dns),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _portController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.mqttPortLabel,
                      hintText: '1883',
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.numbers),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _usernameController,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.mqttUsernameLabel,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.person),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextField(
                    controller: _passwordController,
                    obscureText: true,
                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                      labelText: l10n.mqttPasswordLabel,
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.lock),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  if (_errorMessage != null) ...[
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.error, color: Colors.red),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              _errorMessage!,
                              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],
                  if (_isConnected != null) ...[
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _isConnected!
                            ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.1)
                            : Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            _isConnected!
                                ? Icons.check_circle
                                : Icons.cancel,
                            color: _isConnected!
                                ? Colors.green
                                : Colors.red,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              _isConnected!
                                  ? l10n.mqttConnectionSuccess
                                  : l10n.mqttConnectionFailureStatus,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: _isConnected!
                                    ? Colors.green
                                    : Colors.red,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  ],
                  SizedBox(
                    width: double.infinity,
                    child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: _isConnecting ? null : _saveAndConnect,
                      icon: _isConnecting
                          ? const SizedBox(
                        width: 16,
                        height: 16,
                        child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                          strokeWidth: 2,
                        ),
                      )
                          : const Icon(Icons.wifi),
                      label: Text(
                        _isConnecting
                            ? l10n.mqttConnecting
                            : l10n.mqttSaveAndConnect,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Экран настройки комнат при первом запуске (онбординг).
/// Позволяет создать и удалить комнаты.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';

import '../../../application/onboarding_manager.dart';
import '../../../application/state/rooms_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/room.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class RoomsSetupScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RoomsSetupScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final rooms = ref.watch(roomsProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.roomsTitle),
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(32),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              l10n.roomsCreateTitle,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 24,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(l10n.roomsOrganizeHint, style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey[600])),
            const SizedBox(height: 24),

            Expanded(
              child: rooms.isEmpty
                  ? Center(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Icon(
                      Icons.meeting_room,
                      size: 56,
                      color: Colors.grey[400],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Text(
                      l10n.roomsAddFirst,
                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              )
                  : ListView.builder(
                itemCount: rooms.length,
                itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                  final room = rooms[index];

                  return Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: Text(
                        room.icon ?? '🏠',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 32),
                      ),
                      title: Text(room.name),
                      trailing: IconButton(
                        icon: const Icon(
                          Icons.delete,
                          color: Colors.red,
                        ),
                        onPressed: () {
                          ref
                              .read(roomsProvider.notifier)
                              .deleteRoom(room.id);
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 16),

            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 56,
              child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _showAddRoomDialog(context, ref),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                label: Text(l10n.roomsAddButton, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 8),

            SizedBox(
              width: double.infinity,
              height: 56,
              child: ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  await OnboardingManager.complete();

                  if (context.mounted) {
                    context.go('/');
                  }
                },
                child: Text(l10n.onboardingFinishButton, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Диалог добавления новой комнаты.
  void _showAddRoomDialog(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => const _AddRoomDialog(),
    );
  }
}
class _AddRoomDialog extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const _AddRoomDialog();

  @override
  ConsumerState<_AddRoomDialog> createState() => _AddRoomDialogState();
}

class _AddRoomDialogState extends ConsumerState<_AddRoomDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController();
  }

  void _saveRoom() {
    final roomName = _controller.text.trim();
    if (roomName.isEmpty) return;

    final rooms = ref.read(roomsProvider);

    ref.read(roomsProvider.notifier).addRoom(
      Room(
        id: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch.toString(),
        name: roomName,
        sortOrder: rooms.length,
      ),
    );

    FocusScope.of(context).unfocus();
    Navigator.of(context).pop();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return AlertDialog(
      title: Text(l10n.roomAddDialogTitle),
      content: TextField(
        controller: _controller,
        autofocus: true,
        textInputAction: TextInputAction.done,
        onSubmitted: (_) => _saveRoom(),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: l10n.roomNameLabel,
          hintText: l10n.roomNameHint,
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: Text(l10n.cancel),
        ),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: _saveRoom,
          child: Text(l10n.add),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}
