import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:geolocator/geolocator.dart';

import '../../application/models/presence_settings.dart';
import '../../application/state/presence_detector_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/presence_provider.dart';
import '../../data/services/presence_detector.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class PresenceSettingsScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const PresenceSettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final settings = ref.watch(presenceSettingsProvider);
    final notifier = ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier);
    final detector = ref.watch(presenceDetectorProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(l10n.presenceTitle)),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          SwitchListTile(
            title: Text(l10n.presenceTrackingEnable),
            subtitle: Text(l10n.presenceTrackingSubtitle),
            value: settings.enabled,
            onChanged: (value) async {
              await notifier.update(settings.copyWith(enabled: value));
            },
          ),
          const Divider(height: 32),

          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 16),
                child: Text(
                  l10n.presencePhones,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    fontSize: 16,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
              IconButton(
                icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                onPressed: () => _showPhoneDialog(context, ref, null),
              ),
            ],
          ),

          if (settings.phones.isEmpty)
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Text(l10n.presenceNoPhones),
            )
          else
            ...settings.phones.map((phone) {
              final presence = detector.phones[phone.phoneId];
              return _buildPhoneCard(
                context,
                ref,
                notifier,
                phone,
                presence,
                l10n,
              );
            }),

          const Divider(height: 32),

          _buildCard(
            context: context,
            icon: Icons.my_location,
            color: Colors.blue,
            title: l10n.presenceHomeZone,
            subtitle: settings.homeLat == 0 && settings.homeLng == 0
                ? l10n.presenceNotConfigured
                : '${settings.homeLat.toStringAsFixed(4)}, '
                '${settings.homeLng.toStringAsFixed(4)}',
            onTap: () => _showHomeZoneDialog(context, ref, settings),
          ),

          _buildCard(
            context: context,
            icon: Icons.circle_outlined,
            color: Colors.orange,
            title: l10n.presenceRadius,
            subtitle: '${settings.homeRadius} м',
            onTap: () => _showRadiusDialog(context, ref, settings),
          ),

          _buildCard(
            context: context,
            icon: Icons.timer,
            color: Colors.red,
            title: l10n.presenceAwayTimeout,
            subtitle: '${settings.awayTimeoutMin} мин',
            onTap: () => _showTimeoutDialog(context, ref, settings),
          ),

          const SizedBox(height: 16),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPhoneCard(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      PresenceSettingsNotifier notifier,
      PresencePhone phone,
      PhonePresence? presence,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final status = presence?.status ?? PhonePresenceStatus.unknown;
    final source = presence?.source ?? PresenceSource.unknown;

    IconData icon;
    Color color;
    String statusText;
    String? subtitle;

    if (status == PhonePresenceStatus.home) {
      if (source == PresenceSource.heartbeat) {
        icon = Icons.wifi;
        color = Colors.green;
        statusText = l10n.presenceHomeWifi;
        subtitle = l10n.presenceHeartbeatActive;
      } else if (source == PresenceSource.cloud) {
        icon = Icons.cloud_done;
        color = Colors.lightGreen;
        statusText = l10n.presenceHomeCloud;

        final distance = presence?.distanceFromHome;
        subtitle = distance == null
            ? l10n.presenceWifiInactiveGpsUnavailable
            : l10n.presenceWifiInactiveDistance(
          _formatDistance(distance, l10n),
        );
      } else {
        icon = Icons.home;
        color = Colors.green;
        statusText = l10n.presenceHomeWifi;
        subtitle = null;
      }
    } else if (status == PhonePresenceStatus.away) {
      final distance = presence?.distanceFromHome;

      icon = Icons.directions_walk;
      color = Colors.orange;
      statusText = l10n.presenceAway;
      subtitle = distance == null
          ? null
          : l10n.presenceDistanceFromHome(
        _formatDistance(distance, l10n),
      );
    } else {
      icon = Icons.help_outline;
      color = Colors.grey;
      statusText = l10n.presenceUnknown;
      subtitle = null;
    }

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        onTap: () => _showPhoneDialog(context, ref, phone),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, color: color, size: 36),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            phone.phoneName,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              fontSize: 15,
                            ),
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            maxLines: 1,
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (presence?.battery != null)
                          Text(
                            '${presence!.battery}%',
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11,
                              color: Colors.grey,
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      statusText,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: color,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (subtitle != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 2),
                      Text(
                        subtitle,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: Colors.grey,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                    const SizedBox(height: 2),
                    Text(
                      'ID: ${phone.phoneId}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        color: Colors.grey,
                      ),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      maxLines: 1,
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              Switch(
                value: phone.enabled,
                onChanged: (value) {
                  notifier.updatePhone(
                    phone.phoneId,
                    phone.copyWith(enabled: value),
                  );
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCard({
    required BuildContext context,
    required IconData icon,
    required Color color,
    required String title,
    required String subtitle,
    required VoidCallback onTap,
  }) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
      child: ListTile(
        leading: Icon(icon, color: color, size: 32),
        title: Text(
          title,
          style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        subtitle: Text(subtitle),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
        onTap: onTap,
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showPhoneDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      PresencePhone? existingPhone,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final isEditing = existingPhone != null;
    final nameController =
    TextEditingController(text: existingPhone?.phoneName ?? '');
    final idController =
    TextEditingController(text: existingPhone?.phoneId ?? '');

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(
          isEditing ? l10n.presenceEditPhone : l10n.presenceAddPhone,
        ),
        content: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: nameController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.presenceName,
                  hintText: l10n.presenceNameHint,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: idController,
                enabled: !isEditing,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.presencePhoneId,
                  hintText: l10n.presencePhoneIdHint,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          if (isEditing)
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                ref
                    .read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier)
                    .removePhone(existingPhone.phoneId);
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              },
              child: Text(
                l10n.presenceDelete,
                style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
              ),
            ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.presenceCancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              if (nameController.text.isEmpty ||
                  idController.text.isEmpty) {
                return;
              }

              final newPhone = PresencePhone(
                phoneId: idController.text.trim(),
                phoneName: nameController.text.trim(),
                enabled: existingPhone?.enabled ?? true,
              );

              if (isEditing) {
                ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier).updatePhone(
                  existingPhone.phoneId,
                  newPhone,
                );
              } else {
                ref
                    .read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier)
                    .addPhone(newPhone);
              }

              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
            },
            child: Text(
              isEditing ? l10n.presenceSave : l10n.presenceAdd,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showHomeZoneDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      PresenceSettings settings,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final latController = TextEditingController(
      text: settings.homeLat == 0
          ? ''
          : settings.homeLat.toStringAsFixed(6),
    );
    final lngController = TextEditingController(
      text: settings.homeLng == 0

          : settings.homeLng.toStringAsFixed(6),
    );

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.presenceHomeZone),
        content: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: latController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.presenceLatitude,
                  hintText: '55.7558',
                ),
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                  decimal: true,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: lngController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.presenceLongitude,
                  hintText: '37.6173',
                ),
                keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(
                  decimal: true,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              OutlinedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () => _getCurrentLocation(
                  context,
                  latController,
                  lngController,
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.my_location),
                label: Text(l10n.presenceGetCurrentCoordinates),
                style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                  minimumSize: const Size(double.infinity, 44),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.presenceCancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              final latitude = double.tryParse(latController.text);
              final longitude = double.tryParse(lngController.text);

              if (latitude != null && longitude != null) {
                ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier).update(
                  settings.copyWith(
                    homeLat: latitude,
                    homeLng: longitude,
                  ),
                );
              }

              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
            },
            child: Text(l10n.presenceSave),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _getCurrentLocation(
      BuildContext context,
      TextEditingController latController,
      TextEditingController lngController,
      ) async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final serviceEnabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
    if (!serviceEnabled) {
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.presenceGpsDisabled)),
      );
      return;
    }

    LocationPermission permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
    if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) {
      permission = await Geolocator.requestPermission();
    }

    if (permission == LocationPermission.deniedForever) {
      if (!context.mounted) return;

      final openSettings = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.presencePermissionTitle),
          content: Text(l10n.presencePermissionMessage),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
              child: Text(l10n.presenceCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
              child: Text(l10n.presenceOpenSettings),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

      if (openSettings == true) {
        await Geolocator.openAppSettings();
      }
      return;
    }

    if (permission == LocationPermission.denied) {
      if (!context.mounted) return;
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.presencePermissionNotGranted)),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      barrierDismissible: false,
      builder: (_) => AlertDialog(
        content: Row(
          children: [
            const CircularProgressIndicator(),
            const SizedBox(width: 16),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(l10n.presenceGettingGps),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );

    Position? position;

    try {
      position = await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(
        locationSettings: const LocationSettings(
          accuracy: LocationAccuracy.high,
          timeLimit: Duration(seconds: 60),
        ),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      debugPrint('⚠️ Fresh GPS timeout: $error');
    }

    if (position == null) {
      try {
        position = await Geolocator.getLastKnownPosition();
        if (position != null) {
          debugPrint(
            '📍 Используем last known: '
                '${position.latitude}, ${position.longitude}',
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        debugPrint('❌ Last known error: $error');
      }
    }

    if (context.mounted) {
      Navigator.pop(context);
    }

    if (position != null) {
      final latitude = position.latitude.toStringAsFixed(6);
      final longitude = position.longitude.toStringAsFixed(6);

      latController.text = latitude;
      lngController.text = longitude;

      if (context.mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(
              l10n.presenceCoordinatesReceived(latitude, longitude),
            ),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } else if (context.mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(l10n.presenceGpsFailed),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  void _showRadiusDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      PresenceSettings settings,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final controller =
    TextEditingController(text: settings.homeRadius.toString());

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.presenceRadius),
        content: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            labelText: l10n.presenceMeters,
            hintText: l10n.presenceRadiusHint,
          ),
          keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.presenceCancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              final radius = int.tryParse(controller.text);
              if (radius != null && radius > 0) {
                ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier).update(
                  settings.copyWith(homeRadius: radius),
                );
              }
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
            },
            child: Text(l10n.presenceSave),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showTimeoutDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      PresenceSettings settings,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final controller =
    TextEditingController(text: settings.awayTimeoutMin.toString());

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.presenceAwayTimeout),
        content: TextField(
          controller: controller,
          decoration: InputDecoration(
            labelText: l10n.presenceMinutes,
            hintText: l10n.presenceTimeoutHint,
          ),
          keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.presenceCancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              final timeout = int.tryParse(controller.text);
              if (timeout != null && timeout > 0) {
                ref.read(presenceSettingsProvider.notifier).update(
                  settings.copyWith(awayTimeoutMin: timeout),
                );
              }
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
            },
            child: Text(l10n.presenceSave),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  String _formatDistance(double meters, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    if (meters < 1000) {
      return '${meters.round()} м';
    }

    return '${(meters / 1000).toStringAsFixed(1)} км';
  }
}

/// Экран управления комнатами.
/// Позволяет добавлять, переименовывать и удалять комнаты.
/// При удалении комнаты устройства переносятся в раздел «Все устройства».
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/rooms_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/models/room.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class RoomsManageScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const RoomsManageScreen({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final rooms = ref.watch(roomsProvider);
    final devices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.roomsTitle),
      ),
      body: rooms.isEmpty
          ? Center(
        child: Text(
          l10n.roomsManageEmpty,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16),
          textAlign: TextAlign.center,
        ),
      )
          : ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: rooms.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final room = rooms[index];
          final deviceCount =
              devices.where((device) => device.roomId == room.id).length;

          return Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: Text(
                room.icon ?? '🏠',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 32),
              ),
              title: Text(
                room.name,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  fontSize: 16,
                ),
              ),
              subtitle: Text(l10n.roomsDeviceCount(deviceCount)),
              trailing: Row(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                children: [
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: l10n.roomsEditDialogTitle,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.edit, color: Colors.blue),
                    onPressed: () =>
                        _showRenameDialog(context, ref, room),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    tooltip: l10n.roomsDeleteDialogTitle,
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                    onPressed: () => _showDeleteDialog(
                      context,
                      ref,
                      room,
                      deviceCount,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        tooltip: l10n.roomAddDialogTitle,
        onPressed: () => _showAddRoomDialog(context, ref),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _iconLabel(String icon, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (icon) {
      case '🛋️':
        return l10n.roomIconLiving;
      case '🛏️':
        return l10n.roomIconBedroom;
      case '🍳':
        return l10n.roomIconKitchen;
      case '🚿':
        return l10n.roomIconBathroom;
      case '🚗':
        return l10n.roomIconGarage;
      case '🌳':
        return l10n.roomIconYard;
      case '👶':
        return l10n.roomIconKids;
      case '📦':
        return l10n.roomIconStorage;
      case '💻':
        return l10n.roomIconOffice;
      case '🏠':
        return l10n.roomIconHome;
      case '🔌':
        return l10n.roomIconAppliances;
      default:
        return icon;
    }
  }

  List<DropdownMenuItem<String>> _iconItems(AppLocalizations l10n) {
    const icons = [
      '🛋️',
      '🛏️',
      '🍳',
      '🚿',
      '🚗',
      '🌳',
      '👶',
      '📦',
      '💻',
      '🏠',
      '🔌',
    ];

    return icons
        .map(
          (icon) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
        value: icon,
        child: Text('$icon ${_iconLabel(icon, l10n)}'),
      ),
    )
        .toList();
  }

  void _showAddRoomDialog(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final controller = TextEditingController();
    String selectedIcon = '🏠';

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.roomAddDialogTitle),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: controller,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.roomNameLabel,
                  hintText: l10n.roomNameHint,
                ),
                autofocus: true,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: selectedIcon,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.roomIconHome,
                ),
                items: _iconItems(l10n),
                onChanged: (value) {
                  setDialogState(() {
                    selectedIcon = value ?? '🏠';
                  });
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: Text(l10n.cancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                final name = controller.text.trim();
                if (name.isEmpty) return;

                ref.read(roomsProvider.notifier).addRoom(
                  Room(
                    id: const Uuid().v4(),
                    name: name,
                    icon: selectedIcon,
                    sortOrder: ref.read(roomsProvider).length,
                  ),
                );

                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              },
              child: Text(l10n.add),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showRenameDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      Room room,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final controller = TextEditingController(text: room.name);
    String selectedIcon = room.icon ?? '🏠';

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.roomsEditDialogTitle),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: controller,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.roomNameLabel,
                ),
                autofocus: true,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                initialValue: selectedIcon,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.roomIconHome,
                ),
                items: _iconItems(l10n),
                onChanged: (value) {
                  setDialogState(() {
                    selectedIcon = value ?? '🏠';
                  });
                },
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: Text(l10n.cancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                final name = controller.text.trim();
                if (name.isEmpty) return;

                ref.read(roomsProvider.notifier).renameRoom(room.id, name);

                final updatedRoom = room.copyWith(
                  name: name,
                  icon: selectedIcon,
                );
                ref
                    .read(roomsProvider.notifier)
                    .updateRoom(updatedRoom);

                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              },
              child: Text(l10n.save),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showDeleteDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      Room room,
      int deviceCount,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.roomsDeleteDialogTitle),
        content: Text(
          deviceCount > 0
              ? l10n.roomsDeleteWithDevices(deviceCount)
              : l10n.roomsDeleteConfirmation(room.name),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.cancel),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              // Переносим устройства в раздел «Все устройства».
              final devices = ref.read(devicesProvider);
              for (final device
              in devices.where((item) => item.roomId == room.id)) {
                ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(
                  device.copyWith(roomId: 'all'),
                );
              }

              ref.read(roomsProvider.notifier).deleteRoom(room.id);
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);

              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                SnackBar(
                  content: Text(l10n.roomsDeletedMessage(room.name)),
                ),
              );
            },
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.red,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
            child: Text(l10n.roomsDeleteButton),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

                  ),
                  child: Column(

                    children: [
                      // IP:

                        '📍 ${l10n.ipAddress(device.ip)}',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 15),

                      // 🔌 Порт:
                      Text(
                        '🔌 ${l10n.portNumber(device.port)}',

                  initialValue: _selectedType,
                  // 'Тип устройства'

                    labelText: l10n.deviceType,
                    prefixIcon: const Icon(Icons.category),
                  ),

                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.outlet,
                      child: Text(l10n.outlet),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.switch1,
                      child: Text(l10n.switchOne),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.switch2,
                      child: Text(l10n.switchTwo),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.switch3,
                      child: Text(l10n.switchThree),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.sensor,
                      child: Text(l10n.sensor),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.light,
                      child: Text(l10n.light),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.curtain,
                      child: Text(l10n.curtain),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.hvac,
                      child: Text('❄️ ${l10n.airConditioner}'),
                    ),
                    DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: DeviceType.compound,
                      child: Text('🦾 ${l10n.universalDevice}'),
                    ),
                  ],
                  onChanged: (value) =>
                      setDialogState(() => _selectedType = value ?? DeviceType.outlet),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(
                  controller: deviceIdController,
                  // 'Device ID'
                  decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.deviceId),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                TextField(
                  controller: localKeyController,
                  // 'Local Key'
                  decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: l10n.localKey),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
              // 'Отмена'
              child: Text(l10n.cancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                if (localKeyController.text.isNotEmpty) {
                  final newDevice = Device(
                    id: const Uuid().v4(),
                    name: nameController.text,
                    type: _selectedType,
                    roomId: 'living',
                    isOnline: true,
                    state: DeviceState.online,
                    deviceId: deviceIdController.text.isNotEmpty
                        ? deviceIdController.text
                        : 'device_${device.ip.replaceAll('.', '_')}',
                    localKey: localKeyController.text,
                    address: device.ip,
                    version: 3.5,
                    properties: _getDefaultProperties(_selectedType),
                  );
                  ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).addDevice(newDevice);
                  setState(() => _addedIps.add(device.ip));
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    // добавлено!'
                    SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.deviceAddedMessage(nameController.text)),
                    ),
                  );
                }
              },
              //'Добавить'
              child: Text(l10n.add),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SCAN
  // ============================================================

  Future<void> _startScan() async {
    setState(() {
      _scanning = true;
      _progress = 0;
      _total = 254;
      _foundDevices.clear();
    });

    final subnet = await PortScanner.getLocalSubnet();
    if (subnet == null) {
      setState(() => _scanning = false);
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          // 'Не удалось определить локальную сеть'
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(AppLocalizations.of(context).localNetworkNotFound),
          ),
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    final scanner = PortScanner(
      getIt<Talker>(),
          (device) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() => _foundDevices.add(device));
        }
      },
          (progress, total) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            _progress = progress;
            _total = total;
          });
        }
      },
    );

    await scanner.scanSubnet(subnet);
    if (mounted) setState(() => _scanning = false);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> _getDefaultProperties(DeviceType type) {
    return DevicesNotifier.defaultProperties(type);
  }
}

/// Диалог создания/редактирования сцены.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

import '../../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../../application/state/presence_provider.dart';
import '../../../application/state/scenes_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/presence_conditions.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/scene.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import 'scene_helpers.dart';

class SceneEditorDialog extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const SceneEditorDialog({super.key, this.existingScene});

  final Scene? existingScene;

  @override
  ConsumerState<SceneEditorDialog> createState() =>
      _SceneEditorDialogState();
}

class _SceneEditorDialogState extends ConsumerState<SceneEditorDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _nameController;
  late final TextEditingController _sensorThresholdController;

  late String _triggerType;
  late TimeOfDay _selectedTime;
  late String _repeatType;
  late final Set<int> _selectedDays;

  String? _selectedSensorId;
  late String _selectedSensorCondition;

  late PresenceEvent _selectedPresenceEvent;
  String? _selectedPresencePhoneId;
  late PresenceChannel _selectedPresenceChannel;
  late int _presenceDelayMin;
  late int _presenceCooldownMin;
  PresenceConditions? _presenceConditions;
  bool _showPresenceAdvanced = false;

  final Map<String, String?> _selectedActions = {};

  bool get _isEditing => widget.existingScene != null;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    final scene = widget.existingScene;
    final trigger = scene?.trigger;

    _nameController = TextEditingController(text: scene?.name ?? '');
    _sensorThresholdController = TextEditingController(
      text: '${trigger?.sensorThreshold ?? 30}',
    );

    _triggerType = _triggerTypeToString(trigger?.type);
    _selectedTime = SceneHelpers.parseTime(trigger?.time) ??
        const TimeOfDay(hour: 22, minute: 0);
    _repeatType = _repeatTypeToString(trigger?.repeat);
    _selectedDays = Set.from(trigger?.repeatDays ?? []);

    _selectedSensorId = trigger?.sensorDeviceId;
    _selectedSensorCondition =
        trigger?.sensorCondition ?? 'temperature_above';

    _selectedPresenceEvent =
        trigger?.presenceEvent ?? PresenceEvent.someoneHome;
    _selectedPresencePhoneId = trigger?.presencePhoneId;
    _selectedPresenceChannel =
        trigger?.presenceChannel ?? PresenceChannel.gps;
    _presenceDelayMin = trigger?.presenceDelayMin ?? 0;
    _presenceCooldownMin = trigger?.presenceCooldownMin ?? 1;
    _presenceConditions = trigger?.presenceConditions;

    if (scene != null) {
      for (final action in scene.actions) {
        _selectedActions[action.deviceId] = action.command;
      }
    }
  }

  String _repeatTypeToString(RepeatType? type) {
    switch (type) {
      case RepeatType.daily:
        return 'daily';
      case RepeatType.weekly:
        return 'weekly';
      case RepeatType.interval:
      case RepeatType.once:
      case null:
        return 'once';
    }
  }

  String _triggerTypeToString(TriggerType? type) {
    switch (type) {
      case TriggerType.time:
        return 'time';
      case TriggerType.deviceState:
        return 'sensor';
      case TriggerType.presence:
        return 'presence';
      case TriggerType.manual:
      case null:
        return 'manual';
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    _sensorThresholdController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  String _formatTime(TimeOfDay time) {
    return '${time.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
        '${time.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  List<String> _weekDays(AppLocalizations l10n) => [
    l10n.sceneEditorMonday,
    l10n.sceneEditorTuesday,
    l10n.sceneEditorWednesday,
    l10n.sceneEditorThursday,
    l10n.sceneEditorFriday,
    l10n.sceneEditorSaturday,
    l10n.sceneEditorSunday,
  ];

  String _minuteLabel(int value, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    if (value == 0) return l10n.sceneEditorNoDelay;
    if (value == 1) return l10n.sceneEditorMinute;
    return l10n.sceneEditorMinutes(value);
  }

          child: Text(
            _isEditing
                ? l10n.sceneEditorSave
                : l10n.sceneEditorCreate,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  void _save() {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final hasActions = _selectedActions.values.any((action) => action != null);

    if (_nameController.text.trim().isEmpty || !hasActions) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.sceneEditorValidation)),
      );
      return;
    }

    final actions = _selectedActions.entries
        .where((entry) => entry.value != null)
        .map(
          (entry) => SceneAction(
        deviceId: entry.key,
        command: entry.value!,
      ),
    )
        .toList();

    final timeString = _formatTime(_selectedTime);

    SceneTrigger? trigger;

    if (_triggerType == 'time') {
      trigger = SceneTrigger(
        type: TriggerType.time,
        time: timeString,
        repeat: RepeatType.values.firstWhere(
              (repeat) => repeat.name == _repeatType,
        ),
        repeatDays:
        _repeatType == 'weekly' ? _selectedDays.toList() : null,
      );
    } else if (_triggerType == 'sensor') {
      trigger = SceneTrigger(
        type: TriggerType.deviceState,
        sensorDeviceId: _selectedSensorId,
        sensorCondition: _selectedSensorCondition,
        sensorThreshold:
        double.tryParse(_sensorThresholdController.text) ?? 30,
      );
    } else if (_triggerType == 'presence') {
      trigger = SceneTrigger(
        type: TriggerType.presence,
        presenceEvent: _selectedPresenceEvent,
        presencePhoneId: _selectedPresencePhoneId,
        presenceChannel: _selectedPresenceChannel,
        presenceDelayMin: _presenceDelayMin,
        presenceCooldownMin: _presenceCooldownMin,
        presenceConditions: _presenceConditions,
      );
    }

    final scene = Scene(
      id: widget.existingScene?.id ?? const Uuid().v4(),
      name: _nameController.text.trim(),
      icon: _triggerType == 'time'
          ? '⏰'
          : _triggerType == 'sensor'
          ? '🌡️'
          : _triggerType == 'presence'
          ? '📍'
          : '🎬',
      actions: actions,
      trigger: trigger,
    );

    // Сохраняем так же, как было в исходном диалоге.
    // При наличии отдельного updateScene в scenesProvider нужно проверить,
    // следует ли вызывать его для редактирования вместо addScene.
    ref.read(scenesProvider.notifier).addScene(scene);

    Navigator.pop(context);
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          _isEditing
              ? l10n.sceneEditorUpdated
              : l10n.sceneEditorCreated,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<PresenceConditions?> _showConditionsDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      ) async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final conditions = _presenceConditions ?? const PresenceConditions();

    var useTime = conditions.useTime;
    var startTime = TimeOfDay(
      hour: conditions.startHour,
      minute: conditions.startMinute,
    );
    var endTime = TimeOfDay(
      hour: conditions.endHour,
      minute: conditions.endMinute,
    );
    var useDays = conditions.useDays;
    final days = Set<int>.from(conditions.daysOfWeek);

    return showDialog<PresenceConditions>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.sceneEditorConditionsTitle),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                SwitchListTile(
                  dense: true,
                  title: Text(l10n.sceneEditorTimeOfDay),
                  value: useTime,
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setDialogState(() => useTime = value);
                  },
                ),
                if (useTime) ...[
                  ListTile(
                    dense: true,
                    title: Text(
                      l10n.sceneEditorFromTime(_formatTime(startTime)),
                    ),
                    trailing: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                    onTap: () async {
                      final time = await showTimePicker(
                        context: dialogContext,
                        initialTime: startTime,
                      );
                      if (time != null) {
                        setDialogState(() => startTime = time);
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                  ListTile(
                    dense: true,
                    title: Text(
                      l10n.sceneEditorUntilTime(_formatTime(endTime)),
                    ),
                    trailing: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                    onTap: () async {
                      final time = await showTimePicker(
                        context: dialogContext,
                        initialTime: endTime,
                      );
                      if (time != null) {
                        setDialogState(() => endTime = time);
                      }
                    },
                  ),
                ],
                const Divider(),
                SwitchListTile(
                  dense: true,
                  title: Text(l10n.sceneEditorDaysCondition),
                  value: useDays,
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setDialogState(() => useDays = value);
                  },
                ),
                if (useDays)
                  Wrap(
                    spacing: 4,
                    children: _weekDays(l10n).asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                      final dayIndex = entry.key + 1;

                      return FilterChip(
                        label: Text(
                          entry.value,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                        ),
                        selected: days.contains(dayIndex),
                        onSelected: (selected) {
                          setDialogState(() {
                            if (selected) {
                              days.add(dayIndex);
                            } else {
                              days.remove(dayIndex);
                            }
                          });
                        },
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(
                  dialogContext,
                  const PresenceConditions(),
                );
              },
              child: Text(l10n.sceneEditorReset),
            ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: Text(l10n.sceneEditorCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(
                  dialogContext,
                  PresenceConditions(
                    useTime: useTime,
                    startHour: startTime.hour,
                    startMinute: startTime.minute,
                    endHour: endTime.hour,
                    endMinute: endTime.minute,
                    useDays: useDays,
                    daysOfWeek: days.toList(),
                  ),
                );
              },
              child: Text(l10n.sceneEditorSave),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Чистые хелперы для экрана сцен: форматирование команд, иконок,
/// условий датчиков и присутствия.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/scene.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class SceneHelpers {
  SceneHelpers._();

  // ─── Действия ───

  static String actionLabel(
      String command,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    switch (command) {
      case 'turnOn':
        return l10n.sceneEditorActionOn;
      case 'turnOff':
        return l10n.sceneEditorActionOff;
      case 'setBrightness':
        return l10n.sceneEditorActionBrightness;
      default:
      // Неизвестная команда — техническое значение, оставляем как есть.
        return command.toUpperCase();
    }
  }

  static Color actionColor(String command) {
    switch (command) {
      case 'turnOn':
        return Colors.green;
      case 'turnOff':
        return Colors.red;
      case 'setBrightness':
        return Colors.orange;
      default:
        return Colors.blue;
    }
  }

  static String deviceIcon(DeviceType? type) {
    switch (type) {
      case DeviceType.outlet:
        return '🔌';
      case DeviceType.switch1:
      case DeviceType.switch2:
      case DeviceType.switch3:
      case DeviceType.light:
        return '💡';
      case DeviceType.sensor:
        return '🌡️';
      case DeviceType.camera:
        return '📹';
      case DeviceType.compound:
        return '🤖';
      default:
        return '📦';
    }
  }

  // ─── Условия датчика ───

  static String sensorConditionLabel(
      SceneTrigger trigger,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final condition = trigger.sensorCondition ?? '';
    final threshold = (trigger.sensorThreshold ?? 0).toString();

    switch (condition) {
      case 'temperature_above':
        return l10n.sceneEditorTemperatureAbove(threshold);
      case 'temperature_below':
        return l10n.sceneEditorTemperatureBelow(threshold);
      case 'humidity_above':
        return l10n.sceneEditorHumidityAbove(threshold);
      case 'humidity_below':
        return l10n.sceneEditorHumidityBelow(threshold);
      case 'water_leak':
        return l10n.sceneEditorWaterLeak;
      case 'motion':
        return l10n.sceneEditorMotion;
      case 'contact_open':
        return l10n.sceneEditorContactOpen;
      case 'contact_closed':
        return l10n.sceneEditorContactClosed;
      case 'smoke':
        return l10n.sceneEditorSmoke;
      case 'gas':
        return l10n.sceneEditorGas;
      default:
        return '$condition $threshold';
    }
  }

  // ─── Присутствие ───

  static String presenceEventLabel(
      SceneTrigger trigger,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final event = trigger.presenceEvent;
    if (event == null) return l10n.scenesPresence;

    switch (event) {
      case PresenceEvent.someoneHome:
        return l10n.sceneEditorSomeoneHome;
      case PresenceEvent.nobodyHome:
        return l10n.sceneEditorNobodyHome;
      case PresenceEvent.allHome:
        return l10n.sceneEditorAllHome;
      case PresenceEvent.phoneArrived:
        return l10n.sceneEditorPhoneArrived;
      case PresenceEvent.phoneLeft:
        return l10n.sceneEditorPhoneLeft;
      case PresenceEvent.phoneUnknown:
        return l10n.sceneEditorPhoneUnknown;
    }
  }

  // ─── Повторы ───

  static String repeatLabel(
      RepeatType repeat,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    switch (repeat) {
      case RepeatType.daily:
        return l10n.sceneEditorRepeatDaily;
      case RepeatType.weekly:
        return l10n.sceneEditorRepeatWeekly;
      case RepeatType.interval:
        return l10n.sceneEditorMinutes(1);
      case RepeatType.once:
        return l10n.sceneEditorRepeatOnce;
    }
  }

  static String daysLabel(
      List<int>? days,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    if (days == null || days.isEmpty) return '';

    final names = [
      '',
      l10n.sceneEditorMonday,
      l10n.sceneEditorTuesday,
      l10n.sceneEditorWednesday,
      l10n.sceneEditorThursday,
      l10n.sceneEditorFriday,
      l10n.sceneEditorSaturday,
      l10n.sceneEditorSunday,
    ];

    return days
        .where((day) => day > 0 && day < names.length)
        .map((day) => names[day])
        .join(', ');
  }

  // ─── Прочее ───

  static String pluralize(
      int count,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    // Сохраняет прежнее назначение метода: вернуть краткую подпись единицы.
    return l10n.sceneEditorDeviceUnitShort;
  }

  static TimeOfDay? parseTime(String? timeStr) {
    if (timeStr == null) return null;

    final parts = timeStr.split(':');
    if (parts.length != 2) return null;

    final hour = int.tryParse(parts[0]);
    final minute = int.tryParse(parts[1]);

    if (hour == null ||
        minute == null ||
        hour < 0 ||
        hour > 23 ||
        minute < 0 ||
        minute > 59) {
      return null;
    }

    return TimeOfDay(hour: hour, minute: minute);
  }
}

class ScenesScreen extends ConsumerWidget {
  const ScenesScreen({super.key});

  @override

  int _calculateCrossAxisCount(double width, bool isLandscape) {
    if (isLandscape) {
      if (width >= 1200) return 5;
      if (width >= 900) return 4;
      if (width >= 700) return 3;
      return 2;
    }

    if (width >= 900) return 3;
    if (width >= 300) return 2;
    return 1;
  }

  double _calculateTileWidth(double screenWidth, int crossAxisCount) {
    const horizontalPadding = 16.0;
    const spacing = 8.0;
    final available =
        screenWidth - horizontalPadding - spacing * (crossAxisCount - 1);

    return available / crossAxisCount;
  }

  Widget _buildActionsList(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../data/services/screen_saver_settings.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class ScreenSettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ScreenSettingsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ScreenSettingsScreen> createState() => _ScreenSettingsScreenState();
}

class _ScreenSettingsScreenState extends State<ScreenSettingsScreen> {
  bool _isLoading = true;
  bool _enabled = true;
  bool _motionWakeEnabled = false;
  int _idleTimeoutSeconds = 120;
  int _motionSensitivity = 50;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadSettings();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    await ScreenSaverSettings.load();

    if (!mounted) return;

    final config = ScreenSaverSettings.value.value;

    setState(() {
      _enabled = config.enabled;
      _idleTimeoutSeconds = config.idleTimeoutSeconds;
      _motionWakeEnabled = config.motionWakeEnabled;
      _motionSensitivity = config.motionSensitivity;
      _isLoading = false;
    });
  }

  Future<void> _setMotionSensitivity(int sensitivity) async {
    setState(() => _motionSensitivity = sensitivity);
    await ScreenSaverSettings.setMotionSensitivity(sensitivity);
  }

  Future<void> _setMotionWakeEnabled(bool enabled) async {
    setState(() => _motionWakeEnabled = enabled);
    await ScreenSaverSettings.setMotionWakeEnabled(enabled);
  }

  Future<void> _setEnabled(bool enabled) async {
    setState(() => _enabled = enabled);
    await ScreenSaverSettings.setEnabled(enabled);
  }

  Future<void> _setIdleTimeout(int seconds) async {
    setState(() => _idleTimeoutSeconds = seconds);
    await ScreenSaverSettings.setIdleTimeout(seconds);
  }

  String _timeoutLabel(AppLocalizations l10n, int seconds) {
    switch (seconds) {
      case 30:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeout30;
      case 60:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeout60;
      case 120:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeout120;
      case 300:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeout300;
      case 600:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeout600;
      default:
        return l10n.screenSaverTimeoutSeconds(seconds);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    if (_isLoading) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: Text(l10n.screenSettings),
        ),
        body: const Center(
          child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
        ),
      );
    }

    final timeoutOptions = <int>[
      30,
      60,
      120,
      300,
      600,
    ];

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.screenSettings),
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: [
          Card(
            child: SwitchListTile(
              secondary: const Icon(
                Icons.animation,
                color: Colors.deepPurple,
              ),
              title: Text(l10n.screenSaverTitle),
              subtitle: Text(l10n.screenSaverSubtitle),
              value: _enabled,
              onChanged: _setEnabled,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Card(
            child: SwitchListTile(
              secondary: const Icon(
                Icons.directions_run,
                color: Colors.teal,
              ),
              title: Text(l10n.screenSaverMotionWakeTitle),
              subtitle: Text(l10n.screenSaverMotionWakeSubtitle),
              value: _motionWakeEnabled,
              onChanged: _enabled ? _setMotionWakeEnabled : null,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Card(
            child: Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.tune),
                      const SizedBox(width: 12),
                      Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          l10n.screenSaverSensitivity(_motionSensitivity),
                          style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  Slider(
                    value: _motionSensitivity.toDouble(),
                    min: 0,
                    max: 100,
                    divisions: 20,
                    label: '$_motionSensitivity%',
                    onChanged: !_enabled || !_motionWakeEnabled
                        ? null
                        : (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _motionSensitivity = value.round();
                      });
                    },
                    onChangeEnd: !_enabled || !_motionWakeEnabled
                        ? null
                        : (value) {
                      _setMotionSensitivity(value.round());
                    },
                  ),
                  Row(
                    mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
                    children: [
                      Text(l10n.screenSaverSensitivityLow),
                      Text(l10n.screenSaverSensitivityHigh),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  Text(
                    l10n.screenSaverSensitivityHint,
                    style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.timer_outlined),
              title: Text(l10n.screenSaverTimeoutTitle),
              subtitle: Text(_timeoutLabel(l10n, _idleTimeoutSeconds)),
              enabled: _enabled,
              trailing: DropdownButton<int>(
                value: timeoutOptions.contains(_idleTimeoutSeconds)
                    ? _idleTimeoutSeconds
                    : null,
                hint: Text(l10n.screenSaverChoose),
                items: timeoutOptions
                    .map(
                      (seconds) => DropdownMenuItem<int>(
                    value: seconds,
                    child: Text(_timeoutLabel(l10n, seconds)),
                  ),
                )
                    .toList(),
                onChanged: !_enabled
                    ? null
                    : (seconds) {
                  if (seconds != null) {
                    _setIdleTimeout(seconds);
                  }
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

typedef StatsSettingReader = Future<String?> Function(String key);

class SettingsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SettingsScreen({
    super.key,
    this.statsSettingReader,
  });

  /// Позволяет подменить чтение настроек в widget-тестах.
  /// В приложении по умолчанию читается AppDatabase.
  final StatsSettingReader? statsSettingReader;

  @override
  State<SettingsScreen> createState() => _SettingsScreenState();
}

class _SettingsScreenState extends State<SettingsScreen> {
  int _pollIntervalMs = AdaptivePoller.defaultIntervalMs;

  late Future<String?> _eventsRetentionFuture;
  late Future<String?> _electricityTariffFuture;

  Future<String?> _readStatsSetting(String key) {
    final reader = widget.statsSettingReader;
    if (reader != null) {
      return reader(key);
    }
    return AppDatabase.getStatsSetting(key);
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    _eventsRetentionFuture =
        _readStatsSetting('events_retention_days');
    _electricityTariffFuture =
        _readStatsSetting('electricity_tariff_rub_per_kwh');

    _loadSettings();
  }

  Future<void> _loadSettings() async {
    final interval = await AdaptivePoller.readIntervalMs();
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _pollIntervalMs = interval);
  }

  Future<void> _refreshEventsRetention() async {
    setState(() {
      _eventsRetentionFuture =
          _readStatsSetting('events_retention_days');
    });
  }

  Future<void> _refreshElectricityTariff() async {
    setState(() {
      _electricityTariffFuture =
          _readStatsSetting('electricity_tariff_rub_per_kwh');
    });
  }

  String _formatInterval(int milliseconds, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    if (milliseconds >= 60000 && milliseconds % 60000 == 0) {
      return l10n.settingsIntervalMinutes(milliseconds ~/ 60000);
    }

    return l10n.settingsIntervalSeconds(
      (milliseconds / 1000).round(),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ЭКСПОРТ / ИМПОРТ
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Future<void> _exportConfig() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    try {
      await ConfigService.exportConfig();
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.settingsExportReady)),
      );
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.settingsError(error.toString()))),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _importConfig() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    try {
      await ConfigService.importConfig();
      if (!mounted) return;

      final restart = await showDialog<bool>(
        context: context,
        builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.settingsImportDone),
          content: Text(l10n.settingsImportRestartHint),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, false),
              child: Text(l10n.settingsLater),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, true),
              child: Text(l10n.settingsRestart),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );

      if (restart == true) {
        await Restart.restartApp();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.settingsError(error.toString()))),
      );
    }
  }

  void _showBackupDialog() {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => SimpleDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.settingsBackupDialogTitle),
        children: [
          SimpleDialogOption(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              _exportConfig();
            },
            child: ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.upload, color: Colors.blue),
              title: Text(l10n.settingsExport),
              subtitle: Text(l10n.settingsExportSubtitle),
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            ),
          ),
          SimpleDialogOption(
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              _importConfig();
            },
            child: ListTile(
              leading: const Icon(Icons.download, color: Colors.green),
              title: Text(l10n.settingsImport),
              subtitle: Text(l10n.settingsImportSubtitle),
              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ИНТЕРВАЛ ОПРОСА
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Future<void> _selectPollInterval() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final selected = await showDialog<int>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => SimpleDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.settingsPollInterval),
        children: AdaptivePoller.intervalOptions.keys.map((milliseconds) {
          return SimpleDialogOption(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, milliseconds),
            child: Text(_formatInterval(milliseconds, l10n)),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );

    if (!mounted || selected == null) return;

    await AdaptivePoller.writeIntervalMs(selected);
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _pollIntervalMs = selected);

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          l10n.settingsPollIntervalChanged(
            _formatInterval(selected, l10n),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ХРАНЕНИЕ СОБЫТИЙ
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Future<void> _selectEventsRetention() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final current =
        await AppDatabase.getStatsSetting('events_retention_days') ?? '30';

    if (!mounted) return;

    final selected = await showDialog<int>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => SimpleDialog(
        title: Text(l10n.settingsRetentionDialogTitle),
        children: [30, 60, 90, 365].map((days) {
          return SimpleDialogOption(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext, days),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                if (days.toString() == current)
                  const Icon(
                    Icons.check,
                    color: Colors.green,
                    size: 18,
                  ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(l10n.settingsRetentionDays(days)),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );

    if (selected == null) return;

    await AppDatabase.setStatsSetting(
      'events_retention_days',
      '$selected',
    );

    if (!mounted) return;
    await _refreshEventsRetention();
  }

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // ТАРИФ ЭЛЕКТРОЭНЕРГИИ
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  Future<void> _editElectricityTariff() async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final current = await AppDatabase.getStatsSetting(
      'electricity_tariff_rub_per_kwh',
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    final result = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _ElectricityTariffDialog(
        initialValue: current ?? '5.5',
      ),
    );

    if (!mounted || result == null || result.trim().isEmpty) return;

    final normalized = result.trim().replaceAll(',', '.');
    final parsed = double.tryParse(normalized);

    if (parsed == null || parsed <= 0) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.settingsTariffInvalid)),
      );
      return;
    }

    await AppDatabase.setStatsSetting(
      'electricity_tariff_rub_per_kwh',
      normalized,
    );

    if (!mounted) return;
    await _refreshElectricityTariff();
  }

  // BUILD
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  const _ElectricityTariffDialog({
    required this.initialValue,
  });

  final String initialValue;

  State<_ElectricityTariffDialog> createState() =>
      _ElectricityTariffDialogState();

class _ElectricityTariffDialogState
    extends State<_ElectricityTariffDialog> {
  late final TextEditingController _controller;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = TextEditingController(text: widget.initialValue);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return AlertDialog(
      title: Text(l10n.settingsTariffDialogTitle),
      content: TextField(
        controller: _controller,
        autofocus: true,
        keyboardType: const TextInputType.numberWithOptions(decimal: true),
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          hintText: l10n.settingsTariffHint,
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
          child: Text(l10n.cancel),
        ),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: () {
            Navigator.of(context).pop(_controller.text);
          },
          child: Text(l10n.save),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => AlertDialog(

        content: Column(

          children: [

                hintText: l10n.smsSettingsNameHint,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            TextField(
              controller: phoneController,
              decoration: InputDecoration(
                labelText: l10n.smsSettingsPhoneLabel,
                hintText: l10n.smsSettingsPhoneHint,
              ),
              keyboardType: TextInputType.phone,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
            child: Text(l10n.smsSettingsCancel),

          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () {
              final phone = phoneController.text.trim();

              );

              Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
            },
            child: Text(l10n.smsSettingsAdd),

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class StatsClimateTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const StatsClimateTab({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<StatsClimateTab> createState() => _StatsClimateTabState();
}

class _StatsClimateTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsClimateTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  List<Map<String, Object?>> _stats = const [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));

    final stats = await AppDatabase.getClimateStats(
      fromDate: _formatDate(from),
      toDate: _formatDate(now),
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _stats = stats;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  String _numberOrDash(double? value, {int decimals = 1}) {
    return value?.toStringAsFixed(decimals) ?? '—';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod30d),
              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},
            onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (_stats.isEmpty)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(l10n.statsNoClimateData),
              ),
            )
          else ...[
              Text(
                l10n.statsClimateByDevice,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              ..._stats.map((row) {
                final name = row['deviceName'] as String? ?? '—';
                final temperatureMin =
                (row['t_min'] as num?)?.toDouble();
                final temperatureMax =
                (row['t_max'] as num?)?.toDouble();
                final temperatureAverage =
                (row['t_avg'] as num?)?.toDouble();

                final humidityMin =
                (row['h_min'] as num?)?.toDouble();
                final humidityMax =
                (row['h_max'] as num?)?.toDouble();
                final humidityAverage =
                (row['h_avg'] as num?)?.toDouble();

                final samples = (row['samples'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;

                return Card(
                  child: Padding(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Row(
                          children: [
                            const Icon(
                              Icons.thermostat,
                              color: Colors.red,
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(width: 8),
