import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/sparkline.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/uptime_bar.dart';

class StatsDevicesTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const StatsDevicesTab({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<StatsDevicesTab> createState() => _StatsDevicesTabState();
}

class _StatsDevicesTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsDevicesTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  List<Map<String, Object?>> _rows = const [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));

    final rows = await AppDatabase.getDeviceUptime(
      fromDate: _formatDate(from),
      toDate: _formatDate(now),
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _rows = rows;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final devices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);

    String nameOf(String id) {
      for (final device in devices) {
        if (device.id == id) return device.name;
      }
      return id;
    }

    return Column(
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod30d),
              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},
            onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
        ),
        Expanded(
          child: _loading
              ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
              : _rows.isEmpty
              ? Center(
            child: Text(l10n.statsNoDeviceDataPeriod),
          )
              : ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
            itemCount: _rows.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              final row = _rows[index];
              final id = row['device_id'] as String;
              final ratio =
              (row['uptime_ratio'] as num?)?.toDouble();
              final alerts =
                  (row['alerts'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
              final actions =
                  (row['actions'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
              final offline =
                  (row['offline'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;
              final deviceName = nameOf(id);

              return Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  title: Text(deviceName),
                  subtitle: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      UptimeBar(ratio: ratio),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        l10n.statsDeviceEventCounts(
                          offline,
                          alerts,
                          actions,
                        ),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: Colors.grey,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  trailing: Text(
                    ratio == null
                        ? '—'
                        : '${(ratio * 100).toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: ratio == null
                          ? Colors.grey
                          : ratio >= 0.95
                          ? Colors.green
                          : ratio >= 0.80
                          ? Colors.orange
                          : Colors.red,
                    ),
                  ),
                  onTap: () => _openDetail(
                    context,
                    id,
                    deviceName,
                    l10n,
                  ),
                ),
              );
            },
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _openDetail(
      BuildContext context,
      String id,
      String name,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));

    final series = await AppDatabase.getDeviceDailySeries(
      deviceId: id,
      fromDate: _formatDate(from),
      toDate: _formatDate(now),
    );

    if (!context.mounted) return;

    final alertsSeries = series
        .map((entry) => (entry['alert_count'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0)
        .toList();
    final offlineSeries = series
        .map((entry) => (entry['offline_count'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0)
        .toList();

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      showDragHandle: true,
      builder: (sheetContext) => Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text(
              name,
              style: Theme.of(sheetContext).textTheme.titleLarge,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              l10n.statsAlertsForDays(_days),
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            Sparkline(
              values: alertsSeries,
              color: Colors.red,
              height: 60,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              l10n.statsOfflineForDays(_days),
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            Sparkline(
              values: offlineSeries,
              color: Colors.grey,
              height: 60,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/stat_card.dart';

class StatsEnergyTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const StatsEnergyTab({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<StatsEnergyTab> createState() => _StatsEnergyTabState();
}

class _StatsEnergyTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsEnergyTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, double> _deviceTotals = const {};
  double _totalKwh = 0;
  double _tariff = 5.5;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final tariffString = await AppDatabase.getStatsSetting(
      'electricity_tariff_rub_per_kwh',
    );
    final data = await AppDatabase.getEnergyStats(days: _days);

    final totals = <String, double>{};
    var totalKwh = 0.0;

    for (final row in data) {
      final name = row['deviceName'] as String? ?? '—';
      final kwh = (row['totalEnergy'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;

      totals[name] = (totals[name] ?? 0) + kwh;
      totalKwh += kwh;
    }

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _tariff = double.tryParse(tariffString ?? '5.5') ?? 5.5;
      _deviceTotals = totals;
      _totalKwh = totalKwh;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod30d),
              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},
            onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else ...[
            GridView.count(
              crossAxisCount: 2,
              shrinkWrap: true,
              physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
              mainAxisSpacing: 8,
              crossAxisSpacing: 8,
              childAspectRatio: 1.2,
              children: [
                StatCard(
                  label: l10n.statsEnergyConsumption,
                  value: l10n.statsEnergyKwh(
                    _totalKwh.toStringAsFixed(2),
                  ),
                  icon: Icons.bolt,
                  color: Colors.amber,
                  subtitle: l10n.statsEnergyPeriod(_days),
                ),
                StatCard(
                  label: l10n.statsEnergyCost,
                  value: l10n.statsEnergyRubles(
                    (_totalKwh * _tariff).toStringAsFixed(0),
                  ),
                  icon: Icons.payments,
                  color: Colors.green,
                  subtitle: l10n.statsEnergyTariff(
                    _tariff.toString(),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            if (_deviceTotals.isEmpty)
              Card(
                child: Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                  child: Text(l10n.statsEnergyNoData),
                ),
              )
            else ...[
              Text(
                l10n.statsEnergyByDevice,
                style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              ...(_deviceTotals.entries.toList()
                ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value)))
                  .map(
                    (entry) => Card(
                  child: ListTile(
                    title: Text(entry.key),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      l10n.statsEnergyRubles(
                        (entry.value * _tariff).toStringAsFixed(0),
                      ),
                    ),
                    trailing: Text(
                      l10n.statsEnergyKwh(
                        entry.value.toStringAsFixed(2),
                      ),
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatsNotificationsTabState
    extends ConsumerState<StatsNotificationsTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, int> _totals = const {};
  List<Map<String, Object?>> _byCategory = const [];
  Map<String, Map<String, int>> _byChannel = const {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));
    final fromDate = _formatDate(from);
    final toDate = _formatDate(now);

    final totals = await AppDatabase.getNotificationTotals(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );
    final byCategory = await AppDatabase.getNotificationByCategory(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );
    final byChannel = await AppDatabase.getNotificationByChannel(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _totals = totals;
      _byCategory = byCategory;
      _byChannel = byChannel;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final sent = _totals['sent'] ?? 0;
    final suppressed = _totals['suppressed'] ?? 0;
    final total = sent + suppressed;
    final suppressedPercent =
    total == 0 ? 0 : suppressed * 100 ~/ total;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod30d),
              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},
            onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (total == 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(l10n.statsNotificationsEmpty),
              ),
            )
          else ...[
              GridView.count(
                crossAxisCount: 2,
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),

                    value: '$sent',

                  StatCard(
                    label: l10n.statsNotificationsSuppressed,
                    value: '$suppressed',
                    icon: Icons.block,
                    color: Colors.orange,
                    subtitle: l10n.statsNotificationsCooldownPercent(
                      suppressedPercent,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),

              if (_byChannel.isNotEmpty) ...[
                Text(
                  l10n.statsNotificationsByChannel,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Card(

                        final channelSent = entry.value['sent'] ?? 0;

                        return ListTile(

  String _categoryLabel(String category, AppLocalizations l10n) {

class _CategoryBarChart extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CategoryBarChart({
    required this.data,
    required this.l10n,
  });

  final List<Map<String, Object?>> data;
  final AppLocalizations l10n;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final top = data.take(6).toList();

    final maxY = top.isEmpty
        ? 1.0
        : top
        .map((row) => (row['sent'] as num).toInt())
        .reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b)
        .toDouble() *
        1.2;

    return BarChart(
      BarChartData(
        maxY: maxY,
        barGroups: top.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
          return BarChartGroupData(
            x: entry.key,
            barRods: [
              BarChartRodData(
                toY: (entry.value['sent'] as num).toDouble(),
                color: Colors.blue,
                width: 16,
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                  top: Radius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        }).toList(),
        titlesData: FlTitlesData(
          bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
                final index = value.toInt();
                if (index < 0 || index >= top.length) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                }

                final category = top[index]['category'] as String;
                final label = _categoryLabel(category, l10n);
                final shortLabel =
                label.length > 8 ? '${label.substring(0, 8)}…' : label;

                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(
                    shortLabel,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          leftTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              reservedSize: 30,
            ),
          ),
          topTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
          rightTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
        ),
        gridData: const FlGridData(
          show: true,
          drawVerticalLine: false,
        ),
        borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _categoryLabel(String category, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (category) {
      case 'water_leak':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryWaterLeak;
      case 'smoke':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategorySmoke;
      case 'gas':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryGas;
      case 'motion':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryMotion;
      case 'contact':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryContact;
      case 'person':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryPerson;
      case 'car':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryCar;
      case 'offline':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryOffline;
      case 'low_battery':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryLowBattery;
      case 'state_changed':
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryStateChanged;
      default:
        return l10n.statsNotificationsCategoryUnknown;
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/stat_card.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/uptime_bar.dart';

class StatsOverviewTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const StatsOverviewTab({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<StatsOverviewTab> createState() => _StatsOverviewTabState();
}

class _StatsOverviewTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsOverviewTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, int> _totals = const {};
  List<Map<String, Object?>> _worst = const [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));
    final fromDate = _formatDate(from);
    final toDate = _formatDate(now);

    final totals = await AppDatabase.getStatsTotals(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );
    final uptime = await AppDatabase.getDeviceUptime(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );

    final worst = uptime
        .where(
          (row) =>
      row['uptime_ratio'] != null &&
          (row['uptime_ratio'] as double) < 1.0,
    )
        .take(3)
        .toList();

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _totals = totals;
      _worst = worst;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final devices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);

    String nameOf(String id) {
      for (final device in devices) {
        if (device.id == id) return device.name;
      }
      return id;
    }

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import '../../widgets/stats/stat_card.dart';

class StatsPresenceTab extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const StatsPresenceTab({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<StatsPresenceTab> createState() =>
      _StatsPresenceTabState();
}

class _StatsPresenceTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsPresenceTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, int> _totals = const {};

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));

    final totals = await AppDatabase.getPresenceTotals(
      fromDate: _formatDate(from),
      toDate: _formatDate(now),
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _totals = totals;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  String _formatDuration(int seconds, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    if (seconds <= 0) {
      return l10n.statsPresenceDurationZero;
    }

    final hours = seconds ~/ 3600;
    final minutes = (seconds % 3600) ~/ 60;

    if (hours > 0) {
      return l10n.statsPresenceDurationHoursMinutes(hours, minutes);
    }

    if (minutes > 0) {
      return l10n.statsPresenceDurationMinutes(minutes);
    }

    return l10n.statsPresenceDurationLessMinute;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    final totalSeconds = _totals.values.fold<int>(
      0,
          (sum, value) => sum + value,
    );
    final homePercent = totalSeconds == 0
        ? 0
        : (_totals['home'] ?? 0) * 100 ~/ totalSeconds;

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod30d),
              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},
            onSelectionChanged: (selection) {
              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (totalSeconds == 0)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(l10n.statsPresenceEmpty),
              ),
            )
          else ...[
              GridView.count(
                crossAxisCount: 2,
                shrinkWrap: true,
                physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                mainAxisSpacing: 8,
                crossAxisSpacing: 8,
                childAspectRatio: 1.9,
                children: [
                  StatCard(
                    label: l10n.statsPresenceHome,
                    value: '$homePercent%',
                    icon: Icons.home,
                    color: Colors.green,
                    subtitle: _formatDuration(
                      _totals['home'] ?? 0,
                      l10n,
                    ),
                  ),
                  StatCard(
                    label: l10n.statsPresenceNear,
                    value: _formatDuration(_totals['near'] ?? 0, l10n),
                    icon: Icons.near_me,
                    color: Colors.orange,
                    subtitle: l10n.statsPresencePeriod(_days),
                  ),
                  StatCard(
                    label: l10n.statsPresenceAway,
                    value: _formatDuration(_totals['away'] ?? 0, l10n),
                    icon: Icons.directions_walk,
                    color: Colors.blueGrey,
                    subtitle: l10n.statsPresencePeriod(_days),
                  ),
                  StatCard(
                    label: l10n.statsPresenceUnknown,
                    value: _formatDuration(_totals['unknown'] ?? 0, l10n),
                    icon: Icons.help_outline,
                    color: Colors.grey,
                    subtitle: l10n.statsPresencePeriod(_days),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              Card(
                child: ListTile(
                  leading: const Icon(Icons.cloud, color: Colors.blue),
                  title: Text(l10n.statsPresenceCloudFallback),
                  subtitle: Text(l10n.statsPresenceCloudFallbackSubtitle),
                  trailing: Text(
                    '${_totals['cloud'] ?? 0}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 18,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatsScenesTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsScenesTab> {

  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, int> _sceneStats = const {};
  List<String> _forgotten = const [];

  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();

    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));
    final fromDate = _formatDate(from);
    final toDate = _formatDate(now);

      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );

        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';

class _SceneBarChart extends StatelessWidget {
  const _SceneBarChart({
    required this.data,
    required this.l10n,
  });

  final Map<String, int> data;
  final AppLocalizations l10n;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final entries = data.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));
    final top = entries.take(5).toList();
    final maxY = top.isEmpty ? 1.0 : top.first.value.toDouble() * 1.2;

    return BarChart(
      BarChartData(
        maxY: maxY,
        barGroups: top.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
          return BarChartGroupData(
            x: entry.key,
            barRods: [
              BarChartRodData(
                toY: entry.value.value.toDouble(),
                color: Colors.purple,
                width: 20,
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                  top: Radius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        }).toList(),
        titlesData: FlTitlesData(
          bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
                final index = value.toInt();
                if (index < 0 || index >= top.length) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                }

                // Подпись на графике — имя сцены пользователя.
                final sceneName = top[index].key;
                final label = sceneName.length > 8
                    ? '${sceneName.substring(0, 8)}…'
                    : sceneName;

                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(
                    label,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          leftTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              reservedSize: 30,
            ),
          ),
          topTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
          rightTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
        ),
        gridData: const FlGridData(
          show: true,
          drawVerticalLine: false,
        ),
        borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import 'package:shome/l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

import 'stats_climate_tab.dart';

class StatsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const StatsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<StatsScreen> createState() => _StatsScreenState();
}

class _StatsScreenState extends State<StatsScreen> {
  int _selectedIndex = 0;

  List<_StatTab> _tabs(AppLocalizations l10n) => [
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabOverview, icon: Icons.dashboard),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabDevices, icon: Icons.devices),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabEnergy, icon: Icons.bolt),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabVideo, icon: Icons.videocam),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabScenes, icon: Icons.movie),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabPresence, icon: Icons.location_on),
    _StatTab(label: l10n.statsTabClimate, icon: Icons.thermostat),
    _StatTab(
      label: l10n.statsTabNotifications,
      icon: Icons.notifications,
    ),
  ];

  Widget _buildContent() {
    switch (_selectedIndex) {
      case 0:
        return const StatsOverviewTab();
      case 1:
        return const StatsDevicesTab();
      case 2:
        return const StatsEnergyTab();
      case 3:
        return const StatsVideoTab();
      case 4:
        return const StatsScenesTab();
      case 5:
        return const StatsPresenceTab();
      case 6:
        return const StatsClimateTab();
      case 7:
        return const StatsNotificationsTab();
      default:
        return const StatsOverviewTab();
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final tabs = _tabs(l10n);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.statsTitle),
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          SizedBox(
            height: 90,
            child: ListView.builder(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                horizontal: 8,
                vertical: 4,
              ),
              itemCount: tabs.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) => _StatTile(
                tab: tabs[index],
                selected: _selectedIndex == index,
                onTap: () {
                  setState(() => _selectedIndex = index);
                },
              ),
            ),
          ),
          const Divider(height: 1),
          Expanded(child: _buildContent()),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatTab {
  const _StatTab({
    required this.label,
    required this.icon,
  });

  final String label;
  final IconData icon;
}

class _StatTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _StatTile({
    required this.tab,
    required this.selected,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final _StatTab tab;
  final bool selected;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final color = selected
        ? Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary
        : Colors.grey;

    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: onTap,
      child: AnimatedContainer(
        duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 200),
        width: 100,
        margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: selected
              ? color.withValues(alpha: 0.15)
              : Colors.transparent,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
          border: Border.all(
            color: selected
                ? color
                : Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
            width: selected ? 2 : 1,
          ),
        ),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(tab.icon, color: color, size: 28),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Text(
              tab.label,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 11,
                fontWeight:
                selected ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
                color: selected ? color : null,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _StatsVideoTabState extends ConsumerState<StatsVideoTab> {
  int _days = 7;
  bool _loading = true;
  Map<String, int> _byLabel = const {};
  Map<String, int> _byCamera = const {};
  List<Map<String, Object?>> _hourly = const [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _load();
  }

  Future<void> _load() async {
    setState(() => _loading = true);

    final now = DateTime.now();
    final from = now.subtract(Duration(days: _days - 1));
    final fromDate = _formatDate(from);
    final toDate = _formatDate(now);

    final byLabel = await AppDatabase.getFrigateDetectionsByLabel(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );
    final byCamera = await AppDatabase.getFrigateDetectionsByCamera(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );
    final hourly = await AppDatabase.getFrigateHourlyHeatmap(
      fromDate: fromDate,
      toDate: toDate,
    );

    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() {
      _byLabel = byLabel;
      _byCamera = byCamera;
      _hourly = hourly;
      _loading = false;
    });
  }

  String _formatDate(DateTime date) {
    return '${date.year.toString().padLeft(4, '0')}-'
        '${date.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}-'
        '${date.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  String _localizedLabel(String label, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    switch (label.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'person':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelPerson;
      case 'car':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelCar;
      case 'dog':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelDog;
      case 'cat':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelCat;
      case 'bird':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelBird;
      case 'motorcycle':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelMotorcycle;
      case 'bicycle':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelBicycle;
      case 'truck':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelTruck;
      case 'bus':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelBus;
      case 'boat':
        return l10n.statsVideoLabelBoat;
      default:
      // Неизвестная метка Frigate — исходное значение.
        return label;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return RefreshIndicator(
      onRefresh: _load,
      child: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<int>(
            segments: [
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 1,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod24h),
              ),

                value: 7,
                label: Text(l10n.statsPeriod7d),
              ),
              ButtonSegment(
                value: 30,

              ),
            ],
            selected: {_days},

              setState(() => _days = selection.first);
              _load();
            },
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          if (_loading)
            const Padding(
              padding: EdgeInsets.all(32),
              child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
            )
          else if (_byLabel.isEmpty && _byCamera.isEmpty)
            Card(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Text(l10n.statsVideoEmpty),
              ),
            )
          else ...[
              if (_byLabel.isNotEmpty) ...[
                Text(
                  l10n.statsVideoByTypes,
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.titleMedium,
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                Card(

  }

class _DetectionDonut extends StatelessWidget {
  const _DetectionDonut({
    required this.data,
    required this.l10n,
    required this.labelBuilder,
  });

  final Map<String, int> data;
  final AppLocalizations l10n;
  final String Function(String label, AppLocalizations l10n) labelBuilder;

  static const _colors = [
    Colors.red,
    Colors.blue,
    Colors.green,
    Colors.orange,
    Colors.purple,
    Colors.teal,
    Colors.pink,
    Colors.amber,
  ];

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final total = data.values.fold<int>(0, (sum, count) => sum + count);
    final entries = data.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));

    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: PieChart(
            PieChartData(
              sectionsSpace: 2,
              centerSpaceRadius: 40,
              sections: entries.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                final index = entry.key;
                final item = entry.value;
                final percent =
                total == 0 ? 0.0 : item.value * 100 / total;

                return PieChartSectionData(
                  value: item.value.toDouble(),
                  title: '${percent.toStringAsFixed(0)}%',
                  color: _colors[index % _colors.length],
                  radius: 50,
                  titleStyle: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 10,
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                );
              }).toList(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Flexible(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: entries.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
              final index = entry.key;
              final item = entry.value;

              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                child: Row(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    Container(
                      width: 10,
                      height: 10,
                      color: _colors[index % _colors.length],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                    Flexible(
                      child: Text(
                        '${labelBuilder(item.key, l10n)}: ${item.value}',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

class _CameraBarChart extends StatelessWidget {
  const _CameraBarChart({required this.data});

  final Map<String, int> data;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final entries = data.entries.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));
    final maxY =
    entries.isEmpty ? 1.0 : entries.first.value.toDouble() * 1.2;

    return BarChart(
      BarChartData(
        maxY: maxY,
        barGroups: entries.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
          return BarChartGroupData(
            x: entry.key,
            barRods: [
              BarChartRodData(
                toY: entry.value.value.toDouble(),
                color: Colors.blue,
                width: 16,
                borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(
                  top: Radius.circular(4),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        }).toList(),
        titlesData: FlTitlesData(
          bottomTitles: AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              getTitlesWidget: (value, meta) {
                final index = value.toInt();
                if (index < 0 || index >= entries.length) {
                  return const SizedBox.shrink();
                }

                // Название камеры — пользовательская конфигурация Frigate.
                return Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 4),
                  child: Text(
                    entries[index].key,
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
          leftTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(
              showTitles: true,
              reservedSize: 30,
            ),
          ),
          topTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
          rightTitles: const AxisTitles(
            sideTitles: SideTitles(showTitles: false),
          ),
        ),
        gridData: const FlGridData(
          show: true,
          drawVerticalLine: false,
        ),
        borderData: FlBorderData(show: false),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class _HourHeatmap extends StatelessWidget {
  const _HourHeatmap({
    required this.data,
    required this.l10n,
  });

  final List<Map<String, Object?>> data;
  final AppLocalizations l10n;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final byDate = <String, Map<int, int>>{};

    for (final row in data) {
      final date = row['date'] as String;
      final hour = (row['hour'] as num).toInt();
      final count = (row['count'] as num).toInt();

      byDate.putIfAbsent(date, () => {});
      byDate[date]![hour] = count;
    }

    final dates = byDate.keys.toList()..sort();
    final maxCount = data.fold<int>(
      1,
          (maximum, row) {
        final count = (row['count'] as num).toInt();
        return count > maximum ? count : maximum;
      },
    );

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            const SizedBox(width: 60),
            ...List.generate(
              24,
                  (hour) => Expanded(
                child: Text(
                  hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0'),
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 8,
                    color: Colors.grey,
                  ),
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        ...dates.map((date) {
          final hours = byDate[date]!;

          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 1),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                SizedBox(
                  width: 60,
                  child: Text(
                    date.substring(5),
                    style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10),
                  ),
                ),
                ...List.generate(24, (hour) {
                  final count = hours[hour] ?? 0;
                  final intensity = count == 0
                      ? 0.0
                      : (count / maxCount).clamp(0.0, 1.0);

                  return Expanded(
                    child: Container(
                      height: 16,
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.all(0.5),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: count == 0
                            ? Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.1)
                            : Colors.blue.withValues(
                          alpha: 0.2 + intensity * 0.8,
                        ),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(2),
                      ),
                      child: count == 0
                          ? null
                          : Center(
                        child: Text(
                          '$count',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 8,
                            color: Colors.white,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }),
        const SizedBox(height: 8),
        Text(
          l10n.statsVideoHeatmapHint,
          style: const TextStyle(
            fontSize: 10,
            color: Colors.grey,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

/// Экран таймеров — отложенное включение/выключение устройств.
library;

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:uuid/uuid.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../data/local/database.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device_timer.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class TimersScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const TimersScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<TimersScreen> createState() => _TimersScreenState();
}

class _TimersScreenState extends ConsumerState<TimersScreen> {
  List<DeviceTimer> _timers = [];
  Timer? _refreshTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadTimers();

    // Обновляем обратный отсчёт раз в минуту.
    _refreshTimer = Timer.periodic(
      const Duration(minutes: 1),
          (_) {
        if (mounted) setState(() {});
      },
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _refreshTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadTimers() async {
    final timers = await AppDatabase.getActiveTimers();
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _timers = timers);
  }

  String _formatTime(DateTime dateTime) {
    return '${dateTime.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
        '${dateTime.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
  }

  String _countdown(
      DateTime executeAt,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final difference = executeAt.difference(DateTime.now());

    if (difference.isNegative) {
      return l10n.timersAlreadyFired;
    }

    final hours = difference.inHours;
    final minutes = difference.inMinutes.remainder(60);

    if (hours > 0) {
      return l10n.timersCountdownHoursMinutes(hours, minutes);
    }

    if (minutes > 0) {
      return l10n.timersCountdownMinutes(minutes);
    }

    return l10n.timersLessThanMinute;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final devices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);

    final controllableDevices = devices
        .where(
          (device) =>
      device.type == DeviceType.outlet ||
          device.type == DeviceType.light,
    )
        .toList();

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.timersTitle),
      ),
      body: _timers.isEmpty
          ? Center(child: Text(l10n.timersEmpty))
          : ListView.builder(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        itemCount: _timers.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final timer = _timers[index];
          final isTurnOn = timer.command == 'turnOn';

          return Card(
            child: ListTile(
              leading: Icon(
                isTurnOn
                    ? Icons.power_settings_new
                    : Icons.power_off,
                color: isTurnOn ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
              ),
              title: Text(timer.deviceName),
              subtitle: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    '${isTurnOn ? l10n.timersTurnOn : l10n.timersTurnOff} '
                        '${_countdown(timer.executeAt, l10n)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    ),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    l10n.timersTodayAt(
                      _formatTime(timer.executeAt),
                    ),
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.grey,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              trailing: IconButton(
                tooltip: l10n.timersDeleteTooltip,
                icon: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                onPressed: () async {
                  await AppDatabase.deleteTimer(timer.id);
                  await _loadTimers();
                },
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _showAddTimerDialog(
          context,
          controllableDevices,
        ),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showAddTimerDialog(
      BuildContext context,
      List<Device> devices,
      ) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    Device? selectedDevice;
    var command = 'turnOff';
    var selectedTime = TimeOfDay.now();

    showDialog<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (dialogContext, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.timersNewTitle),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                DropdownButtonFormField<Device>(
                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    labelText: l10n.timersDeviceLabel,
                  ),
                  items: devices
                      .map(
                        (device) => DropdownMenuItem<Device>(
                      value: device,
                      child: Text(device.name),
                    ),
                  )
                      .toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setDialogState(() => selectedDevice = value);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                SegmentedButton<String>(
                  segments: [
                    ButtonSegment(
                      value: 'turnOff',
                      label: Text(l10n.timersCommandOff),
                    ),
                    ButtonSegment(
                      value: 'turnOn',
                      label: Text(l10n.timersCommandOn),
                    ),
                  ],
                  selected: {command},
                  onSelectionChanged: (values) {
                    setDialogState(() => command = values.first);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 12),
                ListTile(
                  title: Text(
                    _formatTime(
                      DateTime(
                        2024,
                        1,
                        1,
                        selectedTime.hour,
                        selectedTime.minute,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  trailing: const Icon(Icons.access_time),
                  onTap: () async {
                    final time = await showTimePicker(
                      context: dialogContext,
                      initialTime: selectedTime,
                    );

                    if (time != null) {
                      setDialogState(() => selectedTime = time);
                    }
                  },
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogContext),
              child: Text(l10n.timersCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                final device = selectedDevice;
                if (device == null) return;

                final now = DateTime.now();
                final executeAt = DateTime(
                  now.year,
                  now.month,
                  now.day,
                  selectedTime.hour,
                  selectedTime.minute,
                );

                final timer = DeviceTimer(
                  id: const Uuid().v4(),
                  deviceId: device.id,
                  deviceName: device.name,
                  command: command,
                  executeAt: executeAt.isBefore(now)
                      ? executeAt.add(const Duration(days: 1))
                      : executeAt,
                  executed: false,
                );

                await AppDatabase.insertTimer(timer);
                if (!mounted) return;

                await _loadTimers();
                if (!dialogContext.mounted) return;

                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              },
              child: Text(l10n.timersCreate),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/rooms_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/zigbee_provider.dart';
import '../../data/mappers/zigbee_dps_mapper.dart';
import '../../data/protocols/zigbee_protocol.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../domain/models/zigbee_device.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class ZigbeeScanScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  const ZigbeeScanScreen({super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<ZigbeeScanScreen> createState() => _ZigbeeScanScreenState();
}

class _ZigbeeScanScreenState extends ConsumerState<ZigbeeScanScreen> {
  Timer? _timer;
  int _countdown = 0;
  bool _isPermitJoin = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _togglePermitJoin() async {
    final protocol = getIt<ZigbeeProtocol>();

    if (_isPermitJoin) {
      await protocol.permitJoin(false);
      _timer?.cancel();

      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _isPermitJoin = false;
        _countdown = 0;
      });
    } else {
      await protocol.permitJoin(true, time: 254);

      if (!mounted) return;

      setState(() {
        _isPermitJoin = true;
        _countdown = 254;
      });

      _timer?.cancel();
      _timer = Timer.periodic(const Duration(seconds: 1), (timer) {
        if (!mounted) {
          timer.cancel();
          return;
        }

        if (_countdown <= 1) {
          timer.cancel();
          setState(() {
            _isPermitJoin = false;
            _countdown = 0;
          });
        } else {
          setState(() => _countdown--);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _addDevice(ZigbeeDevice zigbeeDevice) async {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final devicesNotifier = ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier);
    final rooms = ref.read(roomsProvider);
    final roomId = rooms.isNotEmpty ? rooms.first.id : 'other';

    final dpsMap = ZigbeeDpsMapper.toDpsMap(zigbeeDevice.exposes);

    final device = Device(
      id: 'zigbee_${zigbeeDevice.ieeeAddress}',
      name: zigbeeDevice.friendlyName.isNotEmpty
          ? zigbeeDevice.friendlyName
          : zigbeeDevice.model,
      type: DeviceType.compound,
      roomId: roomId,
      isOnline: zigbeeDevice.available,
      state: zigbeeDevice.available
          ? DeviceState.online
          : DeviceState.offline,
      deviceId: zigbeeDevice.ieeeAddress,
      mqttTopic: 'zigbee2mqtt/${zigbeeDevice.friendlyName}',
      properties: {
        'source': 'zigbee',
        'friendly_name': zigbeeDevice.friendlyName,
        'ieee_address': zigbeeDevice.ieeeAddress,
        'model': zigbeeDevice.model,
        'vendor': zigbeeDevice.vendor,
        'exposes':
        zigbeeDevice.exposes.map((expose) => expose.toJson()).toList(),
        'dps_map': dpsMap,
        'isOn': false,
      },
    );

    await devicesNotifier.addDevice(device);

    if (!mounted) return;

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(content: Text(l10n.zigbeeDeviceAdded(device.name))),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    final zigbeeDevices = ref.watch(zigbeeDevicesProvider);
    final appDevices = ref.watch(devicesProvider);

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(l10n.zigbeeScanTitle),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            tooltip: l10n.zigbeeRefresh,
            onPressed: () {
              // Список bridge/devices обычно приходит из retained-сообщения.
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            child: Column(
              children: [
                SizedBox(
                  width: double.infinity,
                  child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: _togglePermitJoin,
                    icon: Icon(
                      _isPermitJoin ? Icons.stop : Icons.wifi_find,
                    ),
                    label: Text(
                      _isPermitJoin
                          ? l10n.zigbeeStopPairing(_countdown)
                          : l10n.zigbeeOpenPairing,
                    ),
                    style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                      backgroundColor:
                      _isPermitJoin ? Colors.orange : Colors.purple,
                      foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
                if (_isPermitJoin) ...[
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  LinearProgressIndicator(value: _countdown / 254),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  Text(
                    l10n.zigbeePairingInstruction,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.grey,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ],
            ),
          ),
          const Divider(),
          Expanded(
            child: zigbeeDevices.isEmpty
                ? Center(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),
                child: Text(
                  l10n.zigbeeNoDevices,
                  textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ),
            )
                : ListView.builder(
              itemCount: zigbeeDevices.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final zigbeeDevice = zigbeeDevices[index];
                final isAdded = appDevices.any(
                      (device) =>
                  device.deviceId == zigbeeDevice.ieeeAddress,
                );

                return Card(
                  margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 16,
                    vertical: 4,
                  ),
                  child: ListTile(
                    leading: Icon(
                      zigbeeDevice.isRouter
                          ? Icons.router
                          : Icons.sensors,
                      color: zigbeeDevice.available
                          ? Colors.purple
                          : Colors.grey,
                    ),
                    title: Text(
                      zigbeeDevice.friendlyName.isNotEmpty
                          ? zigbeeDevice.friendlyName
                          : zigbeeDevice.model,
                    ),
                    // Vendor, model и тип — данные устройства,
                    // оставляем их без перевода.
                    subtitle: Text(
                      '${zigbeeDevice.vendor} • '
                          '${zigbeeDevice.model} • '
                          '${zigbeeDevice.type}',
                    ),
                    trailing: isAdded
                        ? const Icon(
                      Icons.check_circle,
                      color: Colors.green,
                    )
                        : IconButton(
                      icon: const Icon(
                        Icons.add_circle,
                        color: Colors.purple,
                      ),
                      onPressed: () =>
                          _addDevice(zigbeeDevice),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Тема приложения — светлая и тёмная.
/// Использует Material 3 с Dynamic Color.
/// Цветовая схема генерируется из seedColor (primary).
library;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'colors.dart';

class AppTheme {
  /// Светлая тема Material 3.
  static ThemeData light() {
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: AppColors.primary,
        brightness: Brightness.light,
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Тёмная тема Material 3.
  static ThemeData dark() {
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: AppColors.primary,
        brightness: Brightness.dark,
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Компактная карточка для составных устройств (пылесос, кондиционер).
/// Показывает только информационные DP из dps_map.
/// По тапу открывает DeviceControlScreen.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import 'device_control_screen.dart';

class CompoundDeviceCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Device device;
  const CompoundDeviceCard({super.key, required this.device});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    // Получаем актуальное состояние устройства из провайдера
    final currentDevice = ref
        .watch(devicesProvider)
        .firstWhere((d) => d.id == device.id, orElse: () => device);

    final dpsMap = currentDevice.properties['dps_map'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};

    // Фильтруем DP: только info и status, у которых show_on_card != false
    final infoItems = dpsMap.entries.where((entry) {
      final config = entry.value as Map<String, dynamic>?;
      if (config == null) return false;
      final role = config['role'] as String? ?? '';
      if (role != 'info' && role != 'status') return false;
      return config['show_on_card'] != false;
    }).toList();

    // Контент без карточки, но с кликабельностью
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () {
        Navigator.push(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(
            builder: (_) => DeviceControlScreen(device: currentDevice),
          ),
        );
      },
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            // Если нет информационных полей — показываем заглушку
            if (infoItems.isEmpty)
              Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    currentDevice.isOnline ? Icons.circle : Icons.circle_outlined,
                    size: 12,
                    color: currentDevice.isOnline ? Colors.green : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Text(
                    currentDevice.isOnline ? 'Онлайн' : 'Офлайн',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: currentDevice.isOnline ? Colors.green : Colors.grey,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              )
            else ...[
              // Компактный список информационных полей
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              ...infoItems.map((entry) {
                final config = entry.value as Map<String, dynamic>;
                return _buildCompactInfoRow(
                  config: config,
                  currentValue: currentDevice.properties['dps_${entry.key}'] ??
                      currentDevice.properties[entry.key],
                );
              }),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Компактная строка с информацией — без лишних отступов
  Widget _buildCompactInfoRow({
    required Map<String, dynamic> config,
    dynamic currentValue,
  }) {
    final label = config['label'] as String? ?? '';
    final iconName = config['icon'] as String?;
    final displayValue = _formatValue(currentValue, config);

    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          if (iconName != null && iconName.isNotEmpty) ...[
            Icon(_getIcon(iconName), size: 14, color: Colors.grey[600]),
            const SizedBox(width: 6),
          ],
          // Лейбл
          Text(
            label,
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 11,
              color: Colors.grey[500],
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          // Точки-разделители
          Text('•', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey[400])),
          const SizedBox(width: 4),
          // Значение
          Expanded(
            child: Text(
              displayValue,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 12,
                color: Colors.grey[800],
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              ),
              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
              maxLines: 1,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Преобразует значение DP в читаемый вид
  String _formatValue(dynamic value, Map<String, dynamic> config) {
    if (value == null) return '--';
    final type = config['type'] as String? ?? '';
    if (type == 'value') {
      final unit = config['unit'] as String? ?? '';
      return '$value$unit';
    }
    if (type == 'bool') {
      return value == true || value == 'true' || value == 1 ? 'Вкл' : 'Выкл';
    }
    return value.toString();
  }

  /// Возвращает иконку по строковому ключу из dps_map
  IconData _getIcon(String iconName) {
    switch (iconName) {
      case 'battery':
        return Icons.battery_std;
      case 'timer':
        return Icons.timer;
      case 'area':
        return Icons.square_foot;
      case 'temp':
        return Icons.thermostat;
      case 'humidity':
        return Icons.water_drop;
      case 'power':
        return Icons.power;
      case 'water':
        return Icons.water;
      case 'fan':
        return Icons.air;
      default:
        return Icons.info_outline;
    }
  }
}

/// Карточка устройства — основной виджет для отображения устройства в сетке.
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';

import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';
import 'compound_device_card.dart';
import 'device_controls/camera_preview.dart';
import 'device_controls/curtain_info.dart';
import 'device_controls/multi_switch.dart';
import 'device_controls/power_button.dart';
import 'device_controls/sensor_info.dart';
import 'device_icons.dart';
import 'device_settings.dart';

class DeviceCard extends ConsumerWidget {
  const DeviceCard({
    super.key,
    required this.device,
  });

  final Device device;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    // Следим за актуальным состоянием и свойствами устройства,
    // например battery и linkquality.
    final latestDevice = ref.watch(
      devicesProvider.select(
            (list) => list.firstWhere(
              (item) => item.id == device.id,
          orElse: () => device,
        ),
      ),
    );

    final isOnline = latestDevice.state != DeviceState.offline;

    return Card(
      elevation: 3,
      color: Colors.white,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
            child: Column(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
              children: [
                _buildHeader(context, ref, latestDevice),
                Expanded(
                  child: Center(
                    child: _buildControls(ref, latestDevice, l10n),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          Positioned(
            left: 8,
            bottom: 8,
            child: Icon(
              isOnline ? Icons.wifi : Icons.wifi_off,
              size: 16,
              color: isOnline
                  ? Colors.green.withValues(alpha: 0.6)
                  : Colors.red.withValues(alpha: 0.4),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader(
      BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      Device latestDevice,
      ) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Icon(
          getDeviceIcon(latestDevice),
          size: 20,
          color: Colors.blue,
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 6),
        Expanded(
          child: Text(
            latestDevice.name,
            style: const TextStyle(
              fontSize: 13,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            maxLines: 2,
          ),
        ),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => DeviceSettings.show(context, ref, latestDevice),
          child: const Icon(
            Icons.settings,
            size: 18,
            color: Colors.grey,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildControls(
      WidgetRef ref,
      Device latestDevice,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    // Zigbee compound-устройства имеют отдельную карточку.
    if (latestDevice.type == DeviceType.compound &&
        latestDevice.properties['source'] == 'zigbee') {
      return _buildZigbeeCard(latestDevice, l10n);
    }

    switch (latestDevice.type) {
      case DeviceType.outlet:
      case DeviceType.light:
        return DevicePowerButton(device: latestDevice);
      case DeviceType.switch1:
      case DeviceType.switch2:
      case DeviceType.switch3:
        return DeviceMultiSwitch(device: latestDevice);
      case DeviceType.sensor:
        return DeviceSensorInfo(device: latestDevice);
      case DeviceType.curtain:
        return DeviceCurtainInfo(device: latestDevice);
      case DeviceType.camera:
        return DeviceCameraPreview(device: latestDevice);
      case DeviceType.compound:
      case DeviceType.hvac:
        return CompoundDeviceCard(device: latestDevice);
      default:
        return DevicePowerButton(device: latestDevice);
    }
  }

  /// Карточка Zigbee-устройства: батарея, качество связи и состояния датчиков.
  Widget _buildZigbeeCard(
      Device latestDevice,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final properties = latestDevice.properties;

    final battery = properties['battery'] as num?;
    final linkquality = properties['linkquality'] as num?;
    final waterLeak = properties['water_leak'] as bool?;
    final batteryLow = properties['battery_low'] as bool?;
    final occupancy = properties['occupancy'] as bool?;
    final contact = properties['contact'] as bool?;

    final hasInfo = battery != null ||
        linkquality != null ||
        waterLeak != null ||
        batteryLow != null ||
        occupancy != null ||
        contact != null;

    return Column(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
      children: [
        if (occupancy != null)
          Icon(
            occupancy ? Icons.directions_walk : Icons.accessibility_new,
            size: 28,
            color: occupancy ? Colors.orange : Colors.grey,
          )
        else if (contact != null)
          Icon(
            contact
                ? Icons.door_front_door
                : Icons.door_front_door_outlined,
            size: 28,
            color: contact ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey,
          )
        else if (waterLeak != null)
            Icon(
              waterLeak ? Icons.water_drop : Icons.water_drop_outlined,
              size: 28,
              color: waterLeak ? Colors.red : Colors.grey,
            )
          else
            const Icon(
              Icons.sensors,
              size: 28,
              color: Colors.purple,
            ),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        if (hasInfo)
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 8,
            runSpacing: 2,
            children: [
              if (battery != null)
                _infoChip(
                  icon: batteryLow == true
                      ? Icons.battery_alert
                      : Icons.battery_full,
                  label: '${battery.toInt()}%',
                  color: battery > 20 ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                ),
              if (linkquality != null)
                _infoChip(
                  icon: Icons.signal_cellular_alt,
                  label: '${linkquality.toInt()} lqi',
                  color: Colors.blue,
                ),
              if (waterLeak == true)
                _infoChip(
                  icon: Icons.warning_amber,
                  label: l10n.deviceCardWaterLeak,
                  color: Colors.red,
                ),
              if (occupancy == true)
                _infoChip(
                  icon: Icons.directions_walk,
                  label: l10n.deviceCardMotion,
                  color: Colors.orange,
                ),
              if (contact == true)
                _infoChip(
                  icon: Icons.door_front_door,
                  label: l10n.deviceCardContactOpen,
                  color: Colors.blue,
                ),
            ],
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _infoChip({
    required IconData icon,
    required String label,
    required Color color,
  }) {
    return Row(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Icon(icon, size: 13, color: color),
        const SizedBox(width: 2),
        Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 11,
            color: color,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
