import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../data/services/vk_notification_service.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../data/protocols/tuya_protocol.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../application/services/notification_settings_service.dart';

class DeviceControlScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final Device device;
  const DeviceControlScreen({super.key, required this.device});

  @override
  ConsumerState<DeviceControlScreen> createState() => _DeviceControlScreenState();
}

class _DeviceControlScreenState extends ConsumerState<DeviceControlScreen> {
  late final TuyaProtocol _tuyaProtocol = getIt<TuyaProtocol>();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final device = ref
        .watch(devicesProvider)
        .firstWhere((d) => d.id == widget.device.id, orElse: () => widget.device);

    final dpsMap = device.properties['dps_map'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};

    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(device.name),
        centerTitle: true,
      ),
      body: ListView(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        children: dpsMap.entries
            .where((entry) => (entry.value as Map<String, dynamic>?)?['role'] != 'info')
            .map((entry) => _buildControl(entry.key, entry.value as Map<String, dynamic>, device))
            .toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildControl(String dpId, Map<String, dynamic> config, Device device) {
    final role = config['role'] as String? ?? 'action';
    final currentValue = device.properties['dps_$dpId'] ?? device.properties[dpId];

    switch (role) {
      case 'action':
        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
          child: ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _sendCommand(dpId, true),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.play_arrow),
            label: Text(config['label'] ?? dpId),
          ),
        );
      case 'toggle':
        return SwitchListTile(
          title: Text(config['label'] ?? dpId),
          value: currentValue == true,
          onChanged: (val) => _sendCommand(dpId, val),
        );
      case 'slider':
        final divider = (config['divider'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 1.0;
        double min = (config['min'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 0;
        double max = (config['max'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 100;
        double step = (config['step'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 1;
        int divisions = step > 0 ? ((max - min) / step).round() : 100;
        double currentVal = (currentValue as num?)?.toDouble() ?? min;

        return Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Text('${config['label'] ?? dpId}: ${currentVal.toStringAsFixed(divider > 1 ? 1 : 0)}'),
            Slider(
              value: currentVal.clamp(min, max),
              min: min,
              max: max,
              divisions: divisions,
              label: currentVal.toStringAsFixed(divider > 1 ? 1 : 0),
              onChanged: (val) {
                final updatedProperties = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties);
                updatedProperties['dps_$dpId'] = val;
                ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceProperties(device.id, updatedProperties);
              },
              onChangeEnd: (val) => _sendCommand(dpId, val),
            ),
          ],
        );
      case 'enum':
        final enumValues = (config['enum_values'] as List?)?.cast<String>() ?? [];
        // Убираем дубликаты
        final uniqueValues = enumValues.toSet().toList();
        return DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
          initialValue: uniqueValues.contains(currentValue?.toString())
              ? currentValue?.toString()
              : null,
          decoration: InputDecoration(labelText: config['label'] ?? dpId),
          items: uniqueValues
              .map((v) => DropdownMenuItem(value: v, child: Text(v)))
              .toList(),
          onChanged: (val) {
            if (val != null) _sendCommand(dpId, val);
          },
        );
      default:
        return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sendCommand(String dpId, dynamic value) async {
    // Учитываем divider для value/slider
    final dpsMap = widget.device.properties['dps_map'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    final config = dpsMap[dpId] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    final divider = (config['divider'] as num?)?.toDouble() ?? 1.0;
    final sendValue = (value is num && divider > 1) ? (value * divider).round() : value;

    final oldProperties = Map<String, dynamic>.from(widget.device.properties);
    final updatedProperties = Map<String, dynamic>.from(oldProperties);
    updatedProperties['dps_$dpId'] = value;

    ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceProperties(widget.device.id, updatedProperties);

    try {
      final success = await _tuyaProtocol.setDp(widget.device, int.parse(dpId), sendValue);

      if (success) {
        // Уведомление при успешном изменении
        await _sendCompoundNotification(dpId, value);
      } else {
        ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceProperties(widget.device.id, oldProperties);
        if (mounted) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
            SnackBar(content: Text('❌ Не удалось отправить команду: DP $dpId = $value')),
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDeviceProperties(widget.device.id, oldProperties);
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('❌ Ошибка: $e')),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _sendCompoundNotification(String dpId, dynamic value) async {
    try {
      final shouldSend = await NotificationSettingsService.shouldSendDeviceNotification();
      if (!shouldSend) return;

      final dpsMap = widget.device.properties['dps_map'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      final config = dpsMap[dpId] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
      final label = config['label'] ?? dpId;

      final vk = VkNotificationService();
      await vk.loadSettings();
      await vk.sendCompoundNotification(
        deviceName: widget.device.name,
        changes: {label: value.toString()},
      );
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('❌ VK compound notification error: $e');
    }
  }
}

// ═══════════ Локальная камера планшета ═══════════

class _MiniPreview extends StatefulWidget {
  final Device device;
  const _MiniPreview({required this.device});

  @override
  State<_MiniPreview> createState() => _MiniPreviewState();
}

class _MiniPreviewState extends State<_MiniPreview> {
  CameraController? _controller;
  bool _isReady = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    try {
      final cameras = await availableCameras();
      if (cameras.isEmpty) return;
      final lens = widget.device.properties['cameraLens'] as int? ?? 0;
      _controller = CameraController(cameras[lens < cameras.length ? lens : 0], ResolutionPreset.low, enableAudio: false);
      await _controller!.initialize();
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _isReady = true);
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  @override
  void dispose() { _controller?.dispose(); super.dispose(); }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    if (!_isReady || _controller == null) return const Icon(Icons.videocam, size: 28, color: Colors.grey);
    return ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8), child: CameraPreview(_controller!));
  }
}

class _FullScreenCamera extends StatefulWidget {
  final Device device;
  const _FullScreenCamera({required this.device});

  @override
  State<_FullScreenCamera> createState() => _FullScreenCameraState();
}

class _FullScreenCameraState extends State<_FullScreenCamera> {
  CameraController? _controller;
  List<CameraDescription>? _cameras;
  int _lensIndex = 0;
  bool _isReady = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _lensIndex = widget.device.properties['cameraLens'] as int? ?? 0;
    _init();
  }

  Future<void> _init() async {
    _cameras = await availableCameras();
    if (_cameras == null || _cameras!.isEmpty) return;
    if (_lensIndex >= _cameras!.length) _lensIndex = 0;
    _controller = CameraController(_cameras![_lensIndex], ResolutionPreset.high, enableAudio: false);
    await _controller!.initialize();
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _isReady = true);
  }

  Future<void> _switch() async {
    if (_cameras == null || _cameras!.length < 2) return;
    _lensIndex = _lensIndex == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    await _controller?.dispose();
    _isReady = false;
    setState(() {});
    await _init();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() { _controller?.dispose(); super.dispose(); }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: Colors.black,
      appBar: AppBar(title: Text(widget.device.name), backgroundColor: Colors.black, actions: [
        if (_cameras != null && _cameras!.length > 1)
          IconButton(icon: const Icon(Icons.flip_camera_android, color: Colors.white), onPressed: _switch),
      ]),
      body: _isReady && _controller != null ? Center(child: CameraPreview(_controller!)) : const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator(color: Colors.white)),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';

class DeviceCompound extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Device device;
  const DeviceCompound({super.key, required this.device});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final dpsMap = device.properties['dps_map'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    final isOnline = device.state != DeviceState.offline;

    // Разделяем DPS по ролям
    final mainDps = dpsMap.entries.where((e) => e.value['role'] == 'main').toList();
    final actionDps = dpsMap.entries.where((e) => e.value['role'] == 'action').toList();
    final toggleDps = dpsMap.entries.where((e) => e.value['role'] == 'toggle').toList();
    final infoDps = dpsMap.entries.where((e) => e.value['role'] == 'info').toList();
    final statusDps = dpsMap.entries.where((e) => e.value['role'] == 'status').toList();

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        // Статус
        if (statusDps.isNotEmpty)
          Text(
            _dpsValue(statusDps.first)?.toString() ?? '--',
            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10),
          ),

        // Инфо-строка
        if (infoDps.isNotEmpty)
          Wrap(
            alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
            spacing: 4,
            runSpacing: 0,
            children: infoDps.map((e) {
              final icon = e.value['icon'] as String?;
              final val = _dpsValue(e);
              return Text(
                '${_infoIcon(icon)}${val ?? "--"}',
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 9, color: Colors.grey),
              );
            }).toList(),
          ),

        // Кнопки управления
        if (mainDps.isNotEmpty || actionDps.isNotEmpty || toggleDps.isNotEmpty)
          LayoutBuilder(
            builder: (context, constraints) {
              final narrow = constraints.maxWidth < 140;
              final allButtons = <Widget>[];
              allButtons.addAll(mainDps.map((e) => _dpsButton(ref, context, isOnline, e)));
              allButtons.addAll(actionDps.map((e) => _dpsButton(ref, context, isOnline, e)));
              allButtons.addAll(toggleDps.map((e) => _dpsToggle(ref, context, isOnline, e)));

              if (narrow) {
                return Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  children: [
                    for (var i = 0; i < allButtons.length; i += 2)
                      Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 2),
                        child: Row(
                          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                          children: [
                            allButtons[i],
                            if (i + 1 < allButtons.length) const SizedBox(width: 2),
                            if (i + 1 < allButtons.length) allButtons[i + 1],
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                );
              }

              return Wrap(
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                spacing: 2,
                runSpacing: 2,
                children: allButtons,
              );
            },
          ),
      ],
    );
  }

  dynamic _dpsValue(MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry) {
    final key = 'dps_${entry.key}';
    return device.properties[key];
  }

  Widget _dpsButton(WidgetRef ref, BuildContext ctx, bool online, MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry) {
    final label = entry.value['label'] as String? ?? '';
    final isOn = _dpsValue(entry) == true || _dpsValue(entry) == 1;
    final iconName = entry.value['icon'] as String? ?? '';
    final icon = _getIconFromName(iconName, label, isOn);
    final color = isOn ? Colors.green : Colors.grey;
    final dpsNumber = int.tryParse(entry.key) ?? 1;

    return _btn(ref, ctx, online, icon, color, () {
      ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).setSwitchChannel(device.id, dpsNumber, !isOn);
    });
  }

  Widget _dpsToggle(WidgetRef ref, BuildContext ctx, bool online, MapEntry<String, dynamic> entry) {
    final label = entry.value['label'] as String? ?? '';
    final isOn = _dpsValue(entry) == true || _dpsValue(entry) == 1;
    final iconName = entry.value['icon'] as String? ?? '';
    final icon = _getIconFromName(iconName, label, isOn);
    final color = isOn ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey;
    final dpsNumber = int.tryParse(entry.key) ?? 1;

    return _btn(ref, ctx, online, icon, color, () {
      ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).setSwitchChannel(device.id, dpsNumber, !isOn);
    });
  }

  IconData _getIconFromName(String? iconName, String label, bool isOn) {
    if (iconName != null && iconName.isNotEmpty) {
      switch (iconName) {
        case 'play': return isOn ? Icons.stop : Icons.play_arrow;
        case 'home': return Icons.home;
        case 'power': return Icons.power_settings_new;
        case 'water': return Icons.water_drop;
        case 'mop': return Icons.cleaning_services;
        case 'do_not_disturb': return Icons.do_not_disturb;
        case 'battery': return isOn ? Icons.battery_full : Icons.battery_std;
        case 'fan': return Icons.air;
        case 'temp': return Icons.thermostat;
        case 'ac': return Icons.ac_unit;
        case 'heater': return Icons.local_fire_department;
        case 'air': return Icons.air;
        case 'suction': return Icons.storm;
        case 'wait': return Icons.hourglass_empty;
        case 'sync': return Icons.sync;
        default: return Icons.circle;
      }
    }
    // Fallback
    if (label.contains('Уборка')) return isOn ? Icons.stop : Icons.play_arrow;
    if (label.contains('базу') || label.contains('Базу')) return Icons.home;
    if (label.contains('беспокоить')) return Icons.do_not_disturb;
    if (label.contains('Влажная') || label.contains('Мытьё')) return Icons.water_drop;
    return Icons.circle;
  }

  Widget _btn(WidgetRef ref, BuildContext ctx, bool online, IconData icon, Color color, VoidCallback onTap) {
    return GestureDetector(
      onTap: () {
        if (!online) {
          ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
            const SnackBar(content: Text('Offline'), duration: Duration(seconds: 1)),
          );
          return;
        }
        onTap();
      },
      child: Container(
        width: 26, height: 26,
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          shape: BoxShape.circle,
          color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
        ),
        child: Icon(icon, size: 16, color: color),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _infoIcon(String? icon) {
    switch (icon) {
      case 'battery': return '🔋';
      case 'timer': return '⏱';
      case 'area': return '📐';
      default: return '';
    }
  }
}

class DeviceMultiSwitch extends ConsumerWidget {

  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final channels = device.properties['channels'] as int?
        ?? (device.type == DeviceType.switch3 ? 3
            : device.type == DeviceType.switch2 ? 2
            : 1);
    final states = List<bool>.from(device.properties['states'] ?? List.filled(channels, false));
    final isThreeChannel = channels == 3;

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: List.generate(isThreeChannel ? 2 : channels, (i) {
            return Expanded(
              child: _ChannelButton(device: device, channel: i + 1, isOn: i < states.length ? states[i] : false, showLabel: channels > 1),
            );
          }),
        ),
        if (isThreeChannel) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          Row(mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center, children: [
            _ChannelButton(device: device, channel: 3, isOn: states.length > 2 ? states[2] : false, showLabel: true),
          ]),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }
}

class DeviceSensorInfo extends ConsumerWidget {
  final Device device;

  const DeviceSensorInfo({super.key, required this.device});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref) {
    final temp = device.properties['temperature'];
    final hum = device.properties['humidity'];
    final power = device.properties['power'];
    final current = device.properties['current'];
    final voltage = device.properties['voltage'];
    final sensorType = device.properties['sensorType'] as String?;

    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      children: [
        if (temp != null) Text('${(temp as num).toDouble()}°C', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 22, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        if (hum != null) Text('${(hum as num).toDouble()}%', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.blue)),
        if (power != null) Text('${(power as num).toDouble()} W', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
        if (current != null) Text('${(current as num).toDouble()} mA', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.orange)),
        if (voltage != null) Text('${(voltage as num).toDouble()} V', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, color: Colors.blueGrey)),
        if (temp == null && hum == null && power == null && current == null && voltage == null)
          Text(sensorType ?? '---', style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, color: Colors.grey)),
        const SizedBox(height: 6),
        GestureDetector(
          onTap: () => _refreshSensorData(ref),
          child: const Icon(Icons.refresh, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Future<void> _refreshSensorData(WidgetRef ref) async {
    try {
      final outlet = OutletDevice(deviceId: device.deviceId ?? '', address: device.address ?? '', localKey: device.localKey ?? '', version: device.version ?? 3.3);
      final result = await outlet.status();
      if (result['dps'] != null) {
        final dps = result['dps'] as Map<String, dynamic>;
        final sensorDps = device.properties['sensorDps'] ?? device.dpsIndex ?? 21;
        final divider = device.properties['sensorDivider'] ?? 10;
        final rawValue = dps[sensorDps] ?? dps[sensorDps.toString()];
        if (rawValue != null) {
          final value = (rawValue as num).toDouble() / divider;
          final sensorType = device.properties['sensorType'] as String?;
          ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(device.copyWith(properties: {...device.properties, if (sensorType == 'temperature') 'temperature': value, if (sensorType == 'humidity') 'humidity': value, if (sensorType == 'power') 'power': value}));
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }
}
===== C:\SHomeV8.0\lib\presentation\widgets\device_icons.dart =====
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';

IconData getDeviceIcon(Device device) {
  switch (device.type) {
    case DeviceType.outlet: return Icons.power;
    case DeviceType.light: return Icons.lightbulb;
    case DeviceType.switch1:
    case DeviceType.switch2:
    case DeviceType.switch3: return Icons.toggle_on;
    case DeviceType.sensor:
      final st = device.properties['sensorType'] as String?;
      if (st == 'temperature') return Icons.thermostat;
      if (st == 'humidity') return Icons.water_drop;
      if (st == 'power') return Icons.bolt;
      return Icons.sensors;
    case DeviceType.curtain: return Icons.blinds;
    case DeviceType.hvac: return Icons.ac_unit;
    case DeviceType.camera: return Icons.videocam;
    case DeviceType.compound: return Icons.smart_toy;
    default: return Icons.devices;
  }
}

  static String _getNotifySummary(
      Device device,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final condition =
        device.properties['notify_condition'] as String? ?? 'always';

    final conditionLabel = switch (condition) {
      'always' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAlways,
      'away' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAway,
      'night' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyNight,
      'away_or_night' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAwayOrNight,
      _ => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAlways,
    };

    final typeCount =
        (device.properties['notify_types'] as List?)?.length ?? 5;

    return l10n.deviceSettingsNotifySummary(typeCount, conditionLabel);
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // DPS КАРТА — отображение списка DPS
  // ===================================================================

  static List<Widget> _buildDpsMapEditor(Device device,
      void Function(VoidCallback) setModalState,
      BuildContext ctx,
      WidgetRef ref,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final dpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties['dps_map'] as Map? ?? {});

    final sortedKeys = dpsMap.keys.toList()
      ..sort((a, b) => (int.tryParse(a) ?? 0).compareTo(int.tryParse(b) ?? 0));

    return sortedKeys.map((key) {
      final cfg = dpsMap[key] as Map<String, dynamic>;
      final label = cfg['label'] as String? ?? '';
      final role = cfg['role'] as String? ?? '';
      final iconName = cfg['icon'] as String? ?? '';

      final leading = role == 'channel'
          ? const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 16, color: Colors.blueGrey)
          : _dpsIcon(role, iconName);

      final titlePrefix = role == 'channel' ? 'Канал' : 'DPS';

      return ListTile(
        dense: true,
        leading: leading,
        title: Text('$titlePrefix $key: $label', style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12)),
        trailing: const Icon(Icons.edit, size: 16),
        onTap: () {
          if (role == 'channel') {
            _showChannelEditor(ctx, setModalState, device, key, ref, l10n);
          } else {
            _showDpsEditor(ctx, setModalState, device, key, ref, l10n);
          }
        },
      );
    }).toList();
  }

  static Widget _dpsIcon(String role, String? iconName) {
    if (iconName != null && iconName.isNotEmpty) {
      return Text(_iconEmoji(iconName), style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16));
    }
    return _dpsRoleIcon(role);
  }

  static Icon _dpsRoleIcon(String role) {
    switch (role) {
      case 'main':
        return const Icon(Icons.power_settings_new, size: 16, color: Colors.green);
      case 'action':
        return const Icon(Icons.play_circle, size: 16, color: Colors.blue);
      case 'toggle':
        return const Icon(Icons.toggle_on, size: 16, color: Colors.orange);
      case 'info':
        return const Icon(Icons.info_outline, size: 16, color: Colors.grey);
      case 'status':
        return const Icon(Icons.info, size: 16, color: Colors.teal);
      case 'slider':
        return const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 16, color: Colors.purple);
      case 'enum':
        return const Icon(Icons.list, size: 16, color: Colors.indigo);
      case 'channel':
        return const Icon(Icons.tune, size: 16, color: Colors.blueGrey);
      default:
        return const Icon(Icons.help_outline, size: 16);
    }
  }

  static String _iconEmoji(String key) {
    switch (key) {
      case 'battery': return '🔋';
      case 'timer': return '⏱';
      case 'area': return '📐';
      case 'water': return '💧';
      case 'fan': return '🌀';
      case 'temp': return '🌡';
      case 'home': return '🏠';
      case 'power': return '⚡';
      case 'mop': return '🧹';
      case 'ac': return '❄️';
      case 'heater': return '🔥';
      case 'air': return '🍃';
      case 'suction': return '🌪️';
      case 'wait': return '⏳';
      case 'sync': return '🔄';
      default: return '📌';
    }
  }

  // ===================================================================
  // РЕДАКТОР ОДНОГО DPS
  // ===================================================================

  static void _showDpsEditor(
      BuildContext context,
      void Function(VoidCallback) setModalState,
      Device device,
      String? dpsKey,
      WidgetRef ref,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final isNew = dpsKey == null;
    final dpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties['dps_map'] as Map? ?? {});

    final keyController = TextEditingController(text: dpsKey ?? '');
    final labelController = TextEditingController(text: isNew ? '' : dpsMap[dpsKey]?['label'] ?? '');
    String selectedType = isNew ? 'bool' : dpsMap[dpsKey]?['type'] ?? 'bool';
    const validTypes = ['bool', 'value', 'enum', 'slider'];
    if (!validTypes.contains(selectedType)) {
      selectedType = 'bool';
    }
    String selectedRole = isNew ? 'action' : dpsMap[dpsKey]?['role'] ?? 'action';
    const validRoles = ['main', 'action', 'toggle', 'info', 'status', 'enum', 'slider', 'channel'];
    if (!validRoles.contains(selectedRole)) {
      selectedRole = 'action';
    }
    String selectedIcon = isNew ? '' : dpsMap[dpsKey]?['icon'] ?? '';
    final enumValuesController = TextEditingController(
      text: isNew ? '' : (dpsMap[dpsKey]?['enum_values'] as List?)?.join(', ') ?? '',
    );

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(
            isNew

                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'heater',
                    child: Text('🔥 ${l10n.deviceSettingsIconHeater}'),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'air',
                    child: Text('🍃 ${l10n.deviceSettingsIconAir}'),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'suction',
                    child: Text('🌪️ ${l10n.deviceSettingsIconSuction}'),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'wait',
                    child: Text('⏳ ${l10n.deviceSettingsIconWaiting}'),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: 'sync',
                    child: Text('🔄 ${l10n.deviceSettingsIconSynchronization}'),
                  ),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) => setDialogState(() => selectedIcon = v ?? ''),
              ),
            ]),
          ),
          actions: [
            if (!isNew)
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx);
                  _deleteDps(device, dpsKey, ref);
                },
                child: Text(
                  l10n.deviceSettingsDelete,
                  style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                ),
              ),
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                final newKey = keyController.text.trim();
                if (newKey.isEmpty || labelController.text.isEmpty) return;

                final newDpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dpsMap);

                if (!isNew && dpsKey != newKey) {
                  newDpsMap.remove(dpsKey);
                }

                newDpsMap[newKey] = {
                  'label': labelController.text,
                  'type': selectedType,
                  'role': selectedRole,
                  if (selectedIcon.isNotEmpty) 'icon': selectedIcon,
                  if (selectedType == 'enum' && enumValuesController.text.isNotEmpty)
                    'enum_values': enumValuesController.text
                        .split(',')
                        .map((e) => e.trim())
                        .where((e) => e.isNotEmpty)
                        .toList(),
                };

                final latestDevice = ref.read(devicesProvider).firstWhere(
                      (d) => d.id == device.id,
                  orElse: () => device,
                );

                final updated = latestDevice.copyWith(
                  properties: {...latestDevice.properties, 'dps_map': newDpsMap},
                );
                await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(updated);
                if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                setModalState(() {});
              },
              child: Text(
                isNew
                    ? l10n.deviceSettingsAdd
                    : l10n.deviceSettingsSave,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static void _deleteDps(Device device, String dpsKey, WidgetRef ref) {
    final dpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties['dps_map'] as Map? ?? {});
    dpsMap.remove(dpsKey);

    final updated = device.copyWith(
      properties: {...device.properties, 'dps_map': dpsMap},
    );
    ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(updated);
  }

  static void _showCreateSensorDialog(BuildContext context,
      WidgetRef ref,
      Device device,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    SensorType selectedSensorType = SensorType.temperature;
    final dpsController = TextEditingController(text: '21');
    final dividerController = TextEditingController(text: '10');
    final nameController = TextEditingController(text: '${device.name} t°');

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCreateSensor),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
              Text(l10n.deviceSettingsSensorFromDevice(device.name)),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              DropdownButtonFormField<SensorType>(
                initialValue: selectedSensorType,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsSensorType,
                ),
                items: [
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: SensorType.temperature,
                    child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsTemperature),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: SensorType.humidity,
                    child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsHumidity),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: SensorType.power,
                    child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsPower),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: SensorType.current,
                    child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCurrent),
                  ),
                  DropdownMenuItem(
                    value: SensorType.voltage,
                    child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsVoltage),
                  ),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) {
                  if (v != null) {
                    setDialogState(() {
                      selectedSensorType = v;
                      switch (v) {
                        case SensorType.temperature:
                          dpsController.text = '21';
                          dividerController.text = '10';
                          nameController.text = '${device.name} t°';
                          break;
                        case SensorType.humidity:
                          dpsController.text = '22';
                          dividerController.text = '10';
                          nameController.text = '${device.name} h%';
                          break;
                        case SensorType.power:
                          dpsController.text = '23';
                          dividerController.text = '10';
                          nameController.text = '${device.name} W';
                          break;
                        case SensorType.current:
                          dpsController.text = '21';
                          dividerController.text = '1';
                          nameController.text = '${device.name} mA';
                          break;
                        case SensorType.voltage:
                          dpsController.text = '22';
                          dividerController.text = '10';
                          nameController.text = '${device.name} V';
                          break;
                        default:
                          break;
                      }
                    });
                  }
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: nameController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsName,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: dpsController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsDpsIndex,
                ),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: dividerController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsDivider,
                ),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              ),
            ]),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () {
                final dps = int.tryParse(dpsController.text) ?? 21;
                final div = double.tryParse(dividerController.text) ?? 10;
                ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).addDevice(Device(
                  id: '${device.id}_sensor_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
                  name: nameController.text,
                  type: DeviceType.sensor,
                  roomId: device.roomId,
                  isOnline: false,
                  state: DeviceState.offline,
                  deviceId: device.deviceId,
                  localKey: device.localKey,
                  address: device.address,
                  version: device.version,
                  dpsIndex: dps,
                  properties: {'sensorDps': dps, 'sensorDivider': div, 'sensorType': selectedSensorType.name},
                ));
                Navigator.pop(ctx);
                ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                  SnackBar(
                    content: Text(
                      l10n.deviceSettingsSensorCreated(nameController.text),
                    ),
                  ),
                );
              },
              child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCreate),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static Widget _buildDisplaySettings(WidgetRef ref,
      Device device,
      VoidCallback setModalState,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    return Card(
      color: Colors.blue.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
        child: Consumer(
          builder: (context, ref, _) {
            final latestDevice = ref.watch(
              devicesProvider.select(
                    (list) => list.firstWhere((d) => d.id == device.id),
              ),
            );
            final dpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(
              latestDevice.properties['dps_map'] as Map? ?? {},
            );

            final displayEntries = dpsMap.entries.where((e) {
              final role = (e.value as Map<String, dynamic>)['role'];
              return role == 'info' || role == 'status';
            }).toList();

            return Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.visibility, color: Colors.blue, size: 20),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(
                      'Отображение на карточке',
                      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  l10n.deviceSettingsDisplayHint,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 8),
                if (displayEntries.isEmpty)
                  Text(
                    l10n.deviceSettingsNoInfoParameters,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 12),
                  )
                else
                  ...displayEntries.map((entry) {
                    final config = entry.value as Map<String, dynamic>;
                    final key = entry.key;
                    final label = config['label'] as String? ?? key;
                    final currentlyShown = config['show_on_card'] != false;

                    return SwitchListTile(
                      dense: true,
                      title: Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13)),
                      value: currentlyShown,
                      onChanged: (val) {
                        final newDpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dpsMap);
                        final newConfig = Map<String, dynamic>.from(config)
                          ..['show_on_card'] = val;
                        newDpsMap[key] = newConfig;
                        final updatedProperties =
                        Map<String, dynamic>.from(latestDevice.properties)
                          ..['dps_map'] = newDpsMap;
                        ref
                            .read(devicesProvider.notifier)
                            .updateDeviceProperties(latestDevice.id, updatedProperties);
                        setModalState();
                      },
                      activeThumbColor: Colors.blue,
                    );
                  }),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  static void _showChannelEditor(
      BuildContext context,
      void Function(VoidCallback) setModalState,
      Device device,
      String channelKey,
      WidgetRef ref,
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      ) {
    final dpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(device.properties['dps_map'] as Map? ?? {});
    final currentConfig = dpsMap[channelKey] as Map<String, dynamic>? ?? {};
    final keyController = TextEditingController(text: channelKey);
    final labelController = TextEditingController(
      text: currentConfig['label'] as String? ??
          l10n.deviceSettingsDefaultChannelLabel(channelKey),
    );

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Канал'),
          content: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextField(
                controller: keyController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsChannelNumber,
                ),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              TextField(
                controller: labelController,
                decoration: InputDecoration(
                  labelText: l10n.deviceSettingsName,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsCancel),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                final newKey = keyController.text.trim();
                if (newKey.isEmpty || labelController.text.isEmpty) return;

                final newDpsMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(dpsMap);

                if (channelKey != newKey) {
                  newDpsMap.remove(channelKey);
                }

                newDpsMap[newKey] = {
                  'label': labelController.text,
                  'type': 'bool',
                  'role': 'channel',
                };

                final latestDevice = ref.read(devicesProvider).firstWhere(
                      (d) => d.id == device.id,
                  orElse: () => device,
                );

                final updated = latestDevice.copyWith(
                  properties: {...latestDevice.properties, 'dps_map': newDpsMap},
                );
                await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).updateDevice(updated);
                if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                setModalState(() {});
              },
              child: Text(l10n.deviceSettingsSave),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import '../../data/services/stats_cache.dart';

/// Прозрачный «хвостик» справа по центру экрана.
/// Тап или свайп влево → открывает EndDrawer.
/// Бейдж: зелёный — аномалий нет, красный — есть.
class EdgeHandle extends StatefulWidget {
  final VoidCallback onOpen;
  const EdgeHandle({super.key, required this.onOpen});

  @override
  State<EdgeHandle> createState() => _EdgeHandleState();
}

class _EdgeHandleState extends State<EdgeHandle> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    StatsCache.instance.addListener(_onCacheChanged);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    StatsCache.instance.removeListener(_onCacheChanged);
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _onCacheChanged() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isPhone = MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).width < 600;
    final color = Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary;
    final hasAnomalies = StatsCache.instance.anomalyCount > 0;
    final badgeColor = hasAnomalies ? Colors.red : Colors.green;

    return Positioned(
      right: 0,
      top: MediaQuery.sizeOf(context).height * (isPhone ? 0.38 : 0.42),
      child: GestureDetector(
        onTap: widget.onOpen,
        onHorizontalDragEnd: (details) {
          if (details.primaryVelocity != null && details.primaryVelocity! < 0) {
            widget.onOpen();
          }
        },
        child: Stack(
          clipBehavior: Clip.none,
          children: [
            Container(
              width: isPhone ? 16 : 20,
              height: isPhone ? 48 : 64,
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                borderRadius:
                const BorderRadius.horizontal(left: Radius.circular(10)),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                  width: 1,
                ),
              ),
              child: Icon(
                Icons.analytics_outlined,
                size: 14,
                color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.6),
              ),
            ),
            Positioned(
              top: -2,
              right: -2,
              child: Container(
                width: 10,
                height: 10,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: badgeColor,
                  shape: BoxShape.circle,
                  border: Border.all(color: Colors.white, width: 1.5),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../di/injection.dart';
import '../../data/services/frigate_service.dart';
import 'frigate_camera_settings.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class FrigateCameraCard extends ConsumerStatefulWidget {
  final Device device;

  const FrigateCameraCard({required this.device, super.key});

  @override
  ConsumerState<FrigateCameraCard> createState() => _FrigateCameraCardState();
}

class _FrigateCameraCardState extends ConsumerState<FrigateCameraCard> {
  Timer? _timer;
  int _tick = 0;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _startTimer();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _timer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _startTimer() {
    final interval = widget.device.properties['snapshot_interval'] as int? ?? 5;
    _timer = Timer.periodic(Duration(seconds: interval), (_) {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _tick++);
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);
    // P1: live-устройство из провайдера (только своё)
    final liveDevice = ref.watch(
      devicesProvider.select(
            (list) => list.firstWhere(
              (d) => d.id == widget.device.id,
          orElse: () => widget.device,
        ),
      ),
    );

    final service = getIt<FrigateService>();
    final cameraName =
        liveDevice.properties['camera_name'] as String? ?? liveDevice.name;
    final isDetecting = liveDevice.properties['isDetecting'] as bool? ?? false;
    final snapshotUrl =
        'http://${service.host}:${service.port}/api/$cameraName/latest.jpg?t=$_tick';

    return Card(
      elevation: isDetecting ? 8 : 4,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        side: isDetecting
            ? const BorderSide(color: Colors.red, width: 3)
            : BorderSide.none,
      ),
      child: Stack(
        children: [
          // Снапшот
          ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            child: Image.network(
              snapshotUrl,
              fit: BoxFit.cover,
              width: double.infinity,
              height: double.infinity,
              errorBuilder: (_, __, ___) => const Center(
                child: Icon(Icons.videocam_off, size: 48, color: Colors.grey),
              ),
              loadingBuilder: (_, child, progress) {
                if (progress == null) return child;
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              },
            ),
          ),
          // Оверлей
          Positioned(
            bottom: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            child: Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topCenter,
                  end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
                  colors: [
                    Colors.transparent,
                    Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.7)
                  ],
                ),
                borderRadius:
                const BorderRadius.vertical(bottom: Radius.circular(16)),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    liveDevice.isOnline ? Icons.circle : Icons.circle_outlined,
                    size: 12,
                    color: liveDevice.isOnline ? Colors.green : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      liveDevice.name,
                      style: const TextStyle(
                          color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.settings, color: Colors.white, size: 20),
                    tooltip: l10n.frigateCameraSettingsTooltip,
                    onPressed: () =>
                        FrigateCameraSettings.show(context, ref, liveDevice, l10n),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
          // Красная подсветка при детекции
          if (isDetecting)
            Positioned(
              top: 8,
              right: 8,
              child: Container(
                padding:
                const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.red,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),

/// Полные настройки Frigate-камеры.
/// Диалог с редактированием:
/// - Название
/// - Комната
/// - Snapshot interval
/// - RTSP порт
/// - Удаление
/// - Кнопка «Уведомления» → DeviceNotificationsScreen (labels + условие)
library;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_riverpod/flutter_riverpod.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import '../../application/state/devices_provider.dart';
import '../../application/state/rooms_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/models/device.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class FrigateCameraSettings {
  static void show(BuildContext context, WidgetRef ref, Device device, l10n) {
    final nameController = TextEditingController(text: device.name);
    final rtspPortController = TextEditingController(
      text: (device.properties['rtsp_port'] as int?)?.toString() ?? '8554',
    );

    String selectedRoomId = device.roomId;
    int snapshotInterval = (device.properties['snapshot_interval'] as int?) ?? 5;

    final rooms = ref.read(roomsProvider);

    final Map<String, DropdownMenuItem<String>> roomItemsMap = {};

    for (final r in rooms) {
      roomItemsMap[r.id] = DropdownMenuItem(
        value: r.id,
        child: Text('${r.icon ?? "🏠"} ${r.name}'),
      );
    }

    if (!roomItemsMap.containsKey('other')) {
      roomItemsMap['other'] = const DropdownMenuItem(
        value: 'other',
        child: Text('🔌 Техника'),
      );
    }

    if (!roomItemsMap.containsKey(selectedRoomId)) {
      selectedRoomId = roomItemsMap.containsKey('other')
          ? 'other'
          : roomItemsMap.keys.first;
    }

    final roomItems = roomItemsMap.values.toList();

    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setModalState) {
          final latestDevice = ref.watch(devicesProvider).firstWhere(
                (d) => d.id == device.id,
            orElse: () => device,
          );

          return Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(
              left: 16,
              right: 16,
              top: 16,
              bottom: MediaQuery.of(ctx).viewInsets.bottom + 16,
            ),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      const Icon(Icons.videocam, color: Colors.red, size: 28),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      const Expanded(
                        child: Text(
                          'Настройки камеры',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),

                  TextField(
                    controller: nameController,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Название',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.label),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    initialValue: selectedRoomId,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Комната',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.meeting_room),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    items: roomItems,
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      if (v != null) setModalState(() => selectedRoomId = v);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                    initialValue: snapshotInterval,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Интервал снимков',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.timer),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    items: const [
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 5, child: Text('5 секунд')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 10, child: Text('10 секунд')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 30, child: Text('30 секунд')),
                    ],
                    onChanged: (v) {
                      if (v != null) setModalState(() => snapshotInterval = v);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  TextField(
                    controller: rtspPortController,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'RTSP порт',
                      hintText: '8554',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.settings_ethernet),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),

                  // 🔔 Уведомления → отдельный экран
                  Card(
                    child: ListTile(
                      leading: const Icon(Icons.notifications_active,
                          color: Colors.orange),
                      title: const Text('Уведомления'),
                      subtitle: Text(
                          _getNotifySummary(latestDevice, l10n),
                        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                      ),
                      trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
                      onTap: () {
                        Navigator.pop(ctx);
                        context.push(
                            '/device_notifications?id=${latestDevice.id}');
                      },
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),

                  Row(
                    children: [
                      Expanded(
                        child: OutlinedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () =>
                              _confirmDelete(ctx, ref, latestDevice),
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                          label: const Text(
                            'Удалить',
                            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
                          ),
                          style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                            side: const BorderSide(color: Colors.red),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                      Expanded(
                        flex: 2,
                        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
                          onPressed: () async {
                            final name = nameController.text.trim();
                            if (name.isEmpty) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                                const SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('Название не может быть пустым'),
                                ),
                              );
                              return;
                            }

                            final rtspPort =
                                int.tryParse(rtspPortController.text) ?? 8554;
                            if (rtspPort < 1 || rtspPort > 65535) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(ctx).showSnackBar(
                                const SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('RTSP порт должен быть 1-65535'),
                                ),
                              );
                              return;
                            }

                            final updated = latestDevice.copyWith(
                              name: name,
                              roomId: selectedRoomId,
                              properties: {
                                ...latestDevice.properties,
                                'camera_name': name,
                                'snapshot_interval': snapshotInterval,
                                'rtsp_port': rtspPort,
                              },
                            );

                            await ref
                                .read(devicesProvider.notifier)
                                .updateDevice(updated);

                            if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                            if (context.mounted) {
                              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                                const SnackBar(
                                  content: Text('✅ Настройки сохранены'),
                                  backgroundColor: Colors.green,
                                ),
                              );
                            }
                          },
                          icon: const Icon(Icons.save),
                          label: const Text('Сохранить'),
                          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  static String _getNotifySummary(Device device, AppLocalizations l10n,) {
    final condition = device.properties['notify_condition'] as String? ?? 'always';

    final conditionLabel = switch (condition) {
      'always' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAlways,
      'away' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAway,
      'night' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyNight,
      'away_or_night' => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAwayOrNight,
      _ => l10n.deviceSettingsNotifyAlways,
    };

    final typeCount =
        (device.properties['notify_types'] as List?)?.length ?? 5;

    return l10n.deviceSettingsNotifySummary(typeCount, conditionLabel);
  }

  static Future<void> _confirmDelete(
      BuildContext ctx,
      WidgetRef ref,
      Device device,
      ) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: ctx,
      builder: (dialogCtx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Удалить камеру?'),
        content: Text('${device.name} будет удалена из SHome.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogCtx, false),
            child: const Text('Отмена'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(dialogCtx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
            child: const Text('Удалить'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true) {
      await ref.read(devicesProvider.notifier).removeDevice(device.id);
      if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
    }
  }
}

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../data/services/language_preference.dart';
import '../../l10n/generated/app_localizations.dart';

class LanguageSelectorTile extends StatefulWidget {
  const LanguageSelectorTile({super.key});

  @override
  State<LanguageSelectorTile> createState() =>
      _LanguageSelectorTileState();
}

class _LanguageSelectorTileState extends State<LanguageSelectorTile> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    unawaited(LanguagePreference.load());
  }

  String _languageLabel(
      AppLocalizations l10n,
      String languageCode,
      ) {
    switch (languageCode) {
      case LanguagePreference.russian:
        return l10n.languageRussian;
      case LanguagePreference.english:
        return l10n.languageEnglish;
      case LanguagePreference.system:
      default:
        return l10n.languageSystem;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _chooseLanguage() async {
    final selected = await showDialog<String>(
      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        final dialogL10n = AppLocalizations.of(dialogContext);

        return ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
          valueListenable: LanguagePreference.value,
          builder: (context, currentLanguage, _) {
            return SimpleDialog(
              title: Text(dialogL10n.languageTitle),
              children: [
                _languageOption(
                  dialogContext,
                  code: LanguagePreference.system,
                  currentLanguage: currentLanguage,
                  label: dialogL10n.languageSystem,
                ),
                _languageOption(
                  dialogContext,
                  code: LanguagePreference.russian,
                  currentLanguage: currentLanguage,
                  label: dialogL10n.languageRussian,
                ),
                _languageOption(
                  dialogContext,
                  code: LanguagePreference.english,
                  currentLanguage: currentLanguage,
                  label: dialogL10n.languageEnglish,
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        );
      },
    );

    if (!mounted || selected == null) return;

    await LanguagePreference.set(selected);

    if (!mounted) return;

    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          l10n.languageSelected(
            _languageLabel(l10n, selected),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _languageOption(
      BuildContext dialogContext, {
        required String code,
        required String currentLanguage,
        required String label,
      }) {
    final isSelected = currentLanguage == code;

    return SimpleDialogOption(
      onPressed: () => Navigator.of(dialogContext).pop(code),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Icon(
            isSelected
                ? Icons.radio_button_checked
                : Icons.radio_button_off,
            size: 20,
            color: isSelected ? Colors.blue : null,
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 12),
          Text(label),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final l10n = AppLocalizations.of(context);

    return Card(
      child: ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
        valueListenable: LanguagePreference.value,
        builder: (context, languageCode, _) {
          return ListTile(
            leading: const Icon(
              Icons.language,
              color: Colors.indigo,
            ),
            title: Text(l10n.languageTitle),
            subtitle: Text(
              l10n.languageSelected(
                _languageLabel(l10n, languageCode),
              ),
            ),
            trailing: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right),
            onTap: _chooseLanguage,
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}
